domains.name: product
domains.description: Single source of truth for all product master data across the CPG/FMCG portfolio. Owns SKU definitions, GTIN/UPC/EAN identifiers, product hierarchies, BOM structures, PLM lifecycle stages, formulation records, packaging specifications, INCI ingredient declarations, and regulatory labeling attributes. Serves as the authoritative product catalog referenced by all other domains.

products.name: sku
products.description: Core master record for every Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) in the CPG/FMCG portfolio. Single source of truth for SKU identity including internal code, description, brand assignment, sub-brand, product form, variant, net content, unit of measure, pack size, launch date, discontinuation date, PLM lifecycle stage, portfolio classification, shelf life attributes (total shelf life, FEFO threshold, storage conditions), and key consumer-facing attributes (scent, color, target demographic). Referenced by all other domains as the authoritative product identifier.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SKU record in the product master. Primary key for the sku data product, referenced by all downstream domains as the authoritative product identifier.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: SKU belongs to a product category; linking SKU to category eliminates silo and consolidates category data.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost allocation report requires each SKU to be assigned a cost_center for expense tracking and product profitability analysis.

attributes.name: default_supply_network_node_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Default Supply Network Node Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Required for assigning each SKU to its primary distribution node used in supply planning, ATP calculations, and network optimization.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AR invoice posting uses a default sales GL account per SKU; linking enables automated revenue posting and audit trails.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_hierarchy. Business justification: sku should be linked to its product hierarchy for classification; no existing column, so new FK added.

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: CAPACITY PLANNING: Assign each SKU to its primary manufacturing facility for production capacity allocation, cost per facility, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Brand performance reports require each SKU to be linked to its marketing brand for equity and spend analysis.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Primary Supplier Assignment for each SKU is required for sourcing strategy, cost analysis, and regulatory compliance reports.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Designating a primary supplier site per SKU supports logistics planning, VMI inventory control, and OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability statements map each SKU to a profit_center, enabling SKU‑level P&L reporting and margin analysis.

attributes.name: color
attributes.description: Consumer-facing color descriptor for the SKU (e.g., 'Blue', 'Clear', 'White'). Applicable to products where color is a differentiating attribute (e.g., hair color, cosmetics, cleaning products). Used in planogram execution and consumer-facing content.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 701; FTC Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the product is manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, trade compliance, and consumer labeling in many markets.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Dictionary; FDA 21 CFR; ISO 3166-1; WTO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the SKU master record was first created in the system of record (SAP S/4HANA). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and compliance with SOX record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the MSRP and standard cost fields (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SKU was or is planned to be permanently discontinued from the portfolio. Triggers end-of-life processes in supply chain, manufacturing, and trade. Null if the SKU is still active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: ean
attributes.description: 13-digit European Article Number (EAN-13) used in international retail markets outside North America for barcode scanning and product identification. Registered with GS1.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: fefo_threshold_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: First Expired First Out (FEFO) Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: Minimum remaining shelf life percentage (of total shelf life) required at the time of shipment to a customer or retailer. Below this threshold, the product is considered non-shippable. Used in Blue Yonder WMS and SAP IBP inventory optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP IBP Inventory Optimization; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the consumer unit including packaging in kilograms. Used in logistics freight calculation, transportation planning, and customs documentation. Maps to SAP MM material master gross weight field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Global Data Dictionary; OSHA

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the product in global trade. Encompasses UPC-A (12-digit), EAN-13 (13-digit), and ITF-14 (14-digit) formats. Used for barcode scanning, EDI transactions, and retailer product listings.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; FDA 21 CFR Part 830

attributes.name: inci_declaration
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Declaration
attributes.description: Full INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) ingredient list as declared on product packaging, listed in descending order of concentration. Mandatory for cosmetic and personal care products under FDA and EU regulations. Stored in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 701.3; EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; INCI Nomenclature; ISO 22716

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, or transportation documentation (e.g., Safety Data Sheet / SDS). Triggers compliance workflows in logistics and warehouse management.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA Regulations; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: is_recyclable_packaging
attributes.description: Indicates whether the primary packaging of the SKU is designed to be recyclable. Used in sustainability reporting, ESG disclosures, and consumer-facing labeling claims per FTC Green Guides.
attributes.references: FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; ISO 14001; EU Packaging Directive

attributes.name: is_regulated_product
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU is subject to regulatory approval or registration requirements (e.g., FDA OTC drug, EPA-registered disinfectant, CPSC-regulated product). Triggers regulatory submission workflows in Veeva Vault.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA Registration; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: is_sustainable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SKU meets the company's sustainability criteria, such as FSC-certified packaging, RSPO-certified palm oil, or ISO 14001-aligned manufacturing. Used in sustainability reporting and ESG disclosures.
attributes.references: FSC Forest Stewardship Council; RSPO Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil; ISO 14001

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the SKU master record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; ISO 9001

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date on which the SKU was first commercially available for sale in any market. Used in new product development (NPD) tracking, demand planning baseline establishment, and trade promotion planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the SKU in the Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) framework (e.g., concept, development, launch, growth, mature, decline, discontinued). Governs which business processes are active for the SKU. Managed in Veeva Vault PLM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|launch|growth|mature|decline|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) in the base currency. Represents the recommended consumer selling price (RSP) set by the manufacturer. Used in trade promotion planning (TPM), pricing strategy, and retailer negotiations. Confidential commercial data.
attributes.references: FTC Pricing Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: net_content
attributes.description: Numeric net content quantity of the product as declared on packaging (e.g., 500, 1.5, 200). Must be paired with net_content_uom. Regulated by FDA and FTC for accurate labeling. Used in COGS calculation and logistics weight/volume planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Fair Packaging and Labeling Act; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: net_content_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net content quantity (e.g., ml, L, g, kg, oz, fl oz, ct). Aligned with GS1 UN/CEFACT unit codes. Required for regulatory labeling compliance and logistics planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ml|L|g|kg|oz|fl oz|ct|units — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 UN/CEFACT Unit Codes; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Fair Packaging and Labeling Act

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the product content excluding packaging in kilograms. Used in COGS calculation, regulatory labeling, and customs declarations. Maps to SAP MM material master net weight field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: Number of individual consumer units contained within a single sellable pack (e.g., 1 for single unit, 2 for twin pack, 6 for multipack). Used in trade promotion planning (TPM), pricing, and distribution requirements planning (DRP).
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: packaging_material_type
attributes.description: Material type of the primary consumer packaging (e.g., plastic, glass, aluminum, paper, cardboard). Used in sustainability reporting, EU REACH compliance, and packaging specification management in Veeva Vault. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: plastic|glass|aluminum|paper|cardboard|composite|biodegradable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation; ISO 14001; FSC; RSPO; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: portfolio_classification
attributes.description: Strategic classification of the SKU within the brand portfolio (e.g., core, strategic, tail, innovation, seasonal, limited_edition). Used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) prioritization, resource allocation, and SKU rationalization decisions.
attributes.references: SAP IBP S&OP; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: product_form
attributes.description: Physical or chemical form of the product (e.g., liquid, powder, gel, cream, spray). Critical for manufacturing process routing in Siemens Opcenter MES, packaging specification, and regulatory classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: liquid|powder|gel|cream|foam|spray|bar|tablet|capsule|wipe|stick|sheet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full consumer-facing product name as it appears on packaging and in retail listings. Includes brand, variant, and size descriptors (e.g., 'Brand X Moisturizing Body Wash Fresh Scent 500ml'). Used in marketing, trade, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 701; FTC Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: regulatory_category
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the SKU determining the applicable regulatory framework and labeling requirements (e.g., cosmetic, OTC drug, household chemical, food). Drives compliance workflows in Veeva Vault and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cosmetic|otc_drug|household_chemical|food|dietary_supplement|medical_device|general_merchandise — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA Registration; CPSC; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: scent
attributes.description: Consumer-facing scent or fragrance descriptor for the SKU (e.g., 'Fresh', 'Lavender', 'Unscented'). Relevant for personal care and household products. Used in consumer engagement, marketing, and IFRA fragrance compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IFRA International Fragrance Association Standards; FDA 21 CFR Part 701

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Abbreviated product description (typically 40–80 characters) used in ERP transactions, warehouse management systems, and EDI communications where full product names are truncated. Maps to SAP MM short text field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric code assigned to the SKU within the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA Material Number). Serves as the primary business identifier used in procurement, manufacturing, and sales transactions. Maps to SAP MM material number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the SKU in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA material status). Controls whether the SKU can be procured, manufactured, sold, or shipped. 'blocked' prevents all transactions; 'pending_launch' indicates pre-commercialization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 Global Data Dictionary

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard cost per consumer unit used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation, financial reporting, and profitability analysis. Set annually during standard cost roll in SAP S/4HANA CO. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Product Costing; SOX Financial Reporting; EBITDA Reporting

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required storage conditions for the SKU throughout the supply chain (e.g., ambient, refrigerated, frozen, controlled_temperature). Drives warehouse slotting in Blue Yonder WMS, transportation lane requirements, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: sub_brand
attributes.description: Sub-brand or product line within the parent brand (e.g., 'Dove Men+Care', 'Tide PODS'). Enables granular brand portfolio analysis and targeted trade promotion management (TPM).
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Second-level product classification within the category (e.g., 'Shampoo', 'Conditioner', 'Detergent Pods'). Supports granular category management, demand planning in SAP IBP, and retail execution reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Primary consumer demographic segment this SKU is designed and marketed for (e.g., adult, baby, male, female, professional). Drives consumer segmentation, marketing investment allocation, and shelf placement strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: adult|baby|child|teen|senior|unisex|male|female|professional|family — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: total_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the SKU in days from the date of manufacture to the expiry date as declared on packaging. Used in FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, Blue Yonder WMS configuration, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: upc
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC-A) used primarily in North American retail for point-of-sale scanning and inventory management. Subset of GTIN. Registered with GS1 US.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Specific variant descriptor distinguishing this SKU from others within the same product line (e.g., 'Original', 'Sensitive Skin', 'Extra Strength', '2-in-1'). Used in PLM lifecycle management and consumer segmentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of the consumer unit in millilitres, used for liquid and semi-liquid products. Supports logistics cube utilization calculations, warehouse slotting, and transportation planning.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Dictionary; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

products.name: gtin_registry
products.description: Authoritative registry of all GS1-compliant global trade item numbers (GTIN-8, GTIN-12/UPC, GTIN-13/EAN, GTIN-14) assigned to each SKU and its packaging hierarchy levels (each, inner pack, case, pallet). Stores GTIN value, GS1 company prefix, indicator digit, check digit, packaging level, assignment date, status, and GS1 registration reference. Enables barcode scanning, EDI transactions, and retailer catalog synchronization.

attributes.name: gtin_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Registry ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each GTIN registry record in the Databricks Silver layer. Assigned by the platform upon ingestion from SAP S/4HANA MM or GS1 registration source.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal SKU master record to which this GTIN is assigned. A single SKU may have multiple GTINs across packaging hierarchy levels (each, inner pack, case, pallet).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; GS1 General Specifications

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GTIN was activated and made available for commercial use, EDI transactions, and retailer catalog publication. May differ from assignment_date when a GTIN is pre-assigned during NPD but activated at product launch.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Management Standard; GS1 Sunrise Date Policy

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this GTIN was formally assigned to the SKU by the brand owner. Used for GS1 GTIN Management Standard compliance, audit trails, and PLM lifecycle tracking in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Management Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

attributes.name: barcode_symbology
attributes.description: The barcode symbology used to encode this GTIN on the physical product or packaging (e.g., UPC-A for consumer units, ITF-14 for cases, GS1-128 for logistic labels). Determines scanner compatibility at POS, warehouse, and DSD delivery points. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UPC-A|EAN-13|EAN-8|ITF-14|GS1-128|GS1_DataBar|QR_Code — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Barcode Symbologies; ISO/IEC 15420; ISO/IEC 16388

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The registered brand or trademark name under which the product is marketed to consumers. Used for retailer catalog syndication, Nielsen IQ market measurement reporting, and trade promotion management in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: GS1 Product Data Standard; Nielsen IQ Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: brand_owner_gln
attributes.description: The 13-digit GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) identifying the legal entity that owns the brand and is responsible for the GTIN assignment. Required for GS1 Data Source (1WorldSync/Salsify) product data syndication and retailer onboarding.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — GLN; GS1 Data Source Standard

attributes.name: cases_per_pallet
attributes.description: The standard number of cases stacked on one pallet (logistic unit). Used for transportation planning, warehouse slotting in Blue Yonder WMS, and pallet-level GTIN-14 assignment. Drives DRP and S&OP capacity calculations in SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Packaging Hierarchy; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 General Specifications

attributes.name: check_digit
attributes.description: The single trailing check digit of the GTIN, calculated using the GS1 modulo-10 algorithm. Used to validate GTIN integrity during barcode scanning, EDI processing, and retailer catalog ingestion. Stored explicitly to support validation workflows.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Check Digit Calculation; ISO/IEC 15420

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the product was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, FDA import labeling, FTC country-of-origin rules, and retailer catalog submissions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FDA Import Labeling Requirements; FTC Country of Origin Rules; GS1 Product Data Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GTIN registry record was first created in the system of record. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: data_pool_publication_date
attributes.description: The date on which the product data for this GTIN was first published to the GS1 data pool (GDSN). Used to track compliance with retailer new item setup timelines and GS1 sunrise date requirements.
attributes.references: GS1 GDSN (Global Data Synchronization Network); GS1 Sunrise Date Policy

attributes.name: data_pool_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether the full product data record for this GTIN has been published to a GS1-certified data pool (e.g., 1WorldSync, Salsify) for retailer catalog synchronization. True = published and available to subscribers; False = not yet published.
attributes.references: GS1 Data Source Standard; 1WorldSync GDSN; Salsify PIM

attributes.name: ean_value
attributes.description: The 13-digit EAN-13 barcode value used for international retail scanning and cross-border trade. Populated when gtin_format is GTIN-13. Required for EU, APAC, and LATAM retailer catalog submissions and EDI transactions.

attributes.name: edi_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN is set up and approved for EDI transactions (850 Purchase Order, 856 ASN, 832 Price/Sales Catalog) with trading partners. False when the GTIN is pending retailer item setup or has failed EDI validation. Managed in SAP S/4HANA SD and Oracle Cloud EDI.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; ANSI X12 Transaction Sets 850/856/832; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: gpc_brick_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) Brick Code
attributes.description: The 8-digit GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) Brick Code that categorizes the product into a standardized product segment, family, class, and brick. Required for GS1 data pool submissions and used by retailers for category management and planogram (POG) optimization.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) Standard; GS1 Data Source

attributes.name: gs1_company_prefix
attributes.description: The GS1-assigned company prefix (6–12 digits) that identifies the brand owner within the GTIN structure. Issued by GS1 US or a GS1 Member Organization. Determines the number of GTINs available to the company and is embedded in every GTIN assigned by the company.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; GS1 Company Prefix Licence Agreement

attributes.name: gs1_member_org
attributes.description: The name of the GS1 Member Organization (e.g., GS1 US, GS1 UK, GS1 Germany) through which the company prefix was licensed. Relevant for multi-national CPG companies that hold prefixes from multiple GS1 member organizations across different markets.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; GS1 Member Organization Network

attributes.name: gs1_registration_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or confirmation identifier issued by GS1 (or a GS1 Member Organization) upon formal registration of this GTIN in the GS1 registry. Used for audit, dispute resolution, and regulatory submissions requiring proof of GS1 registration.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Management Standard; GS1 Registry Platform

attributes.name: gs1_registry_published
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN has been published to the GS1 Registry Platform (formerly GEPIR) and is visible to trading partners and retailers for catalog synchronization. True = published; False = not yet published or withheld.
attributes.references: GS1 Registry Platform; GS1 GTIN Management Standard

attributes.name: gtin_format
attributes.description: Identifies the GTIN format variant: GTIN-8 (EAN-8 short barcode), GTIN-12 (UPC-A, North American standard), GTIN-13 (EAN-13, international standard), or GTIN-14 (ITF-14, used for cases and pallets). Determines barcode symbology and EDI transaction set usage.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; GS1 US GTIN Management Standard

attributes.name: gtin_value
attributes.description: The full numeric GTIN string including the check digit. Supports GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC-A), GTIN-13 (EAN-13), and GTIN-14 (shipping container/case) formats as defined by GS1 General Specifications. Used in barcode scanning, EDI transactions, and retailer catalog synchronization.

attributes.name: indicator_digit
attributes.description: Single leading digit (0–9) used in GTIN-14 to indicate the packaging level of a trade item. A value of 0 indicates a consumer unit; values 1–8 indicate inner packs or cases; value 9 is reserved for variable-measure trade items. Applicable only when gtin_format is GTIN-14.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; GS1 GTIN-14 Allocation Rules

attributes.name: inner_packs_per_case
attributes.description: The number of inner packs (display shippers or multi-packs) contained within one case. Populated only when an intermediate inner-pack packaging level exists in the hierarchy. Used in SAP S/4HANA MM BOM and GS1 packaging hierarchy declarations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM BOM; GS1 General Specifications — Packaging Hierarchy

attributes.name: is_consumer_unit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents the consumer-facing sellable unit (each/each pack) as opposed to an inner pack, case, or pallet. True = consumer unit eligible for POS scanning; False = logistic/trade unit. Drives OSA monitoring and POS data matching in Nielsen IQ and TradeEdge.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Consumer Unit; Nielsen IQ POS Data Standard

attributes.name: is_orderable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN is currently eligible to be ordered by retail customers via EDI or Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud order management. False when the GTIN is retired, pending, or restricted to specific channels.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: is_scannable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid, scannable barcode (UPC/EAN/ITF-14) has been verified and approved for this GTIN. False when the barcode artwork is pending verification or has failed GS1 barcode quality verification. Used in retail execution and DSD workflows in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: GS1 Barcode Verification Standard; ISO/IEC 15416; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: is_variable_measure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GTIN represents a variable-measure trade item (e.g., catch-weight products sold by weight). True = variable measure; False = fixed measure. Variable-measure GTINs use indicator digit 9 in GTIN-14 and require special POS and EDI handling per GS1 specifications.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Variable Measure Trade Items; GS1 US Implementation Guide

attributes.name: item_reference_number
attributes.description: The item reference portion of the GTIN, assigned by the brand owner to uniquely identify the product within the company prefix. Together with the company prefix and check digit, it forms the complete GTIN. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM material master EAN/UPC segment.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; SAP S/4HANA MM EAN Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this GTIN registry record in the system of record. Used for incremental data loads, change detection, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: net_content_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the net content value (e.g., ml, L, g, kg, oz, fl_oz, ct, ea). Required for FDA label compliance, GS1 data pool submissions, and retailer catalog item setup. Follows GS1 Recommendation on Unit of Measure codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ml|L|g|kg|oz|fl_oz|ct|ea — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Recommendation on Unit of Measure; FDA 21 CFR Part 101; FTC Fair Packaging and Labeling Act

attributes.name: net_content_value
attributes.description: The numeric net content quantity of the consumer unit (e.g., 400 for a 400ml shampoo bottle). Combined with net_content_uom to express the full net content declaration required on product labels per FDA and FTC labeling regulations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 — Food Labeling; FTC Fair Packaging and Labeling Act; GS1 Product Data Standard

attributes.name: packaging_level
attributes.description: Identifies the packaging hierarchy level to which this GTIN is assigned: each (consumer unit), inner pack (multi-pack or display shipper), case (master carton), or pallet (logistic unit). Drives EDI order management, warehouse scanning, and DRP/MRP planning in SAP S/4HANA and Blue Yonder WMS.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Packaging Hierarchy; GS1 GTIN Allocation Rules

attributes.name: plm_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: The current PLM lifecycle stage of the product associated with this GTIN: concept, development, commercialization, active (in market), end_of_life (phase-out initiated), or discontinued. Sourced from the PLM system and used to govern GTIN activation, EDI eligibility, and retailer catalog status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; PLM Lifecycle Management Standard

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: The internal product category classification (e.g., Hair Care, Skin Care, Oral Care, Home Care) to which the SKU belongs. Aligns with the company's PLM product hierarchy and Nielsen IQ category definitions for market share reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Category Management; GS1 Product Classification (GPC)

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Short consumer-facing product description associated with this GTIN, as published to retailer catalogs and GS1 data pools. Typically includes brand name, product name, variant, and net content (e.g., 'Brand X Moisturizing Shampoo 400ml'). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM material description.
attributes.references: GS1 Product Data Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Description

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GTIN registration: active (in use and published to trading partners), pending (assigned but not yet published), inactive (temporarily suspended), retired (permanently discontinued), or cancelled (assigned in error and voided). Governs EDI eligibility and retailer catalog synchronization.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Management Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM EAN Status

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the GTIN was retired or discontinued from active commercial use. Per GS1 GTIN Management Standard, a retired GTIN must not be reassigned for a minimum of 48 months. Null when the GTIN is still active.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Management Standard — GTIN Reuse Rules

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this GTIN record was sourced: SAP_S4HANA (MM EAN management), Oracle_Cloud (procurement/supply chain), GS1_Registry (direct GS1 platform), or Manual (entered directly). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud ERP; GS1 Registry Platform

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: The natural key or internal identifier of this GTIN record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP material number + EAN category combination). Used for delta-load reconciliation, deduplication, and lineage tracing in the Databricks Silver layer ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EAN/UPC Management; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: target_market_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the primary market for which this GTIN is intended. A single SKU may have different GTINs for different target markets due to regulatory labeling, language, or formulation differences. Used in GS1 data pool syndication and Veeva Vault regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications — Target Market; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: units_per_case
attributes.description: The number of consumer units (eaches) contained within one case (master carton). Used in SAP S/4HANA MM for BOM/packaging hierarchy, DRP/MRP planning, and EDI order quantity validation. Also referenced in Blue Yonder WMS for receiving and putaway.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Packaging Hierarchy; GS1 General Specifications

attributes.name: upc_value
attributes.description: The 12-digit UPC-A barcode value assigned to the consumer unit (each). Derived from the GTIN-12 and used primarily for North American retail POS scanning and retailer item setup. Populated only when gtin_format is GTIN-12.
attributes.references: GS1 US UPC Implementation Guide; GS1 General Specifications

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the multi-level product classification hierarchy used across the CPG portfolio: Division → Category → Sub-Category → Brand → Sub-Brand → Product Form → SKU. Each node carries hierarchy level code, node name, parent node reference, sort order, active flag, GPC brick code alignment, Nielsen/IRI category code mapping, and applicable regulatory framework. Serves as the single authoritative classification backbone for OLAP drill-down, trade promotion planning, demand forecasting, market share reporting, and regulatory categorization.

attributes.name: hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each node in the product classification hierarchy. Serves as the primary key for this record in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: parent_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediate parent node in the product hierarchy tree. NULL for root-level nodes (e.g., Division). Enables recursive traversal of the Division → Category → Sub-Category → Brand → Sub-Brand → Product Form → SKU hierarchy.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Consumer goods category/division hierarchy nodes map to profit centers for brand and category P&L reporting. hierarchy.profit_center_code is a denormalized signal. A direct FK enables IBP-to-finance P

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this hierarchy node was formally approved by the data steward or product management team. Supports PLM lifecycle governance and audit trail for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code of the Brand-level ancestor node for this hierarchy node. Denormalized to enable brand-level P&L reporting, brand equity tracking, SOV (Share of Voice) analysis, and trade promotion planning at the brand level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Code of the Category-level ancestor node for this hierarchy node. Denormalized to support category management, trade promotion planning (TPM), and demand forecasting without recursive hierarchy joins.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion

attributes.name: channel_applicability
attributes.description: Distribution channels through which products in this hierarchy node are sold (e.g., 'Retail', 'E-Commerce', 'DTC', 'Wholesale', 'DSD'). Supports channel management, trade promotion planning, and distribution requirements planning (DRP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Retail|E-Commerce|DTC|Wholesale|DSD|Club|Drug — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: consumer_segment
attributes.description: Primary consumer segment targeted by products in this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Men 18-35', 'Families with Children', 'Premium Skincare Enthusiasts'). Used in brand marketing strategy, NPS (Net Promoter Score) analysis, and consumer engagement planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: cpsc_regulated
attributes.business_glossary_term: CPSC Regulated Flag (Consumer Product Safety Commission)
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this hierarchy node are subject to CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission) regulations. True = product safety testing, labeling, and reporting requirements under CPSA apply.
attributes.references: CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act (CPSA); 16 CFR

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy node record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with SOX financial data governance requirements.

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: Code of the top-level Division node to which this hierarchy node belongs (e.g., 'HPC' for Home & Personal Care, 'FOOD' for Food & Beverage). Denormalized for fast filtering in OLAP queries and S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) reporting without full hierarchy traversal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; SAP IBP S&OP

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this hierarchy node became effective and available for use in planning, trade promotion, and reporting systems. Supports temporal validity management and historical hierarchy reconstruction for trend analysis.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this hierarchy node is no longer active. NULL indicates an open-ended validity. Used for hierarchy versioning, portfolio rationalization, and ensuring discontinued nodes are excluded from forward-looking demand plans.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: External partner or retailer-specific category code mapped to this hierarchy node (e.g., Walmart category code, Amazon browse node ID). Supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transactions, retailer data synchronization, and VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) programs.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; Retail EDI Category Mapping

attributes.name: gmp_standard
attributes.description: Applicable GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standard for manufacturing products in this hierarchy node. Drives quality management requirements in Siemens Opcenter MES and Veeva Vault QMS. ISO 22716 applies to cosmetics; 21 CFR 111 to dietary supplements; 21 CFR 210/211 to pharmaceuticals.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA 21 CFR 111; FDA 21 CFR 210/211; ISO 9001

attributes.name: gpc_brick_code
attributes.description: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) brick-level code (8-digit numeric) aligned to this hierarchy node. Enables cross-industry product classification interoperability, EDI transactions, and retailer data synchronization via GS1 standards.

attributes.name: gpc_brick_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the GS1 GPC brick code associated with this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Shampoo/Conditioner - Non-Medicated'). Supports regulatory submissions, retailer onboarding, and GS1 data pool synchronization.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of this node within the product classification hierarchy. Level 1 = Division, Level 2 = Category, Level 3 = Sub-Category, Level 4 = Brand, Level 5 = Sub-Brand, Level 6 = Product Form, Level 7 = SKU (Stock Keeping Unit). Used for OLAP drill-down and aggregation logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; GS1 GPC

attributes.name: ibp_planning_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: IBP Planning Level Flag (Integrated Business Planning)
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is a designated planning level in SAP IBP (Integrated Business Planning) for demand forecasting and S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning). True = this node is an active planning aggregation point.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; S&OP Process

attributes.name: inci_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: INCI Applicable Flag (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients)
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this hierarchy node require INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) ingredient declaration on labeling. True = cosmetic/personal care products subject to EU Cosmetics Regulation and FDA cosmetic labeling requirements.
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation No 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR Part 701; INCI

attributes.name: iri_category_code
attributes.description: IRI (now Circana) proprietary category code mapped to this hierarchy node. Supports market share reporting, TDP (Total Distribution Points) analysis, and SOM (Share of Market) calculations using IRI syndicated data.

attributes.name: is_leaf_node
attributes.description: Indicates whether this node is a terminal leaf in the hierarchy (True = no children exist, typically the SKU level). Used to filter for assignable product nodes in demand forecasting, inventory management, and trade promotion planning.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the node_name and node_description fields (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es'). Supports multi-language product hierarchy management for global CPG/FMCG operations and localized reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM Language-Dependent Texts

attributes.name: level_name
attributes.description: Business label for the hierarchy depth of this node. Enumerated values correspond to the CPG/FMCG standard classification spine: Division, Category, Sub-Category, Brand, Sub-Brand, Product Form, SKU (Stock Keeping Unit). Drives display logic in reporting tools and S&OP dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Division|Category|Sub-Category|Brand|Sub-Brand|Product Form|SKU — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning Hierarchy; Nielsen IQ Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: market_share_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this hierarchy node is included in external market share reporting via Nielsen IQ or IRI/Circana syndicated data. True = node is mapped to a syndicated data category for SOM (Share of Market) and ACV (All Commodity Volume) reporting.

attributes.name: nielsen_category_code
attributes.description: Nielsen IQ proprietary category code mapped to this hierarchy node. Enables direct linkage between internal product classification and Nielsen IQ retail measurement data for market share reporting, ACV (All Commodity Volume) analysis, and competitive benchmarking.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement Service Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this hierarchy node within its level. Used as the business key in SAP S/4HANA MM product group structures and referenced in EDI transactions and trade promotion planning systems.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; GS1 GPC

attributes.name: node_description
attributes.description: Extended business description of the hierarchy node providing additional context about the product grouping, its scope, and intended use in classification. Supports regulatory categorization and PLM documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of this hierarchy node (e.g., 'Personal Care', 'Shampoo', 'Head & Shoulders', 'Classic Clean'). Used in OLAP drill-down reports, trade promotion planning, and market share dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; Nielsen IQ Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this hierarchy node. 'active' nodes are available for use in planning, trade promotion, and reporting. 'discontinued' nodes are retained for historical analysis. 'pending' nodes are awaiting approval in the PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Veeva Vault PLM Lifecycle

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Materialized full path string from root to this node using a delimiter (e.g., 'Consumer Goods / Personal Care / Hair Care / Shampoo / Head & Shoulders / Classic Clean'). Enables fast string-based filtering and display in BI tools without recursive joins.

attributes.name: plm_lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the product node in the PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) lifecycle. Drives NPD (New Product Development) workflows, portfolio rationalization decisions, and demand planning assumptions in SAP IBP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|development|launch|growth|mature|decline|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Veeva Vault PLM; SAP S/4HANA MM; ISO 9001 Product Lifecycle

attributes.name: reach_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this hierarchy node are subject to EU REACH Regulation (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals). True = chemical substance registration and SDS (Safety Data Sheet) requirements apply.

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: Identifies the primary regulatory framework governing products classified under this hierarchy node (e.g., 'FDA OTC Drug', 'FDA Cosmetic', 'EPA Pesticide', 'CPSC Consumer Product', 'EU Cosmetics Regulation'). Drives compliance workflows in Veeva Vault and regulatory labeling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FDA OTC Drug|FDA Cosmetic|EPA Pesticide|CPSC Consumer Product|EU Cosmetics Regulation|REACH|ISO 22716|IFRA — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU Cosmetics Regulation No 1223/2009; EPA FIFRA; CPSC; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of sibling nodes within the same parent. Used to enforce business-defined ordering in planograms (POG), category management reports, and trade promotion planning interfaces.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this hierarchy node was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA MM, Veeva Vault PLM, Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud). Supports data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_S4|ORACLE_ERP|VEEVA|SALESFORCE_CGC|SAP_IBP|NIELSEN|MANUAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: source_system_node_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this hierarchy node in the originating operational system (e.g., SAP product hierarchy node ID, Veeva Vault record ID). Enables reverse traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy; Enterprise Data Lineage

attributes.name: sustainability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products in this hierarchy node carry a sustainability certification (e.g., FSC, RSPO, ISO 14001). Supports ESG reporting, sustainable sourcing procurement decisions, and consumer-facing sustainability claims.
attributes.references: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council); RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code assigned to this hierarchy node for VAT/GST determination in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Drives correct tax treatment in sales orders, invoicing, and financial reporting across jurisdictions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Determination; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether products under this hierarchy node are eligible for trade promotion activities (TPM/TPO). Drives eligibility rules in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion Management and ROI (Return on Investment) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM; TPO Process

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this hierarchy node record in the Silver Layer. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version counter for this hierarchy node record. Incremented each time the node definition is materially changed (e.g., reclassification, rename, regulatory framework update). Supports SCD Type 2 history management and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Change Documents; ISO 9001 Document Control

products.name: product_bom
products.description: Bill of Materials (BOM) header record defining the complete ingredient and component structure for a finished good or semi-finished SKU. Captures BOM number, BOM type (production, costing, engineering), base quantity, unit of measure, effective date range, PLM status, and the owning plant or production site. Links to BOM line items for individual component details. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA PP/MM modules.

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Bill of Materials (BOM) header record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_formulation. Business justification: product_bom currently has a formulation_code (STRING) that is a string reference to the product_formulation record. This is a classic denormalized string reference that should be a proper FK. Adding p

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production site that owns this BOM. BOMs in SAP are plant-specific; the same material may have different BOMs per plant reflecting local sourcing or production capabilities.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished good or semi-finished SKU for which this BOM is defined. Links to the product master (material master in SAP). A single SKU may have multiple BOMs of different types.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MARA/MARC)

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: GMP change control and BOM validation processes require linking each BOM to its governing quality specification. QA teams use this link during BOM approval reviews to verify component acceptance crite

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_contract. Business justification: Contract manufacturing BOMs are executed under specific supplier contracts. MRP and production planning require knowing which contract governs a BOM version for cost rollup, compliance verification, a

attributes.name: alternative_bom
attributes.description: Alternative BOM identifier (SAP STLAL) allowing multiple BOM variants for the same material and plant combination. Used to manage seasonal formulations, regional variants, or cost-optimized alternatives within the same SKU.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Alternative BOM (STLAL)

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this BOM was formally approved for production use. Part of the GMP and PLM audit trail. Required for regulatory submissions and quality management documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 11; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The reference quantity of the finished or semi-finished material for which the BOM component quantities are specified. All component quantities in BOM line items are expressed relative to this base quantity. Typically 1 or 100 in CPG manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Header Base Quantity (STKO-BMENG); GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: base_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the BOM base quantity (e.g., KG, L, EA, G). Defines the unit in which the finished good is expressed for component ratio calculations. Aligns with SAP base unit of measure (MARA-MEINS) and GS1 unit codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Base Unit of Measure (MARA-MEINS); GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: bom_category
attributes.description: SAP BOM category indicating the object type the BOM is assigned to. 'material' is the standard category for product BOMs in CPG/FMCG. 'equipment' and 'functional_location' apply to plant maintenance BOMs. Aligns with SAP STKO-STLTY.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Category (STKO-STLTY)

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the BOM, typically including the product name, formulation variant, and intended use. Used in PLM, engineering change orders, and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Header Text; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: Indicates the level of the BOM in a multi-level product structure. Level 0 is the finished good, level 1 represents direct components, level 2 represents sub-components, etc. Used for multi-level BOM explosion in MRP and costing roll-ups.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Multi-Level BOM Explosion (CS12); MRP (Material Requirements Planning)

attributes.name: bom_number
attributes.description: Externally-known BOM document number as assigned in SAP S/4HANA PP/MM (e.g., SAP BOM header number). This is the business-facing identifier used in PLM, procurement, and manufacturing communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — CS01/CS02 BOM Header

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose of the BOM. 'production' is used for manufacturing execution (MRP/MES), 'costing' for COGS and standard cost roll-up, 'engineering' for R&D and NPD design, 'sales' for variant configuration, 'configurable' for multi-variant BOMs. Aligns with SAP BOM usage (STLAL).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Usage (STLAL); GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Number (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) reference that authorized the creation or modification of this BOM version. Provides traceability from BOM changes back to the formal change management process in PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Engineering Change Management (ECM); ISO 9001 Section 8.3; Veeva Vault PLM

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of active component line items in this BOM. Provides a quick indicator of BOM complexity and is used in BOM completeness validation checks during PLM review and quality audits.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Item Count; ISO 9001 Section 8.3; PLM

attributes.name: costing_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is relevant for product costing (COGS calculation and standard cost roll-up). 'relevant' means the BOM is included in cost estimates, 'not_relevant' excludes it, 'conditional' applies under specific costing scenarios. Critical for financial reporting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Product Costing (CO-PC); COGS; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this BOM record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA). Provides the audit trail creation marker required for GMP, SOX, and ISO 9001 compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — ERDAT/ERZET; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; SOX; GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: deletion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM has been flagged for deletion in SAP. A deletion flag marks the BOM as logically deleted without physically removing the record, preserving audit history. Aligns with SAP STKO-LOEKZ.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Deletion Flag (STKO-LOEKZ); SOX Compliance

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this BOM version is valid and can be used for production planning, MRP, and costing. Supports time-phased BOM management for seasonal reformulations, ingredient substitutions, or regulatory-driven changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Valid From Date (STKO-DATUV); ISO 9001 Section 7.5

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date until which this BOM version is valid. Null indicates an open-ended validity. Used to manage BOM version transitions during reformulations, regulatory updates, or product discontinuations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Valid To Date (STKO-DATUB); ISO 9001 Section 7.5

attributes.name: gmp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM has been validated as compliant with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Required for health, hygiene, and personal care products. Compliance is verified during quality review before BOM activation.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 (GMP for Cosmetics); FDA 21 CFR Part 111; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM supports variant configuration, allowing different component selections based on product characteristics (e.g., fragrance variant, pack size). Used for configurable products in CPG where a single BOM covers multiple SKU variants.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/SD Module — Variant Configuration (LO-VC); PLM

attributes.name: is_phantom
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM represents a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that does not physically exist as a stocked item but is used to simplify BOM structures. Phantom assemblies are exploded through in MRP without generating production orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Phantom Assembly (MARC-LGPRO); MRP

attributes.name: last_changed_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this BOM record. Part of the change audit trail required for GMP, engineering change management, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — AENAM; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; SOX; GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: last_changed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this BOM record in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — AEDAT/AEZET; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; SOX; GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: lot_size_from
attributes.description: Minimum lot size for which this BOM is valid. BOMs can be lot-size dependent in process manufacturing, where component quantities vary based on batch size. Used in conjunction with lot_size_to to define the valid production quantity range.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Lot-Size-Dependent BOM (STKO-BMEIN); GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: lot_size_to
attributes.description: Maximum lot size for which this BOM is valid. Defines the upper bound of the production quantity range for lot-size-dependent BOMs. Null indicates no upper limit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Lot-Size-Dependent BOM (STKO-BMEIN); GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: lot_size_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the lot size range (lot_size_from and lot_size_to). Typically matches the base UOM of the finished good (e.g., KG, L, EA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Lot Size UOM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number (MATNR) of the finished good or semi-finished product for which this BOM is defined. This is the externally-known product code used across SAP modules (MM, PP, SD, CO) and in EDI transactions with trading partners.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master (MARA-MATNR); GS1 GTIN Standards

attributes.name: mrp_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM is used in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) runs for procurement and production scheduling. When true, MRP will explode this BOM to generate dependent requirements for components and raw materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module — MRP (Material Requirements Planning); SAP IBP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments associated with this BOM header, capturing manufacturing instructions, formulation rationale, regulatory notes, or change justifications that do not fit structured fields. Sourced from SAP BOM header long text.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Header Long Text; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character SAP plant code identifying the manufacturing facility or production site where this BOM is applicable. Used in MRP, production orders, and supply chain planning (SAP IBP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module — Plant (MARC-WERKS); ISO 9001

attributes.name: plm_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the BOM as managed in the PLM process. 'draft' indicates initial creation, 'in_review' is under engineering/regulatory review, 'approved' is signed off but not yet released to production, 'active' is in use for manufacturing, 'obsolete' is retired, 'superseded' has been replaced by a newer BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — BOM Status; Veeva Vault PLM; ISO 9001 Section 8.3

attributes.name: production_version
attributes.description: SAP production version identifier (MKAL-VERID) that links this BOM to a specific routing/recipe and production line. A material may have multiple production versions representing different manufacturing processes or lines at the same plant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Production Version (MKAL-VERID); Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: reach_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all chemical substances in this BOM are compliant with EU REACH (Registration, Evaluation, Authorisation and Restriction of Chemicals) regulation. Mandatory for products sold in the European Union.
attributes.references: EU REACH Regulation (EC No 1907/2006); European Chemicals Agency (ECHA)

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory approval for this BOM/formulation. Indicates whether the ingredient composition has been reviewed and approved by relevant regulatory bodies (FDA, EU REACH, CPSC). Required before a BOM can be released to active production status.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU REACH Regulation; CPSC (Consumer Product Safety Commission); Veeva Vault Regulatory Submissions; ISO 22716

attributes.name: rspo_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certified Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm oil or palm-derived ingredients in this BOM are sourced from RSPO-certified sustainable sources. Relevant for personal care and household products containing palm oil derivatives. Supports sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil); ISO 14001 (Environmental Management Systems); FSC (Forest Stewardship Council)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this BOM record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and enables multi-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Module; Veeva Vault PLM; Siemens Opcenter MES; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: source_system_bom_code
attributes.description: The native primary key or document number of this BOM record in the originating source system (e.g., SAP internal BOM header key combining MATNR+WERKS+STLAL+STLAN). Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — STKO Key Fields (MATNR/WERKS/STLAL/STLAN); Data Lineage

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version or revision identifier for the BOM document, enabling traceability of formulation changes over time. Incremented when ingredient quantities, component substitutions, or structural changes are made. Critical for regulatory submissions and GMP compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Engineering Change Management; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; GMP ISO 22716

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this BOM record in SAP S/4HANA or the PLM system. Part of the mandatory audit trail for GMP and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — ERNAM; ISO 9001 Section 7.5; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GMP ISO 22716

products.name: bom_line
products.description: Individual component line within a Bill of Materials, specifying each raw material, packaging component, or sub-assembly required to produce the parent SKU. Attributes include component item number, component description, component type (raw material, packaging, semi-finished), required quantity, unit of measure, scrap percentage, lead time offset, and whether the component is a critical or alternative item. Supports MRP, COGS calculation, and procurement planning.

attributes.name: bom_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual component line within a Bill of Materials. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_LINE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - CS11/CS12 BOM Line Item

attributes.name: approved_supplier_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.approved_supplier_list. Business justification: Each BOM line component must reference an approved supplier list entry to enforce qualified sourcing during production. GMP compliance in consumer goods manufacturing requires that every BOM component

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or production facility for which this BOM line is defined. BOM structures can vary by plant due to local sourcing, equipment capabilities, or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module - Plant (WERKS); GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: material_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.material. Business justification: Each BOM line specifies a component (raw material, packaging component, etc.). The material table is the authoritative master for all materials in the domain. bom_line.component_item_number is a strin

attributes.name: product_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Bill of Materials header that this line belongs to. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - CS11 BOM Header

attributes.name: restricted_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.restricted_substance. Business justification: BOM components must be screened against restricted substance lists (REACH SVHC, RoHS, California Prop 65) during product development and supplier qualification. This FK enables automated restricted su

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master product/material record for the component (raw material, packaging component, or sub-assembly) required on this BOM line. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master (MARA)

attributes.name: specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.specification. Business justification: Individual BOM line components each have component-level quality specifications in consumer goods. QA teams use component specs for incoming inspection of each BOM component, critical component qualif

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or approved supplier for this component. Used in procurement planning and source list determination during MRP runs. Supports VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) and MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity) management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Source List (EORD); VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory); MOQ (Minimum Order Quantity)

attributes.name: alternative_item_group
attributes.description: Groups multiple BOM lines that are interchangeable alternatives for the same component requirement. All lines sharing the same group code can substitute for one another, enabling flexible sourcing and production planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Alternative Item Group (ALGRU)

attributes.name: alternative_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank within an alternative item group, determining the preferred order of substitution when multiple alternatives exist. Lower numbers indicate higher preference (e.g., 1 = first choice).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Alternative Item Priority (PRIOK)

attributes.name: bom_item_category
attributes.description: SAP BOM item category code that controls how the component is procured and managed. Determines whether the item is stocked, non-stocked, variable-size, or a document/text item. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stock|non_stock|variable_size|document|text|class — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - BOM Item Category (POSTP)

attributes.name: bulk_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is a bulk material that is not individually picked or issued but is consumed from a bulk supply point on the shop floor. Bulk materials are typically excluded from individual goods issue postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Bulk Material Indicator (SCHGT)

attributes.name: change_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Number (ECN) or Engineering Change Order (ECO) that authorized the creation or modification of this BOM line. Provides traceability to the formal change management process in PLM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PLM Module - Engineering Change Management (AENR); ISO 9001 Change Control

attributes.name: co_product_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line represents a co-product or by-product that is produced alongside the primary output. Co-products have positive quantities and receive a portion of the production cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO Module - Co-Product Indicator (KUPPF); COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) Allocation

attributes.name: component_cost_usd
attributes.description: The standard cost per unit of measure for this component in USD, used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation and product costing. Sourced from the material master standard price or moving average price.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Cost (STPRS); COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) Accounting; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: component_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the component material, such as 'HDPE Bottle 500ml Natural' or 'Fragrance Blend XY-204'. Used in procurement, quality, and manufacturing documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Description (MAKTX)

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the component indicating its role in the manufacturing process. Drives MRP planning logic and COGS categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|packaging|semi_finished|finished_good|co_product|by_product — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - BOM Item Category; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BOM line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and change management tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Created On (ERDAT/ERZET); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements; ISO 9001

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the component cost value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Enables multi-currency COGS reporting for global manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: fixed_quantity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity is fixed regardless of the parent order quantity (True) or scales proportionally with the production order size (False). Fixed quantities are common for setup materials, catalysts, or tooling items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Fixed Quantity Indicator (MFEST)

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is classified as a hazardous material under applicable regulations (e.g., OSHA HazCom, EU CLP, DOT). Triggers special handling, storage, and transportation requirements and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008; EPA Regulations; SDS (Safety Data Sheet)

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: The standardized INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) name for this component when used in personal care or cosmetic formulations. Required for regulatory ingredient labeling compliance on finished product packaging.
attributes.references: INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients); EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009; FDA 21 CFR Part 701; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics

attributes.name: is_alternative_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM line represents an alternative or substitute component that can be used in place of the primary component. Alternative items are used when the primary component is unavailable, supporting supply continuity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Alternative Item Group (ALGRU); VMI (Vendor Managed Inventory) Practices

attributes.name: is_critical_component
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is designated as critical to the production of the parent SKU. Critical components trigger priority procurement actions and are subject to enhanced supply chain monitoring and safety stock policies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/PP Module; S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) Best Practices

attributes.name: issue_method
attributes.description: The method by which this component is issued from inventory to the production order. Backflush automatically posts consumption upon order confirmation; manual requires explicit goods issue; pick list generates a picking document; kanban uses replenishment signals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Backflush Indicator (RGEKZ); Siemens Opcenter MES; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this BOM line record was most recently updated. Used for change detection, data synchronization, and audit trail purposes in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Changed On (AEDAT/AEZET); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Audit Requirements; ISO 9001

attributes.name: lead_time_offset_days
