attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: An identifier linking this consumer to a household grouping. Multiple individual shoppers may share the same household_id, enabling household-level purchase analysis, co-habitation segmentation, and family-targeted promotions. Used in Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel household modeling.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel — Household ID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Household Object

attributes.name: acquisition_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the consumer was first acquired or registered. Supports marketing attribution, channel ROI analysis, and consumer journey analytics. Aligns with DTC, POS, and loyalty enrollment touchpoints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dtc_web|dtc_mobile|retail_pos|loyalty_enrollment|social_media|event|referral|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Lead Source; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumer was first acquired or registered in the system (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for cohort analysis, consumer tenure calculations, and lifecycle marketing programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Created Date; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master

attributes.name: age_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has passed age verification for access to age-restricted products (e.g., alcohol, tobacco, certain health products). TRUE = age verified; FALSE = not verified. Required for regulatory compliance with FDA and CPSC age-restriction mandates.
attributes.references: FDA Age Verification Requirements; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; GDPR Article 8 (child consent)

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: The consumer's date of birth in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-dd). Used for age verification (e.g., age-restricted products), lifecycle segmentation, birthday loyalty rewards, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; FDA Age Verification Requirements

attributes.name: ccpa_subject
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer is a California resident subject to CCPA protections. TRUE = CCPA applies; FALSE = not a CCPA subject. Drives opt-out of sale workflows, data deletion requests, and disclosure obligations.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; California Attorney General CCPA Regulations

attributes.name: cltv_segment
attributes.description: The consumer's current CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) segment classification derived from purchase history and predictive modeling. Used for resource allocation in marketing, personalization prioritization, and retention investment decisions. Segment label, not a calculated metric.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Analytics

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when the consumer last provided or updated their privacy consent. Provides the auditable consent record required by GDPR Article 7 and CCPA. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the privacy policy and consent notice that the consumer accepted (e.g., 'v2.3', '2024-01'). Used to track consent currency and trigger re-consent workflows when policy versions are updated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.135; ISO/IEC 29101

attributes.name: consumer_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the shopper record distinguishing individual consumers, household accounts, small business buyers, enrolled loyalty program members, and guest/anonymous shoppers. Drives CRM segmentation and personalization strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Account Type; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Classification

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The consumer's country of residence in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Determines applicable regulatory framework (GDPR for EU, CCPA for California), tax jurisdiction, and localized product availability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this shopper record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform. Serves as the authoritative audit trail for record creation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to sharing their personal data with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, market research firms such as Nielsen IQ). TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented. Critical for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Privacy Guidelines

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred display name or alias used in digital channels, loyalty portals, and personalized marketing communications. May differ from legal name.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: email_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive email marketing communications. TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented or withdrawn. Mandatory suppression flag for GDPR/CCPA compliance in all outbound email campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal family name (surname) as captured at registration or identity verification. Combined with given_name to form the full legal identity for CRM, personalization, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gdpr_subject
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer is a GDPR data subject (i.e., located in the EU/EEA and subject to GDPR protections). TRUE = GDPR applies; FALSE = not a GDPR subject. Drives data processing lawful basis checks, right-to-erasure workflows, and data portability requests.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 & 4; EU REACH Regulation (data subject scope)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported gender identity. Used for consumer segmentation, personalized product recommendations, and inclusive marketing. Collected with explicit consent per GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The consumer's legal given name (first name) as captured at registration or identity verification. Used for personalized communications, CRM, and regulatory subject identification under GDPR/CCPA.

attributes.name: identity_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the consumer's identity was most recently verified (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to assess verification recency and trigger re-verification workflows for high-risk transactions or regulatory audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; NIST SP 800-63; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Identity Verification

attributes.name: identity_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's identity has been formally verified through an identity verification process (e.g., email confirmation, document verification, phone OTP). TRUE = verified; FALSE = unverified. Affects eligibility for high-value loyalty redemptions and DTC account features.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); CCPA Section 1798.130; NIST SP 800-63 Digital Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: last_purchase_date
attributes.description: The date of the consumer's most recent confirmed purchase transaction across any channel (DTC, retail POS, e-commerce). Used for recency scoring in RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, churn prediction, and re-engagement campaign triggers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Last Activity Date; SAP S/4HANA SD — Last Order Date

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the consumer record in the lifecycle. 'active' = engaged consumer; 'inactive' = no activity within defined period; 'opted_out' = consumer has withdrawn consent and must not be contacted; 'suspended' = account temporarily restricted; 'pending_verification' = identity not yet confirmed. Drives GDPR/CCPA suppression logic.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 & 17; CCPA Section 1798.120; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the consumer formally enrolled in the loyalty program (yyyy-MM-dd). Used to calculate loyalty tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based loyalty analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Enrollment Date

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: The current redeemable loyalty points balance held by the consumer. This is the raw operational balance as recorded in the loyalty system — not a calculated aggregate. Used for redemption eligibility checks and consumer-facing balance display.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Points; ISO 4217 (currency-equivalent valuation)

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: The consumer's current tier within the loyalty program (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Determines benefit entitlements, promotional eligibility, and personalized offer thresholds. Recalculated periodically based on purchase activity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Tier; Consumer Goods Industry Loyalty Best Practices

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) for this consumer, on a scale of 0–10. NPS is the industry-standard metric for measuring consumer loyalty and likelihood to recommend. Supports consumer satisfaction analytics and brand health reporting.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent NPS survey response was recorded for this consumer. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and trigger re-survey workflows.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Survey Response Date

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The consumer's residential postal or ZIP code. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution territory assignment, and retail proximity analysis (OSA, planogram relevance).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Address Standards

attributes.name: preferred_currency
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred transaction currency in ISO 4217 three-letter code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Used for DTC pricing display, loyalty point valuation, and cross-border e-commerce personalization.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred communication language in IETF BCP 47 format (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Drives localization of marketing communications, product labels, and digital experience personalization.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; ISO 639-1; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Language Preference

attributes.name: preferred_store_banner
attributes.description: The consumer's self-reported or behaviorally-inferred preferred retail store banner or chain (e.g., 'Walmart', 'Target', 'Kroger'). Used for retail execution targeting, trade promotion personalization, and channel affinity analytics in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: The primary email address used for all consumer communications, loyalty program enrollment, DTC order confirmations, and digital marketing. Serves as the principal digital identity key in CRM and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: The consumer's primary contact phone number in E.164 international format. Used for SMS marketing, two-factor authentication, consumer care, and DTC order notifications.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164

attributes.name: push_notification_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted in to receive push notifications via the brand's mobile application. TRUE = opted in; FALSE = opted out or not set. Drives mobile engagement campaign eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; Apple APNS / Google FCM Consent Guidelines

attributes.name: registration_source_url
attributes.description: The URL or digital touchpoint from which the consumer completed their registration (e.g., brand website landing page, DTC checkout, loyalty sign-up page). Supports digital marketing attribution and campaign source tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Lead Source URL; FTC Digital Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: sms_opt_in
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive SMS/text marketing communications. TRUE = consented; FALSE = not consented or withdrawn. Required for TCPA compliance in the US and equivalent regulations globally.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system from which this consumer record was sourced or first created (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA SD, DTC web platform). Supports data lineage, master data management deduplication, and system-of-record governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_cgc|sap_s4hana|oracle_erp|dtc_web|dtc_mobile|loyalty_platform|pos_system — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Master; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: source_system_consumer_ref
attributes.description: The consumer's unique identifier as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., SAP Business Partner ID, Salesforce Contact ID, DTC platform user ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation, MDM golden record matching, and audit traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Business Partner ID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact ID; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) when this shopper record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

products.name: household
products.description: Household unit grouping multiple shoppers who share a residence and purchasing decisions. Captures household demographics (estimated size, income band, life stage), formation date, status, and primary shopper designation. Enables household-level basket analysis, cross-sell targeting (e.g., recommending baby products when life stage changes), and loyalty program household pooling for CPG/FMCG brands.

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the household record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse. Primary key for all household-level analytics, loyalty pooling, and basket analysis.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.address. Business justification: A household has a physical address (dwelling location) that is the authoritative geographic reference for the household unit. The address table is the SSOT for physical addresses in the consumer domai

attributes.name: merged_from_household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source household record that was merged into this household during deduplication or household consolidation. Null if no merge has occurred. Supports data lineage and audit trails.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: brand_affinity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has demonstrated strong brand loyalty to the company's portfolio based on repeat purchase patterns and SOV (Share of Voice) analysis. Used for brand marketing investment decisions.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has exercised the right to opt out of the sale of personal information under CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act). Mandatory compliance field for California-resident households.

attributes.name: children_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether children under 18 are present in the household. Key trigger for cross-sell targeting of baby, child health, and family-oriented CPG/FMCG product categories.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Life Stage Segmentation; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: cltv_band
attributes.description: Categorical CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) band assigned to the household based on historical purchase behavior and predictive modeling. Used for investment prioritization in trade promotion and personalization.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: consent_last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to any consent or privacy preference for the household. Critical for GDPR/CCPA audit trails and demonstrating lawful basis for data processing.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country of the household's primary residence. Used for regulatory compliance (GDPR, CCPA) and international market segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and GDPR/CCPA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Originating system or channel from which the household record was first created or last enriched. Used for data lineage, quality scoring, and source system reconciliation in the lakehouse. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|loyalty_program|ecommerce|panel|pos|dtc|manual — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; TradeEdge

attributes.name: digital_engagement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household actively engages with the brand through digital channels (e-commerce, mobile app, social media). Used for DTC (Direct to Consumer) channel strategy and omnichannel personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: dissolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was dissolved, merged, or deactivated. Null for active households. Used for lifecycle reporting and GDPR/CCPA data retention compliance.

attributes.name: dwelling_type
attributes.description: Type of residential dwelling occupied by the household. Used for product category targeting (e.g., home care, cleaning products) and basket size normalization in CPG analytics.

attributes.name: estimated_size
attributes.description: Estimated number of individuals residing in the household. Used for basket size normalization, per-capita consumption analysis, and product volume forecasting in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning).
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household record was first established in the system, representing when the household unit was recognized as a distinct entity for loyalty and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has provided valid consent for data processing under GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). Mandatory for EU-resident households before any marketing or analytics processing.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Broad geographic region of the household's residence (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, Southwest). Used for regional demand planning and distribution channel management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand Planning; Nielsen IQ Market Intelligence

attributes.name: household_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the household, used in CRM, loyalty, and DTC channel communications. Distinct from the surrogate primary key.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: household_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the household, typically the primary shopper's surname or a family name used for display in CRM and loyalty program communications.

attributes.name: household_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the household record. 'merged' indicates consolidation with another household; 'dissolved' indicates the household no longer exists as a unit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: household_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the household composition used for segmentation and cross-sell targeting in CPG/FMCG analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|couple|family|multi_generational|shared_living|other — promote to reference product if values expand]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: income_band
attributes.description: Estimated annual household income bracket used for consumer segmentation, RSP (Recommended Selling Price) sensitivity analysis, and premium product targeting. Derived from third-party panel data or self-reported.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Income Segmentation; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the household record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse Silver layer and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: life_stage
attributes.description: Life stage classification of the household used for targeted marketing and NPD (New Product Development) insights (e.g., young_single, young_couple_no_children, family_with_young_children, family_with_teens, empty_nester, retired). Enables cross-sell triggers such as recommending baby products when life stage transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: young_single|young_couple_no_children|family_with_young_children|family_with_teens|empty_nester|retired|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Life Stage Segmentation; SAP IBP Demand Planning Segmentation

attributes.name: loyalty_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate loyalty tenure, tier progression timelines, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) cohort analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion

attributes.name: loyalty_points_balance
attributes.description: Current unredeemed loyalty points balance accumulated at the household level across all member consumers. Supports household-level pooling for CPG/FMCG loyalty programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: loyalty_tier
attributes.description: Current loyalty program tier of the household based on cumulative purchase activity. Drives reward multipliers, exclusive offers, and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Strategic consumer market segment assigned to the household for brand marketing and consumer engagement programs (e.g., health_conscious, value_seeker, premium_buyer, eco_friendly). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: health_conscious|value_seeker|premium_buyer|eco_friendly|convenience_driven|brand_loyal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Segmentation; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: marketing_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has opted in to receive marketing communications (email, SMS, push notifications) from the brand. Governs eligibility for trade promotion and consumer engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) recorded for the household, ranging from 0 to 10. Used to classify households as Promoters (9-10), Passives (7-8), or Detractors (0-6) for consumer engagement programs.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey response was recorded for the household. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data for consumer engagement decisions.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM

attributes.name: panel_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is an active member of a consumer research panel (e.g., Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel). Panel households provide purchase diary data used for market intelligence and SOM (Share of Market) analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; ISO 20252 (Market Research Standards)

attributes.name: pet_owner_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household owns pets. Used for targeted marketing of pet care product categories and cross-sell recommendations within the CPG/FMCG portfolio.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: BCP 47 language tag representing the household's preferred communication language (e.g., en-US, es-MX, fr-FR). Used for localized marketing content, product labeling compliance, and consumer engagement personalization.
attributes.references: BCP 47 Language Tag Standard; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication); FTC Advertising Standards

attributes.name: primary_channel
attributes.description: The dominant channel through which the household makes purchases. Used for DTC (Direct to Consumer) strategy, channel mix analysis, and trade promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: primary_retailer_banner
attributes.description: The retail banner or chain where the household conducts the majority of its grocery or consumer goods shopping (e.g., Walmart, Target, Kroger). Used for OSA (On Shelf Availability) and POG (Planogram) analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement; TradeEdge Secondary Sales

attributes.name: private_label_buyer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household regularly purchases private label or store-brand products in addition to or instead of branded CPG products. Used for competitive analysis and brand switching risk assessment.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: purchase_frequency_band
attributes.description: Categorical band representing how frequently the household makes purchases across CPG/FMCG categories. Derived from POS (Point of Sale) transaction history and used for demand sensing and replenishment planning.
attributes.references: TradeEdge Demand Sensing; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: tenure_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household owns or rents their residence. Used for home improvement and home care product category targeting and consumer segmentation.

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and digital address records associated with a consumer/shopper. Stores address type (billing, shipping, home, work), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, geocoordinates (latitude/longitude), address validation status, address source, effective date, and expiry date. Supports DTC order fulfillment, personalized marketing, and regulatory compliance for GDPR/CCPA data residency requirements.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer address record in the Consumer Goods DTC/B2C platform. Primary key for the consumer_address data product.

attributes.name: address_source
attributes.description: The originating channel or system through which this address was captured. Supports data lineage, source quality scoring, and GDPR/CCPA consent audit trails. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|dtc_checkout|loyalty_enrollment|call_center|mobile_app|web_portal|third_party|manual_entry — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are eligible for order fulfillment and marketing. Inactive addresses are retained for historical reporting. Deleted status supports GDPR right-to-erasure soft-delete workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Status

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address by its business purpose. Billing addresses are used for invoicing and financial compliance; shipping addresses drive DTC order fulfillment and last-mile logistics; home and work addresses support personalized marketing and consumer segmentation.
attributes.references: GS1 Party Address Type Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD Address Category

attributes.name: carrier_route
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code assigned to this address (e.g., C001, R001, B001, H001). Used for direct mail presort discounts, delivery sequence optimization, and postal cost modeling in consumer marketing programs.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Carrier Route Certification; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: U.S. Census Bureau census tract code for the address location. Enables demographic overlay analysis, market penetration reporting by socioeconomic segment, and trade area planning for consumer goods distribution.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau TIGER/Line; Nielsen IQ Market Intelligence - Geographic Segmentation

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the consumer's address. Used for geographic segmentation, regional marketing campaigns, distribution zone assignment, and regulatory data residency tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; UPU S42 Address Standard

attributes.name: consent_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consumer consent was obtained for storing and processing this address record under applicable privacy regulations (GDPR/CCPA). True indicates consent is on file; False requires consent collection before marketing use.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer provided consent for storage and processing of this address record. Required for GDPR Article 7 compliance documentation and CCPA opt-in audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance, international shipping eligibility, tax jurisdiction, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44 (Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; GS1 Country Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was first created in the system. Supports GDPR Article 30 records of processing activities, data lineage tracking, and audit trail requirements for consumer data governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic data residency classification for this address record, indicating the regulatory jurisdiction governing data storage and processing. Drives GDPR (EU), CCPA (US/CA), and other regional privacy law compliance for data localization requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 44-49 (International Data Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.140; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Residency

attributes.name: deliverability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the likelihood that a physical shipment or direct mail piece will be successfully delivered to this address. Derived from address validation provider output. Supports carrier selection and DTC fulfillment risk management.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Deliverability Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area (DMA) code for the address location. Used for media planning, Share of Voice (SOV) analysis, and regional brand marketing investment allocation in consumer goods trade promotion programs.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ DMA Definitions; Nielsen Retail Measurement Service

attributes.name: do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted out of physical direct mail marketing to this address. When True, this address must be suppressed from direct mail campaign execution lists. Supports GDPR right-to-object and CCPA opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC CAN-SPAM Act; DMA (Data & Marketing Association) Guidelines

attributes.name: dpv_confirmation
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Validation confirmation code indicating the deliverability of the address. Y=Confirmed deliverable, S=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info missing), D=Confirmed deliverable (secondary info present but unneeded), N=Not confirmed. Critical for DTC fulfillment and direct mail campaigns.
attributes.references: USPS CASS DPV Certification; USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this address record is considered valid and active for business use. Supports bi-temporal data modeling, address history tracking, and GDPR right-to-erasure compliance by enabling point-in-time address reconstruction.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Null indicates an open-ended active address. Used for address lifecycle management, historical reporting, and GDPR data minimization compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP S/4HANA Address Validity Period

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address format to guide formatting, validation, and carrier routing logic. PO Box addresses may not be eligible for certain DTC carriers; military addresses (APO/FPO/DPO) require specific handling; rural route addresses may have extended delivery windows.
attributes.references: USPS Publication 28 - Postal Addressing Standards; UPU S42 International Address Standard

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates for this address. Rooftop indicates exact parcel-level geocoding; range_interpolated indicates interpolation between street numbers; geometric_center indicates centroid of a polygon. Impacts reliability of proximity-based analytics.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API Accuracy Levels; ISO 19111 Geographic Coordinate Reference Systems

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default billing address for payment processing and invoice generation. Used in DTC checkout flows and financial compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Customer Master Billing Address; PCI DSS Requirement 3

attributes.name: is_default_shipping
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the consumer's default shipping destination for DTC orders. Distinct from is_primary as a consumer may have a primary home address but a different default shipping address (e.g., workplace).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD - Partner Address Determination; Oracle Cloud Order Management

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the consumer's primary address record for the given address type. When True, this address is used as the default for order fulfillment, marketing communications, and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Contact Address Management

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Enables geocoded proximity analysis, delivery zone optimization, and location-based personalized marketing.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including house/building number and street name. Core component of the consumer's physical location used for DTC order fulfillment, direct mail marketing, and GDPR/CCPA data residency compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards; GS1 GLN Address Standard

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, floor, or building designations. Supplements address_line_1 to ensure complete and accurate delivery routing for DTC shipments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; USPS Postal Addressing Standards

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location details such as neighborhood, district, or care-of designations. Used in international address formats where three address lines are required.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 International Postal Address Components

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the consumer's address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Used alongside latitude for geocoded proximity analysis, store locator features, and last-mile delivery optimization.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709 Geographic Point Location

attributes.name: plus4_code
attributes.description: The four-digit USPS ZIP+4 extension code that narrows delivery to a specific block face or building. Enables postal presort discounts for direct mail campaigns and improves delivery precision for DTC shipments within the United States.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP+4 Code Standard; USPS Publication 28; USPS CASS Certification

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or postal code of the consumer's address. Used for last-mile delivery routing, trade area analysis, demographic segmentation, and carrier rate determination in DTC fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; UPU S42; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: residential_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the address as residential or commercial. Impacts carrier surcharge calculations (UPS/FedEx residential delivery fees), marketing segmentation, and DTC fulfillment cost modeling.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Residential Delivery Indicator; UPS/FedEx Residential Surcharge Guidelines

attributes.name: sales_territory_code
attributes.description: Internal sales territory or region code assigned to this address based on geographic boundaries. Used for Sales Force Automation (SFA) territory assignment, trade promotion planning, and regional sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Territory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating operational system of record (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Contact Address ID, SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address GUID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA BP Address GUID; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Address Object; Oracle Cloud ERP Party Site ID

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this address record originated. Supports data lineage, master data management (MDM) conflict resolution, and Silver Layer data quality governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Oracle Cloud ERP; ISO/IEC 27001 Asset Management

attributes.name: standardized_address
attributes.description: The full address formatted as a single standardized string per USPS/UPU postal standards after address validation and normalization (e.g., '123 MAIN ST APT 4B, CHICAGO IL 60601-1234'). Used as the canonical address for carrier label generation and deduplication.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Standardization; UPU S42; GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy)

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the consumer's address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-CA, CA-ON). Supports tax jurisdiction determination, regional compliance, and territory-based sales reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling personalized marketing communications at optimal local times and for regulatory compliance with time-sensitive consumer notifications.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; GDPR Article 12 (Timely Communication)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, data freshness monitoring, and GDPR data accuracy compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO/IEC 27001 Change Management; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: validation_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party address validation service used to verify this address (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate, Google Maps API). Supports audit trails for data quality governance and vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; ISO 9001 Data Quality Management

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the address record as determined by address verification services (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate). Validated addresses reduce failed DTC deliveries and return-to-sender costs. Failed addresses require consumer outreach before order fulfillment.
attributes.references: USPS CASS (Coding Accuracy Support System); GS1 Address Validation Guidelines

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated by the address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is needed based on data freshness policies and to support data quality SLA reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; USPS CASS Certification Requirements

products.name: loyalty_account
products.description: Loyalty program membership account and transaction history for a consumer enrolled in a CPG brand loyalty or rewards program. Captures account master (program name, membership tier, enrollment date, points balance, lifetime points earned/redeemed, tier qualification spend, tier review date, status) and individual points movement events (earn, redeem, adjust, expire — with points amount, triggering event, associated order reference, balance snapshot, processing status, timestamp). Supports CLTV calculation, personalized promotions, consumer retention programs, and points liability reporting required by finance.

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the loyalty program account record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: product_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_brand. Business justification: In CPG, loyalty programs are frequently brand-specific (e.g., Pampers Club, Oral-B Genius program). loyalty_account has no product domain link. This FK enables brand-level loyalty KPI reporting (enrol

attributes.name: referral_account_id
attributes.description: Loyalty account ID of the existing member who referred this consumer to the program. Used for referral reward attribution, viral growth tracking, and network-effect analysis in consumer retention programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty referral program standards

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer's preferred or most frequently visited retail store location. Used for store-level loyalty analytics, On Shelf Availability (OSA) correlation, and localized promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Retail Execution; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who owns this loyalty account. Links to the consumer master record in the Consumer domain.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable membership number assigned to the consumer at enrollment. Printed on loyalty cards, referenced in consumer communications, and used for in-store identification. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loyalty account. 'active' = fully operational; 'suspended' = temporarily restricted (e.g., fraud review); 'closed' = permanently deactivated; 'pending' = enrollment not yet confirmed; 'frozen' = points locked pending investigation. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure)

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the loyalty account indicating whether it belongs to an individual consumer, a household unit, a small business buyer, or a coalition partner program. Drives eligibility rules and benefit structures.

attributes.name: cltv_segment
attributes.description: Consumer's current Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) segment classification derived from purchase history, points activity, and predictive modeling. Used for personalized promotion targeting, retention investment prioritization, and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO). Not a calculated metric — this is a segment label assigned by the analytics/ML pipeline.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM; SAP IBP Demand Planning; CPG CLTV analytics

attributes.name: communication_preference
attributes.description: Consumer's preferred channel for receiving loyalty program communications (e.g., points balance updates, tier change notifications, promotional offers). Drives outbound communication channel selection in CRM and marketing automation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM

attributes.name: consent_data_sharing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to sharing their loyalty data with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, coalition program members). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance. True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 28 (Data Processor); CCPA Section 1798.115

attributes.name: consent_marketing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit opt-in consent to receive marketing communications related to the loyalty program. Required for GDPR Article 6 lawful basis and CCPA compliance. True = consented; False = not consented.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which the consumer's most recent consent preferences were captured or last updated. Required for GDPR audit trail demonstrating when consent was obtained. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country in which the loyalty account is registered. Determines applicable regulatory framework (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), program rules, and currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this loyalty account record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the consumer enrolled in the loyalty program (e.g., web, mobile app, in-store, call center, partner, Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) platform). Used for channel attribution and acquisition cost analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Retail Execution; DTC channel standards

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer formally enrolled in the loyalty program. Used to calculate membership tenure, anniversary rewards, and cohort-based retention analytics. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GDPR Article 7 (consent records)

attributes.name: enrollment_source_code
attributes.description: Campaign or promotion source code associated with the consumer's enrollment event (e.g., a Trade Promotion Management (TPM) campaign code, QR code identifier, or referral code). Used for acquisition attribution and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP IBP

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loyalty account is scheduled to expire or become inactive if no qualifying activity occurs. Nullable for open-ended programs. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for points liability forecasting and consumer re-engagement campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Advertising and Labeling guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loyalty account has been flagged for suspected fraudulent activity (e.g., points manipulation, account takeover, synthetic identity). True = flagged for review; False = no fraud concern. Triggers account suspension workflow.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling; CPSC; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: fraud_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent fraud review was conducted or scheduled for this account. Nullable if no fraud review has occurred. Used by the fraud operations team to track investigation timelines.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the consumer's preferred language for loyalty program communications (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es-MX'). Supports multilingual global loyalty programs.

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent qualifying activity (purchase, redemption, or engagement event) on this loyalty account. Used to determine account dormancy, trigger re-engagement campaigns, and apply activity-based points expiry policies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG consumer retention analytics

attributes.name: last_earn_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points earn event on this account. Used to assess earn recency for RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation and to trigger earn-reminder communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG CLTV analytics

attributes.name: last_redemption_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent points redemption event on this account. Used to assess redemption engagement, identify high-value redeemers, and support personalized redemption offer targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG consumer engagement analytics

attributes.name: lifetime_points_earned
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points ever earned on this account since enrollment, including base earn, bonus earn, and promotional earn events. Never decremented by redemptions or expirations. Used for Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) calculation and tier qualification history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG CLTV analytics standards

attributes.name: lifetime_points_expired
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points that have expired on this account due to inactivity or program rules. Used for points liability release reporting in finance and consumer re-engagement analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: lifetime_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all points ever redeemed on this account since enrollment. Used for redemption rate analysis, points liability reconciliation, and CLTV modeling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: membership_tier
attributes.description: Current loyalty tier of the account reflecting the consumer's engagement and spend level (e.g., Standard, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Elite). Determines benefit multipliers, exclusive offers, and service levels. Reviewed periodically against tier_qualification_spend.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion; CPG industry loyalty best practices

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response from this consumer (0–10 scale). Used to segment consumers into Promoters (9–10), Passives (7–8), and Detractors (0–6) for loyalty program health monitoring and consumer engagement strategy.
attributes.references: NPS methodology (Bain & Company); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – CRM

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was captured for this consumer. Used to assess NPS data freshness and schedule next survey cadence.
attributes.references: NPS methodology; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date on which the consumer formally opted out of the loyalty program or withdrew consent for data processing. Nullable if the consumer has not opted out. Required for GDPR right-to-erasure and CCPA opt-out compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: points_balance
attributes.description: Current redeemable points balance on the loyalty account as of the last transaction processing. Represents the net of all earned, redeemed, adjusted, and expired points. Used for consumer-facing balance display and finance points liability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI (Financial Accounting); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: points_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the monetary currency in which tier_qualification_spend and redemption values are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency global loyalty programs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: points_expiry_policy
attributes.description: Policy governing when unredeemed points on this account expire. Options include rolling 12-month inactivity, annual calendar expiry, never-expire, program-end expiry, or activity-based reset. Drives points liability forecasting and consumer communication triggers.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: preferred_redemption_type
attributes.description: Consumer's stated or inferred preferred method of redeeming loyalty points. Used for personalized redemption offer targeting and program design optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discount|free_product|gift_card|charity|cashback|experience|travel|merchandise — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion; CPG personalization best practices

attributes.name: previous_tier
attributes.description: The membership tier held by the consumer immediately before the most recent tier change. Used for tier transition analysis, win-back campaigns, and understanding tier migration patterns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty analytics

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this loyalty account record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud (SFCGC), SAP S/4HANA). Used for data lineage tracking and Silver Layer reconciliation in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer data lineage standards; SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: tier_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current membership tier became effective. Used to calculate tier tenure, assess tier stability, and trigger tier-anniversary benefits.

attributes.name: tier_qualification_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative qualifying purchase spend (in program currency) accumulated within the current tier review period. Compared against tier thresholds to determine tier upgrade, maintenance, or downgrade at the next tier review date.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud – Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: tier_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the consumer's membership tier will be evaluated against tier_qualification_spend thresholds for potential upgrade, maintenance, or downgrade. Drives proactive consumer engagement campaigns before review.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CPG loyalty program management best practices

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp at which this loyalty account record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX; ISO 9001; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer CDC standards

products.name: loyalty_transaction
products.description: Individual points movement event within a loyalty account — earn, redeem, adjust, or expire. Records points amount, triggering event (purchase, referral, review, birthday bonus, promotion), associated order reference, balance snapshot (before/after), processing status, and transaction timestamp. Provides the complete audit trail for loyalty currency reconciliation and supports points liability reporting required by finance.

attributes.name: loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each loyalty points movement event. Serves as the primary key for the loyalty_transaction data product and enables precise audit trail reconciliation of all points currency activity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Loyalty points liability is a financial obligation recorded per legal entity (company code) for IFRS/GAAP balance sheet disclosure. Consumer goods multinationals must attribute points liability to the

attributes.name: consumer_offer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.consumer_offer. Business justification: Offer-triggered loyalty earn/redemption: consumer offers frequently include bonus loyalty point mechanics (e.g., '2x points with this offer'). Linking loyalty_transaction to consumer_offer enables off

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Loyalty program costs (points liability accruals, bonus awards) are allocated to cost centers for marketing spend reporting and brand controller budgets. loyalty_transaction already has gl_account_id

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Trade Promotion Management (TPM) promotion or loyalty campaign that triggered a bonus points award. Null when the transaction is not promotion-driven.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP IBP Demand Planning

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for accounting loyalty point expense; loyalty_transaction must post expense to a GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program account against which this points movement is recorded. Links the transaction to the member's running balance and tier status.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Management Module

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or DTC purchase that triggered an earn or redemption event. Null for non-purchase-triggered transactions such as birthday bonuses, referral awards, or manual adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order; GS1 Order Management Standards

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Loyalty transactions are attributed to profit centers for brand/channel P&L reporting. Consumer goods companies track loyalty program ROI and points liability by profit center for brand contribution m

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.retail_store. Business justification: In-store loyalty earn transactions must be attributed to the specific retail store for store-level loyalty program analytics, retail execution reporting, and trade partner reconciliation. loyalty_tran

attributes.name: reversal_reference_loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal-type transactions, the loyalty_transaction_id of the original transaction being reversed. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal entries for points reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Reversal Management

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who owns the loyalty account. Supports GDPR/CCPA data subject requests and consumer-level analytics across the CRM platform.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Profile

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) purchased or redeemed in this transaction. Populated for purchase-triggered earn events and product-reward redemptions. Enables product-level loyalty attribution and NPD performance analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master

attributes.name: adjustment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative entered by a customer service agent or system process explaining the rationale for a manual points adjustment or reversal. Supports audit review and consumer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Case Management

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for manual point adjustments or reversals (e.g., GOODWILL, DATA_CORRECTION, FRAUD_REVERSAL, SYSTEM_ERROR, PROMOTION_CORRECTION). Populated only for adjust and reversal transaction types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GOODWILL|DATA_CORRECTION|FRAUD_REVERSAL|SYSTEM_ERROR|PROMOTION_CORRECTION|COMPLAINT_RESOLUTION — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Adjustment Codes; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: bonus_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base earn rate for bonus transactions (e.g., 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus). Null for non-bonus transactions. Used to decompose total points awarded into base and bonus components for TPM ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Earn Rate; Trade Promotion Management (TPM) ROI

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The consumer engagement channel through which the triggering event occurred: ecommerce (third-party online), mobile_app (brand app), retail_store (physical POS), dtc_website (Direct-to-Consumer website), call_centre (agent-assisted), or kiosk (in-store self-service). Supports omnichannel loyalty analytics and channel attribution reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Channel Management; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's active consent for loyalty program participation and data processing was verified at the time of this transaction. Supports GDPR Article 7 and CCPA consent audit requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CCPA Section 1798.120; ISO 27001 Data Privacy

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which this loyalty transaction occurred (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-market loyalty program reporting, regulatory compliance (GDPR for EU markets), and geographic performance analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; GDPR Article 3 — Territorial Scope; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was first created in the source system. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp for data lineage, reconciliation, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary_value field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency loyalty programs operating across international markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: data_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction record is subject to a data retention hold, preventing deletion or anonymization beyond the standard retention period. Set to True for records under legal hold, active fraud investigation, or regulatory audit. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.105; SOX Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: earn_rate
attributes.description: The points-per-currency-unit rate applied to calculate the points_amount for earn transactions (e.g., 1.5 points per USD spent). Captures the rate in effect at the time of the transaction for historical accuracy and program performance analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Earn Rate Configuration

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has been flagged by the fraud detection system as potentially fraudulent or suspicious. Flagged transactions are held for review before points are posted. Supports loyalty program integrity and financial controls.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines; SOX Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Fraud Management

attributes.name: fraud_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the fraud review process for transactions flagged by the fraud detection system: not_reviewed (default), under_review (investigation in progress), cleared (confirmed legitimate), or confirmed_fraud (fraudulent transaction confirmed and reversed).
attributes.references: FTC Guidelines; SOX Section 404 — Internal Controls; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Fraud Case Management

attributes.name: is_bonus_transaction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earn transaction includes a bonus points multiplier applied on top of the base earn rate (e.g., double-points promotion, birthday bonus, new member bonus). Enables separation of base earn from promotional bonus in program cost analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Bonus Configuration; Trade Promotion Management (TPM)

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The monetary equivalent value of the points moved in this transaction, expressed in the program's base currency. Used for points liability valuation on the balance sheet and for calculating the cost of loyalty rewards in COGS reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Financial Reporting; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: The absolute number of loyalty points moved in this transaction. Always stored as a positive value regardless of direction; the transaction_type field determines whether points are added or subtracted from the account balance. Supports fractional points for precision in tiered earn-rate calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Points Engine; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately after this transaction was applied. Together with points_balance_before, provides the complete before/after audit trail for each points movement event.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Balance Snapshot

attributes.name: points_balance_before
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately before this transaction was applied. Critical for audit trail completeness and points liability reconciliation required by finance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Balance Snapshot

attributes.name: points_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the points_amount increases (credit) or decreases (debit) the loyalty account balance. Enables double-entry-style reconciliation of the points ledger for finance liability reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Financial Ledger Integrity; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Ledger

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the points awarded in this earn transaction are scheduled to expire per the loyalty program's currency expiration policy. Null for non-earn transactions. Drives the points liability aging schedule reported to finance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Expiration Policy; SOX Points Liability Reporting

attributes.name: points_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction contributes to the outstanding points liability on the company's balance sheet (True for unspent earned points, False for redeemed or expired points). Supports finance's points liability reserve calculation under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 — Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials — Deferred Revenue

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the loyalty transaction was processed and posted to the account balance by the loyalty engine. May differ from transaction_timestamp due to batch processing windows or pending verification holds.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Processing Engine; SOX Audit Trail

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year of the loyalty program in which this transaction occurred. Used for annual points balance resets, year-over-year program performance reporting, and points expiration policy enforcement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Program Year Configuration; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials — Fiscal Calendar

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: The net purchase amount (after discounts, excluding taxes) on the triggering order that qualified for points earning. Used to verify earn rate calculations and supports COGS and loyalty cost-per-transaction reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Net Order Value; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: redemption_value
attributes.description: The monetary discount or reward value applied to the consumer's order when points are redeemed. Populated only for redeem-type transactions. Used to calculate the effective discount rate and redemption liability release in financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; Oracle Cloud ERP Financials; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Redemption

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this loyalty transaction event (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, POS system). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across the enterprise data lakehouse.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — Data Lineage; SOX Data Provenance

attributes.name: source_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce record ID, SAP document number, POS receipt number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Transaction Reference; SAP S/4HANA SD Document Number

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the loyalty transaction, formatted as LT-{YYYY}-{sequence}. Used in consumer-facing communications, call-centre lookups, and points dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Transaction Reference; GS1 Identification Standards

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the loyalty transaction reflecting its processing lifecycle: pending (awaiting confirmation), processed (successfully posted to account), reversed (cancelled after posting), failed (processing error), or cancelled (voided before posting).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Transaction Lifecycle; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the loyalty points movement event occurred in the real world — i.e., when the triggering business event (purchase, referral, etc.) was confirmed and points were posted. This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Event Timestamp; ISO 8601 Date/Time Standard

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the nature of the points movement: earn (points awarded), redeem (points consumed), adjust (manual correction), expire (points lapsed per program rules), transfer (inter-account movement), or reversal (cancellation of a prior transaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|adjust|expire|transfer|reversal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Management; ISO 8583 Financial Transaction Message Standard

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The specific business event that initiated this points movement, such as purchase, referral, product_review, birthday_bonus, promotion_bonus, account_registration, social_share, or survey_completion. Drives attribution analysis and program ROI reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|referral|product_review|birthday_bonus|promotion_bonus|account_registration|social_share|survey_completion — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Loyalty Event Configuration; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, status changes, and manual adjustments for audit and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

products.name: segment
products.description: Consumer segmentation classification and membership records used for targeting, personalization, and marketing activation.
