Stores segment definition (name, code, model version, type — behavioral/demographic/psychographic/RFM/CLTV-based, description, effective date range, owning brand/BU) and individual membership assignments (shopper reference, assignment date, expiry date, assignment method — rule-based/ML/manual, confidence score, segment version). Enables time-variant segment membership tracking, CRM-driven personalization, and trade promotion targeting across CPG brands.
products.reference: Consumer Segment / CRM Segment (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud)

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer segment definition record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the primary key for all segment definition and membership records.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: CPG segments are defined around product category taxonomy (e.g., 'Premium Skincare Buyers'). Segment targeting, category-level audience sizing, and trade promotion eligibility reports all require link

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Report: Segment Ownership Report requires linking each consumer segment to its owning brand for brand‑level performance analysis.

attributes.name: parent_segment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent segment when this segment is a sub-segment or child in a hierarchical segmentation structure (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists' as a child of 'Loyalty Program Members'). Null for top-level segments.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Hierarchy

attributes.name: activation_channel
attributes.description: The primary marketing activation channel for which this segment is designed (e.g., email campaigns, SMS, push notifications, paid media audiences, in-store promotions). Drives channel-specific audience export configurations in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and CRM platforms.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Campaign Management; FTC - CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: For demographic segments, the maximum consumer age (in years) defining the upper bound for segment inclusion. Used alongside age_range_min to define age-banded demographic segments (e.g., Millennials: 28–43).
attributes.references: FTC - COPPA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Demographic Segmentation

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: For demographic segments, the minimum consumer age (in years) required for segment inclusion. Used in age-gated product targeting (e.g., health supplements, alcohol-adjacent personal care) and regulatory compliance with COPPA for under-13 restrictions.
attributes.references: FTC - COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method by which consumers are assigned to this segment. 'rule_based' uses deterministic business rules (e.g., purchase frequency thresholds); 'ml_model' uses a trained machine learning classifier; 'manual' indicates analyst-driven assignment; 'hybrid' combines rule-based and ML approaches.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Audience Builder; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: The distribution or engagement channel(s) for which this segment is applicable. 'dtc' (Direct to Consumer) segments target consumers via owned digital channels; 'retail' targets in-store shoppers; 'ecommerce' targets online platform shoppers; 'omnichannel' applies across all channels.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Channel Management; TradeEdge - Channel Visibility

attributes.name: cltv_max_value
attributes.description: For CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based segments, the maximum predicted CLTV value defining the upper bound of this segment tier. Used to create banded CLTV segments (e.g., mid-value tier: CLTV between $500 and $2000). Null if no upper bound applies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: cltv_min_value
attributes.description: For CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based segments, the minimum predicted CLTV score or monetary value required for a consumer to qualify for segment membership. Enables tiered loyalty and high-value consumer targeting strategies. Null for non-CLTV segment types.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 or CCPA for processing consumer data within this segment. 'consent' requires explicit opt-in; 'legitimate_interest' applies where the business has a justified interest; 'contract' applies for contractual necessity; 'not_required' for non-personal aggregate segments.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consumer consent is required before a consumer can be assigned to or activated within this segment. True for segments used in direct marketing, personalization, or profiling activities subject to GDPR Article 6 or CCPA opt-in requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 - Lawfulness of Processing; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment definition record was first created in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security Management; SOX Section 404 - Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary thresholds defined in this segment (e.g., rfm_monetary_min, cltv_min_value). Ensures consistent monetary comparisons across geographies and DTC channels.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this segment definition expires and is no longer eligible for active targeting. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Used for time-variant segment membership tracking and historical analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Formats; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this segment definition becomes valid and eligible for use in CRM targeting, personalization, and trade promotion activation. Supports time-variant segment tracking and bi-temporal data modeling in the silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 - Date and Time Formats; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code(s) or region identifiers defining the geographic boundary of this segment (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Supports multi-country CPG brand activation and ensures GDPR/CCPA-compliant targeting within applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 - Country Codes; GDPR Article 3; CCPA

attributes.name: is_suppression_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is a suppression list used to exclude consumers from campaigns (e.g., opted-out consumers, recent purchasers, regulatory exclusions). True means consumers in this segment are excluded from targeted marketing activations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21 - Right to Object; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC - CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the segment membership was last recalculated and updated. Used to assess data freshness for CRM targeting and to trigger refresh workflows when the segment is stale relative to its defined refresh frequency.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP IBP - Demand Planning

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_scope
attributes.description: The loyalty program tier(s) targeted by this segment. Enables differentiated engagement strategies for loyalty program members (e.g., exclusive offers for Platinum tier, win-back campaigns for Bronze tier). 'all' indicates the segment applies across all loyalty tiers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Loyalty Management; TradeEdge - Channel Visibility

attributes.name: min_confidence_score
attributes.description: The minimum ML model confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) required for a consumer to be assigned to this segment when using ML-based assignment. Consumers with scores below this threshold are excluded. Null for rule-based or manual segments.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - AI Segmentation; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: ml_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the machine learning model used to generate or score this segment, when assignment_method is 'ml_model' or 'hybrid'. Enables traceability to the model registry for audit, retraining, and explainability purposes. Null for rule_based or manual segments.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - AI Segmentation; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel Analytics

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the segmentation model or rule set that produced this segment definition (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Enables traceability of segment membership changes across model iterations and supports A/B testing of segmentation approaches.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP IBP - Demand Planning Model Versioning

attributes.name: nps_score_max
attributes.description: For NPS (Net Promoter Score)-based segments, the maximum NPS score (0–10 scale) defining the upper bound for segment inclusion. Used in conjunction with nps_score_min to define NPS-banded segments (e.g., detractors: 0–6).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - NPS Segmentation; FTC - Consumer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: nps_score_min
attributes.description: For NPS (Net Promoter Score)-based segments, the minimum NPS score (0–10 scale) required for segment inclusion. Enables targeting of promoters (9–10), passives (7–8), or detractors (0–6) for tailored consumer engagement programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - NPS Segmentation; FTC - Consumer Engagement Standards

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit (BU) within Consumer Goods responsible for this segment's definition, governance, and activation (e.g., 'Personal Care', 'Home Care', 'Health & Wellness'). Used for segment ownership reporting and cross-BU deduplication governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Controlling; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: personalization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether consumers in this segment are eligible for personalized content, product recommendations, or pricing in DTC (Direct to Consumer) and e-commerce channels. Requires valid consent_basis when consent_required is True.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Personalization Engine; GDPR Article 22 - Automated Decision-Making

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used to resolve conflicts when a consumer qualifies for multiple overlapping segments. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by CRM and personalization engines to determine which segment's rules take precedence for offer assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Conflict Resolution

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the segment membership is recalculated and updated. Determines the cadence at which consumer assignments are re-evaluated against the segment's rules or ML model. Impacts CRM campaign freshness and personalization accuracy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Refresh Scheduling

attributes.name: rfm_frequency_min
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the minimum number of purchase transactions required within the recency window for a consumer to qualify for the frequency criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - RFM Segmentation

attributes.name: rfm_monetary_min
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the minimum cumulative spend amount (in the segment's currency) required within the recency window for a consumer to qualify for the monetary criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - RFM Segmentation

attributes.name: rfm_recency_days
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the number of days used to define the recency window (e.g., last 90 days). Consumers with a purchase within this window qualify for the recency criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - RFM Segmentation

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the segment, used in CRM campaign targeting, trade promotion management (TPM) systems, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud audience configurations. Unique per segment version.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Management

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment's defining characteristics, inclusion criteria, and intended business use (e.g., targeting strategy, personalization approach, or trade promotion eligibility). Authored by the owning brand or business unit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Management

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the consumer segment (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists', 'Lapsed Shoppers', 'Health-Conscious Millennials'). Used in marketing activation, CRM dashboards, and trade promotion targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Management

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment definition. 'active' segments are available for CRM targeting and trade promotion activation; 'draft' segments are under construction; 'archived' segments are retained for historical analysis but no longer used in campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation methodology applied to define this segment. Behavioral segments are based on purchase patterns; demographic on age/gender/income; psychographic on lifestyle/values; RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) on transactional scoring; CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based on predicted long-term value; geographic on location.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel Segmentation Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_segment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this segment in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud segment ID, Nielsen IQ panel group code). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; TradeEdge

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this segment definition originated (e.g., 'salesforce_cgc' for Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, 'nielsen_iq' for Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel, 'tradeedge' for TradeEdge). Supports data lineage and master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ; TradeEdge

attributes.name: target_audience_size
attributes.description: The estimated or actual count of unique consumers assigned to this segment at the time of last refresh. Used for campaign planning, media budget allocation, and share of voice (SOV) estimation. Not a real-time count — reflects the last segment refresh cycle.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Audience Builder

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer segment is eligible for trade promotion targeting within the Trade Promotion Management (TPM) system. True enables the segment to be used in TPM/TPO campaign audience configurations in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management (TPM); SAP IBP - S&OP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment definition record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail compliance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 27001 - Information Security Management; SOX Section 404 - Audit Trail

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Integer version number of this segment definition record, incremented each time the segment's criteria, model, or metadata is materially updated. Supports bi-temporal tracking and enables comparison of segment membership across definition versions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Segment Versioning; ISO/IEC 11179

products.name: segment_membership
products.description: Association record linking an individual shopper/consumer to one or more consumer segments at a point in time. Captures shopper reference, segment reference, assignment date, expiry date, assignment method (rule-based, ML model, manual), confidence score, and segment version. Enables time-variant segment membership tracking for personalization and campaign targeting.

attributes.name: segment_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each segment membership association record in the consumer domain. Primary key for the segment_membership data product.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing campaign or trade promotion for which this segment membership was created or activated. Links segment membership to specific campaign execution context.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion; TradeEdge

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the consent record that authorizes the use of this consumer's data for segment assignment and targeting. Provides an auditable link to the consent management system for GDPR and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Marketing segment campaigns are budgeted to cost centers; linking enables expense tracking per segment.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer segment definition to which this consumer is assigned. Identifies the target segment for personalization, campaign targeting, and analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual shopper, household, or loyalty program member who is assigned to this segment. Links to the consumer master record in the SSOT consumer profile.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: activation_count
attributes.description: The number of times this segment membership has been activated or used in campaign targeting or personalization executions. Supports frequency capping and engagement fatigue management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion; TradeEdge

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consumer was assigned or enrolled into this segment. Marks the start of the membership period for time-variant tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the consumer was assigned to this segment. Rule-based uses deterministic business logic; ml_model uses a trained machine learning classifier; manual indicates analyst-driven override; propensity_score uses a scored threshold; lookalike uses similarity modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: brand_affinity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific brand or brand portfolio for which this segment membership is relevant. Enables brand-level personalization and targeted engagement within a multi-brand consumer goods portfolio.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Retail Measurement

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The commerce or engagement channel context in which this segment membership is applicable. Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), e-commerce, retail, wholesale, loyalty program, or social commerce. Supports channel-specific personalization and campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution; TradeEdge - Channel Visibility

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: The Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) tier of the consumer at the time of segment assignment. Captures the consumer's value classification to support premium targeting and differentiated engagement strategies.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: A numeric probability or confidence value (0.0000 to 1.0000) indicating the certainty of the segment assignment, particularly relevant for ML model and propensity-score assignment methods. Higher values indicate stronger segment fit.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status of the consumer for use of their data in this segment assignment and associated targeting activities. Granted indicates valid consent; withdrawn indicates consent has been revoked and the membership should not be used for targeting. Mandatory for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment membership record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR data retention management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); SOX Section 302; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: data_processing_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under which the consumer's personal data is processed for this segment assignment. Required for GDPR Article 6 compliance documentation. Consent indicates explicit opt-in; legitimate_interest indicates business interest basis; contract indicates processing necessary for contract performance.

attributes.name: effective_from_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time from which this segment membership record is considered effective. Supports bi-temporal data modeling and time-variant segment tracking at sub-day precision for real-time personalization.

attributes.name: effective_until_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time until which this segment membership record is considered effective. Null indicates the record is currently active with no defined end. Supports bi-temporal data modeling and SCD Type 2 history tracking.

attributes.name: evaluation_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which this segment membership is re-evaluated and potentially updated. Real-time indicates event-driven evaluation; daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly indicate batch evaluation schedules.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this segment membership expires or becomes invalid. Null indicates an open-ended membership with no defined expiry. Supports time-variant segment tracking for campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic scope for which this segment membership is applicable. Supports region-specific campaign targeting and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR for EU consumers).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); GS1

attributes.name: is_control_group
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the consumer is assigned to a holdout or control group within this segment for A/B testing or campaign measurement purposes. True indicates the consumer is in the control group and should not receive targeted communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC - Advertising and Labeling

attributes.name: is_primary_segment
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this segment is the primary or dominant segment for the consumer when multiple segment memberships exist simultaneously. True indicates this is the primary segment used for default personalization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: last_activation_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which this segment membership was used to activate a campaign, promotion, or personalization event. Supports recency analysis and frequency capping in campaign management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion

attributes.name: last_evaluated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the segment membership was last re-evaluated by the segmentation engine or rule processor. Indicates freshness of the assignment and supports refresh scheduling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment membership record. Active indicates the consumer is currently a member of the segment; expired indicates the membership period has lapsed; suspended indicates temporary hold.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: ml_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the ML model instance used to generate this segment assignment when assignment_method is ml_model or propensity_score. Enables model lineage tracking and reproducibility audits.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: nps_score_at_assignment
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score (NPS) of the consumer at the time of segment assignment. Captured as a point-in-time snapshot to contextualize the segmentation decision and support consumer satisfaction analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has exercised their right to opt out of data-driven segmentation and targeted marketing under CCPA or GDPR. True means the consumer has opted out and this membership must not be used for targeting.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120 (Right to Opt-Out); GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object)

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business justification for a manual segment assignment or override. Populated when assignment_method is manual. Required for audit compliance and governance review.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: personalization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer is eligible to receive personalized content, offers, or recommendations based on this segment membership. Combines consent, suppression, and opt-out status into a single actionable flag for downstream personalization engines.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 22 (Automated Decision-Making)

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: The product category code for which this segment membership is specifically applicable. Enables category-level targeting (e.g., personal care, household, health) within broader consumer segmentation strategies.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); Nielsen IQ - Retail Measurement

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for periodic review or re-evaluation of this segment membership. Supports governance processes ensuring segment assignments remain accurate and consent remains valid.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation); Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: rule_set_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the business rule set applied when assignment_method is rule_based. Enables traceability of which rule definition produced the membership assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: segment_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank for this segment membership when a consumer belongs to multiple overlapping segments. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used to resolve conflicts in personalization and campaign targeting logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: segment_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the segment definition that was active at the time of assignment. Enables tracking of membership against evolving segment criteria and supports reproducibility of historical targeting decisions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: source_record_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this segment membership record in the originating source system. Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this segment membership record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across the enterprise data ecosystem.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ; TradeEdge

attributes.name: suppression_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer should be suppressed from communications or activations associated with this segment, despite being a member. True means the consumer is suppressed. Used for do-not-contact lists, regulatory holds, or competitive exclusions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC - Advertising and Labeling

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason code explaining why the consumer is suppressed from segment activations. Populated only when suppression_flag is True. Supports compliance audit trails for GDPR and CCPA suppression requests.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 21; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment membership record was last modified. Supports change tracking, incremental data processing, and audit trail requirements.

products.name: preference
products.description: Unified consumer preference profile capturing product, brand, channel, and communication preferences. Stores preference category (product category, brand, flavor, fragrance, pack size, channel, communication channel, contact frequency, preferred time of day, preferred language), preference value, opt-in/opt-out status, preference source (declared via web/app/call-center vs. inferred by ML model), confidence level, effective date, brand-level overrides, and last updated timestamp. Drives personalization engines, recommendation systems, communication orchestration, and targeted consumer engagement programs for CPG brands. This is the SSOT for all consumer preference data — both product/brand preferences and communication/contact preferences.

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer preference record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for the preference data product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.category. Business justification: Consumer preference records in CPG capture product category preferences (e.g., 'prefers hair care over skin care') used in personalization, segment assignment, and category-level marketing. preference

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal consent record that authorizes the collection and use of this preference. Links to the consent management system to ensure every preference is backed by a valid, auditable consent event as required by GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consent Management

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Reference to the household entity this consumer belongs to, enabling household-level preference aggregation for CPG targeting and personalization programs.
attributes.references: Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel — Household Identifier

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CPG brand for which this preference applies. Enables brand-level preference overrides and brand-specific personalization within a multi-brand portfolio.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who owns this preference record. Links to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Profile Object

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: CPG personalization and recommendation engines track shopper preferences at SKU level (specific variant, scent, pack size). preference.sku_preference is a plain denormalized field. Adding sku_id FK en

attributes.name: brand_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record has been overridden at the brand level, superseding the consumer's global preference. When True, the brand_id field identifies which brand applied the override. Enables brand-specific preference management within a multi-brand CPG portfolio.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Brand Preference Management

attributes.name: brand_override_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for the brand-level preference override when brand_override_flag is True. Used for audit trails and compliance reporting, particularly for regulatory restrictions (e.g., FDA, CPSC product safety communications).
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Compliance; CPSC Consumer Safety Notifications

attributes.name: cltv_tier
attributes.description: The consumer's CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) tier at the time this preference was recorded. Enables preference prioritization and investment decisions — high-CLTV consumers may receive more personalized preference-driven experiences and premium engagement programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — CLTV Segmentation; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Numeric confidence level (0.0000 to 1.0000) assigned to this preference record, particularly relevant for ML-inferred preferences. A score of 1.0 indicates absolute certainty (typically for declared preferences); lower scores indicate inferred preferences with varying degrees of model confidence. Used by recommendation systems to weight preference signals.
attributes.references: CPG AI/ML Personalization Standards; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel Analytics

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The GDPR lawful basis under which this preference data is collected and processed. 'explicit_consent' is the most common basis for CPG consumer preference programs. Required for GDPR Article 6 compliance documentation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when this preference record was first captured in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp and is used for GDPR consent audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_subject_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record is subject to an active Data Subject Request (DSR) under GDPR or CCPA (e.g., right to erasure, right to access, right to portability). When True, downstream systems must apply appropriate data handling restrictions.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this preference record becomes valid and actionable for personalization, communication orchestration, and recommendation systems. Aligns with GDPR consent effective date requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consent Management

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this preference record is no longer valid. Nullable for open-ended preferences. Used to enforce time-bound consent periods and seasonal preference windows. When expired, preference_status transitions to 'expired'.

attributes.name: flavor_fragrance_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred flavor (for food/beverage/oral care) or fragrance (for personal care/household products). Drives variant-level recommendations and new product development (NPD) consumer insights. Aligns with INCI nomenclature for fragrance ingredients.
attributes.references: INCI — International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients; IFRA Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the geographic jurisdiction in which this preference is valid. Enables country-specific preference management for global CPG brands operating under different regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR in EU, CCPA in USA).

attributes.name: inference_basis
attributes.description: The data signal or behavioral evidence used to infer this preference when preference_source is ML-inferred. Provides transparency into the inference methodology for model explainability and GDPR Article 22 automated decision-making compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22 — Automated Decision-Making; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: inference_model_version
attributes.description: The version identifier of the ML model used to infer this preference when preference_source is 'inferred_ml' or 'inferred_purchase_history'. Enables model governance, A/B testing of recommendation algorithms, and reproducibility of inferred preferences for audit purposes.
attributes.references: CPG AI/ML Model Governance Standards; ISO 9001 — Quality Management

attributes.name: is_global_preference
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference applies globally across all brands in the CPG portfolio (True) or is specific to a single brand identified by brand_id (False). Global preferences serve as the default when no brand-specific preference exists.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Multi-Brand Preference Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to this preference record, whether from a consumer-declared change, a system re-inference, or an administrative override. Critical for freshness scoring in personalization engines and GDPR audit trails.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or qualifications about this preference record, such as special instructions captured during a call-center interaction or notes from a consumer survey. Used by CRM agents and consumer engagement teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Notes

attributes.name: nps_segment
attributes.description: The consumer's NPS (Net Promoter Score) segment classification at the time this preference was captured. Used to contextualize preference data — promoters may have stronger brand preferences while detractors may have channel avoidance preferences. Supports consumer engagement strategy.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology — Bain & Company; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Insights

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has opted in (True) or opted out (False) for this specific preference category. Critical for GDPR/CCPA compliance — a False value means the consumer must NOT be targeted via this preference dimension.

attributes.name: pack_size_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred pack size or format (e.g., 'travel_size', 'standard', 'family_size', 'bulk', 'subscription_bundle'). Used to tailor product recommendations and promotional offers to the consumer's typical purchase behavior.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Packaging Hierarchy

attributes.name: preference_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the preference type. Defines what dimension of consumer behavior or communication this preference record governs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: product_category|brand|flavor_fragrance|pack_size|channel|communication_channel|contact_frequency|preferred_time_of_day|preferred_language — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: preference_rank
attributes.description: Ordinal ranking of this preference value relative to other values within the same category for the same consumer. Rank 1 indicates the most preferred option. Enables ranked preference lists for recommendation engines (e.g., first, second, third flavor choice).

attributes.name: preference_source
attributes.description: Origin of the preference record indicating whether it was explicitly declared by the consumer through a digital or physical touchpoint, or inferred by an ML model or behavioral analysis. Declared preferences carry higher trust weight in personalization engines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: declared_web|declared_app|declared_call_center|declared_in_store|inferred_ml|inferred_purchase_history|inferred_survey — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Preference Capture; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the preference record. 'active' means the preference is valid and in use by personalization engines; 'suppressed' means the preference is overridden by a brand-level or regulatory rule; 'expired' means the preference has passed its effective end date.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Preference Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: preference_value
attributes.description: The specific declared or inferred preference value within the category and subcategory. Examples: 'mint' for flavor, 'English' for language, 'morning' for time of day, 'weekly' for contact frequency, 'email' for communication channel. Free-form string to accommodate diverse CPG preference dimensions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: preferred_channel
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred channel for receiving brand communications, promotions, and personalized content. Drives communication orchestration in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and DTC engagement programs. 'none' indicates the consumer has opted out of all outbound communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|sms|push_notification|direct_mail|in_app|whatsapp|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Orchestration; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: preferred_contact_frequency
attributes.description: The consumer's declared preference for how often they wish to receive brand communications. Used by communication orchestration engines to enforce contact frequency caps and prevent consumer fatigue in CPG engagement programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi_weekly|monthly|quarterly|as_needed|never — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Contact Frequency Management; FTC CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: preferred_language
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred language for communications, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'es-MX'). Used by communication orchestration platforms to deliver brand content in the consumer's preferred language.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 — Language Tags; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Preferences

attributes.name: preferred_time_of_day
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred time window for receiving communications and push notifications. Used by send-time optimization algorithms in CPG personalization engines to maximize open rates and engagement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Send-Time Optimization

attributes.name: preferred_timezone
attributes.description: The IANA timezone identifier for the consumer's preferred timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used in conjunction with preferred_time_of_day to schedule communications at the correct local time for global CPG consumer bases.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Communication Scheduling

attributes.name: product_category_preference
attributes.description: The specific CPG product category this consumer prefers (e.g., 'oral_care', 'hair_care', 'skin_care', 'household_cleaning', 'personal_hygiene'). Drives product recommendation engines and category-level targeted promotions. Populated when preference_category = 'product_category'.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC); Nielsen IQ Category Management

attributes.name: retail_channel_preference
attributes.description: The consumer's preferred retail channel for purchasing CPG products. Used for channel-specific targeting, trade promotion alignment, and omnichannel engagement strategies. Supports DSD (Direct Store Delivery) and DTC channel optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ecommerce|grocery|mass_retail|pharmacy|dtc|club_store|convenience|specialty — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: sku_preference
attributes.description: The specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code that the consumer has declared or demonstrated a preference for. Enables SKU-level personalization and targeted replenishment reminders in DTC and e-commerce channels. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; GS1 SKU Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this preference record originated. Enables data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when the same consumer has preferences captured across multiple touchpoints (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud vs. web portal vs. call center). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_cgc|sap_s4hana|web_portal|mobile_app|call_center|in_store_kiosk|survey_platform|nielsen_iq — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 Data Quality Framework

attributes.name: source_system_preference_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this preference record in the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud preference record ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and EDI-based data exchange between CPG operational systems.
attributes.references: EDI Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Data Integration

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification within the preference category. For example, within 'product_category' the subcategory may be 'hair_care' or 'oral_care'; within 'communication_channel' it may be 'email' or 'push_notification'. Enables multi-level preference taxonomy for CPG personalization engines.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud — Consumer Preference Framework

attributes.name: suppression_reason
attributes.description: The reason this preference record has been suppressed when preference_status = 'suppressed'. Critical for GDPR right-to-erasure (Article 17) and CCPA opt-out compliance documentation. Ensures downstream systems do not act on suppressed preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure; CCPA Section 1798.120

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Formal consent and privacy preference record for a consumer capturing GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory consent obligations, including full audit history of all consent changes. Stores consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, cookies), current consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent version, capture method (web form, app, in-store, call center), capture timestamp, IP address, regulatory jurisdiction, expiry date, and immutable event log of every status change (prior status, new status, change trigger, channel, processing agent/system). This is the SSOT for consumer privacy compliance and provides the complete consent history required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record in the Consumer Goods consumer privacy system. Primary key for the consent_record data product, serving as the SSOT for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or re-consent campaign that prompted this consent record creation or update. Enables campaign-level consent conversion tracking and supports Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Consent records are captured to satisfy specific regulatory compliance obligations (GDPR Art.6, CCPA §1798.100). Regulatory affairs teams must trace which compliance obligation mandates each consent t

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Data privacy compliance mandates mapping each consent record to its governing jurisdiction for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Consumer Goods brand for which this consent was captured. Enables brand-level consent reporting and ensures that consent granted for one brand is not incorrectly applied to another brand within the same corporate portfolio.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Advertising and Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile record for whom this consent record applies. Links the consent record to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).

attributes.name: capture_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer's consent was captured. Identifies whether consent was obtained via a web form, mobile app, in-store interaction, call center agent, paper form, or email link. Required for GDPR proof-of-consent obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the consumer's consent action was recorded in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent record and is immutable once set. Required for GDPR Article 7 audit trail.

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason or event that triggered the most recent change to the consent status. Distinguishes consumer-initiated changes from system-driven expirations, administrative overrides, legal requests (e.g., right to erasure), or re-consent campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 29101

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the consumer (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es-MX'). Required to confirm consent was given in an intelligible form per GDPR Article 7.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(2); GDPR Recital 42; ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored proof-of-consent artifact (e.g., screenshot, signed form scan, call recording reference, Veeva Vault document ID). Supports GDPR Article 7(1) obligation to demonstrate that consent was given.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); Veeva Vault (Quality Documents); ISO 27001

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the consent grant — whether it applies globally across all Consumer Goods brands and products, is restricted to a specific brand, product category, or a single campaign. Enables granular consent management across the product portfolio.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record indicating whether the consumer has actively granted, withdrawn, or is pending confirmation of consent, or whether the consent has expired past its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: Verbatim text or reference hash of the consent notice, privacy policy excerpt, or opt-in language presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Immutable record of what the consumer agreed to, required for GDPR Article 7 proof-of-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being captured, defining the specific processing activity for which the consumer has provided or withheld consent. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, and cookies as required by GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 22; CCPA Section 1798.120; ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms document presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of which policy version was in effect when consent was given, critical for GDPR Article 7 compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: cookie_consent_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cookie categories for which the consumer has granted consent (e.g., 'functional,analytics,marketing'). Captures granular cookie preferences as required by the ePrivacy Directive and GDPR for digital channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: necessary|functional|analytics|marketing|social_media|personalization|advertising — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ePrivacy Directive Article 5(3); GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF 2.0

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's country of residence at the time of consent capture. Determines applicable privacy regulation (e.g., GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA/California). Critical for multi-jurisdiction compliance management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from capture_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer when providing consent in digital channels. Supports forensic audit trails and UX analysis of consent capture flows.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer completed a double opt-in confirmation process (e.g., clicked a confirmation link in a verification email) in addition to the initial consent action. Double opt-in provides stronger proof of consent for marketing communications under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides the definitive timestamp for consent activation in double opt-in workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; GDPR Article 7; ePrivacy Directive Article 13

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this consent record is considered active and binding. Typically aligns with the capture date but may differ for backdated or scheduled consent activations. Supports MASTER_AGREEMENT role effective-period tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed or re-confirmed by the consumer. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. Used to trigger consent renewal workflows and ensure ongoing compliance with GDPR's requirement for time-limited consent.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the consumer submitted their consent. Captured for digital consent channels (web form, mobile app, email link) as evidence of consent origin. May be considered PII under GDPR in some EU jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); GDPR Recital 30; CCPA Section 1798.140(o)

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this row represents the current active consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD Type 2) pattern in the Silver Layer, where historical consent versions are retained for audit purposes and this flag identifies the latest version.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ISO 29101; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer conventions

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 or equivalent regulation for processing the consumer's personal data. Consent is one of six legal bases; this field distinguishes consent-based processing from other lawful bases to support compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Recital 40-49; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: minor_age_threshold
attributes.description: Age threshold (in years) used to determine whether parental consent was required for this consent record, based on the applicable jurisdiction's rules (e.g., 16 for GDPR default, 13 for COPPA, 13-16 for EU member state variations). Null if consumer is not a minor.

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for a minor consumer. Required under GDPR Article 8 for children under 16 (or lower age threshold set by member state) and COPPA for US consumers under 13.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 8; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act); CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: prior_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status immediately before the most recent status change. Enables point-in-time audit reconstruction and supports the immutable event log requirement for GDPR Article 7 compliance audits without requiring a separate history table join.

attributes.name: processing_agent
attributes.description: Identifier of the system, application, or human agent (call center representative ID or system name) that processed and recorded the consent event. Supports accountability requirements under GDPR Article 5(2) and provides an audit trail of who or what captured the consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2); GDPR Article 24; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to automated profiling and decision-making activities, including personalization algorithms, NPS scoring, CLTV modeling, and segmentation. Required under GDPR Article 22 for automated decision-making with significant effects.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 22; GDPR Recital 71; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: re_consent_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the consumer must re-confirm their consent before the current consent record is automatically withdrawn or expired. Null if re-consent is not required. Used to drive automated consent renewal campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: re_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the consumer due to a material change in the privacy policy, consent notice, or processing purpose. Triggers re-consent outreach workflows in the CRM system.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Increments with each status change or update, enabling full audit history reconstruction. Version 1 is the initial consent capture; subsequent versions reflect changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The applicable privacy regulation or jurisdiction framework under which this consent record was created and must be managed. Determines the legal basis, retention rules, and consumer rights applicable to this record (e.g., GDPR for EU consumers, CCPA for California residents).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140(g); LGPD Article 3; ISO 29101

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days this consent record must be retained for compliance purposes after the consent is withdrawn or expires. Determined by applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation, CCPA). Drives automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.105; ISO 27001

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this consent record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, SAP S/4HANA, web portal, mobile app). Enables data lineage tracking and system-of-record reconciliation across the Consumer Goods technology landscape. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: salesforce_cgc|sap_s4hana|web_portal|mobile_app|call_center_crm|in_store_pos|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has explicitly consented to their personal data being shared with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, data brokers, analytics providers). Distinct from general data sharing consent; specifically governs external data transfers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 44-49 (International Transfers); CCPA Section 1798.120; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required to demonstrate that withdrawal was as easy as giving consent per GDPR Article 7(3).

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent; this timestamp documents the withdrawal event for audit purposes.

products.name: dtc_order
products.description: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order with line-item detail placed by a shopper through owned e-commerce or brand website channels. Captures order header (order number, date, status, channel, shipping/billing address, payment method, subtotal, discount, shipping cost, tax, total, currency, fulfillment reference) and line items (SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered/shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code, fulfillment status, return flag). This is the SSOT for DTC channel order transactions and enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling.
products.reference: DTC Order / SAP SD Sales Order

attributes.name: distribution_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_shipment. Business justification: A DTC order is physically fulfilled via a DC distribution shipment. Linking them enables end-to-end order-to-shipment traceability, OTIF compliance reporting at the consumer order level, and consumer

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.loyalty_account. Business justification: DTC orders earn and redeem loyalty points (loyalty_points_earned and loyalty_points_redeemed fields on dtc_order). Linking dtc_order directly to the loyalty_account used for the transaction enables di

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for consolidated revenue reporting across channels; DTC orders must be reconciled with central sales order for finance.

attributes.name: outbound_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.outbound_order. Business justification: A DTC consumer order triggers a DC outbound order for fulfillment. Order-to-delivery traceability, OTIF measurement, and consumer service escalations all require linking the consumer-facing order to t

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.price_list. Business justification: DTC channel orders must reference the applicable price list for pricing governance, margin analysis, and promotional compliance auditing. Consumer goods companies maintain DTC-specific price lists; li
