attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.address. Business justification: DTC orders have a shipping address captured as denormalized fields (ship_to_address_line1, ship_to_city, ship_to_country_code, ship_to_name, ship_to_postal_code, ship_to_state_province). The address t

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer (shopper) who placed this DTC order. Links to the consumer master profile in the Consumer domain SSOT, enabling CLTV analysis, loyalty program attribution, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription plan that generated this DTC order, when subscription_order_flag is True. Links to the subscription master for recurring order management, churn analysis, and subscription revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the shipment was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Compared against promised_delivery_date to calculate OTIF performance and identify late delivery patterns for carrier SLA management.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OTIF KPI Standards; SLA Standards

attributes.name: billing_address_same_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Address Same as Shipping Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the billing address is identical to the shipping address for this order. When False, a separate billing address record is maintained. Used for payment processing and fraud risk scoring.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to deliver this DTC order (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL). Used for carrier performance analysis, SLA tracking, and logistics cost allocation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; GS1 Carrier Standards

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: The specific owned DTC channel through which the order was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, social commerce). Enables channel-level performance analysis, attribution modeling, and Share of Voice (SOV) reporting across DTC touchpoints.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DTC order record was first ingested and created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and ETL reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial consolidation, FX reporting, and EBITDA calculations. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer to place this DTC order. Used for UX optimization, mobile commerce analytics, and channel attribution modeling to improve conversion rates across device types.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Nielsen IQ Consumer Panel

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied at the order header level, including promotional codes, loyalty redemptions, and trade promotion discounts. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) ROI analysis and net revenue reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Types; TPM Standards

attributes.name: fulfillment_ref
attributes.description: External reference number linking this DTC order to the fulfillment system (e.g., Blue Yonder WMS warehouse order, 3PL fulfillment reference, or SAP WM transfer order). Enables end-to-end order-to-delivery traceability and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM; GS1 SSCC

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment state of the DTC order at the header level, indicating whether all line items have been picked, packed, and shipped. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI reporting and supply chain performance dashboards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery; OTIF Standards

attributes.name: gift_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was placed as a gift, triggering gift wrapping, suppression of price information on packing slips, and gift message inclusion. Used for seasonal demand analysis and consumer gifting behavior modeling.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: ip_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from the consumer's IP address at the time of order placement. Used for fraud detection, geo-restriction compliance, and cross-border commerce analytics. Classified as potentially PII under GDPR.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for this DTC order, based on the order total and applicable loyalty tier multipliers. Feeds into CLTV calculations and loyalty program engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; CCPA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this DTC order. Used for loyalty liability accounting, redemption rate analysis, and consumer engagement reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud CRM; GAAP

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DTC Order Placement Date and Time
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the consumer submitted the order through the DTC e-commerce or brand website channel. This is the principal business event timestamp used for demand planning, daily sales reporting, and S&OP inputs. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DTC order, tracking progression from placement through fulfillment or cancellation. Used for order management dashboards, OTIF reporting, and consumer communication triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|processing|shipped|delivered|cancelled|returned — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Order Management; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: order_total_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount charged to the consumer, calculated as subtotal minus discounts plus shipping plus tax. This is the authoritative revenue figure for DTC channel financial reporting and EBITDA contribution analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET net total.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SOX

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument type used by the consumer to complete this DTC order (e.g., credit card, PayPal, digital wallet). Used for payment analytics, fraud detection, and consumer payment preference reporting. Note: No raw card data is stored; only the instrument type.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Processing

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment transaction associated with this DTC order, tracking authorization through capture or refund. Critical for revenue recognition, accounts receivable (DSO), and consumer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; PCI DSS v4.0; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: External payment gateway transaction reference or authorization code for this order. Used for payment reconciliation, chargeback management, and financial audit trails. Does not contain sensitive card data (PCI DSS compliant tokenized reference only).
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date committed to the consumer at the time of order placement, based on Available to Promise (ATP) or Capable to Promise (CTP) logic. Used for SLA compliance measurement and consumer expectation management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP ATP/CTP; SAP S/4HANA SD; SLA Standards

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any item in this DTC order has been returned or a return has been initiated. Used for return rate analysis, product quality monitoring, and consumer satisfaction (NPS) correlation studies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns Management; ISO 9001 Quality

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the order return (e.g., defective product, wrong item, consumer changed mind). Populated when return_flag is True. Used for quality defect analysis, product improvement, and COGS impact reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: defective|wrong_item|not_as_described|changed_mind|damaged_in_transit|late_delivery|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Returns; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: shipped_date
attributes.description: The date the order was physically dispatched from the fulfillment center or warehouse. Used for lead time analysis, carrier handoff tracking, and revenue recognition timing under ASC 606.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Goods Issue; GAAP ASC 606; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges billed to the consumer for this DTC order. Used for logistics cost analysis, free-shipping threshold reporting, and net revenue calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS Transportation

attributes.name: source_system_order_ref
attributes.description: The native order identifier from the originating e-commerce platform or ERP system (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud order ID, SAP SD sales order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI integration, and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; EDI Standards

attributes.name: subscription_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was generated as part of a recurring subscription (subscribe-and-save) program. Used to distinguish subscription revenue from one-time purchase revenue for CLTV modeling and replenishment trigger analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GAAP ASC 606 Subscription Revenue

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: The gross merchandise value of all line items before discounts, shipping charges, and taxes are applied. Used as the base for promotional discount calculations, COGS analysis, and gross margin reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax or VAT charged on this DTC order, calculated based on the shipping destination jurisdiction. Required for financial reporting, tax compliance, and SOX audit trails. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax; SOX Section 404; CFR Title 26

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment associated with this DTC order. Provided to the consumer for last-mile visibility and used internally for delivery confirmation and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 SSCC; Carrier Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this DTC order record in the Silver layer, capturing status changes, address corrections, or payment updates. Supports change data capture and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Each line item contributes to a profit center; needed for profit‑center reporting per SKU.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who placed the DTC order. Enables consumer-level purchase history, CLTV analysis, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU purchased on this line. Enables SKU-level purchase analysis, product affinity modeling, and replenishment triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_movement. Business justification: Shipment tracking process ties each order line to the inventory movement record that shipped the product.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Fulfillment allocation report requires linking each order line to the specific stock position that supplied the SKU.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription record that triggered this order line, when subscription_flag is True. Enables subscription lifecycle analysis and recurring revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Subscription Management

attributes.name: supply_atp_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.atp_record. Business justification: REQUIRED: Order line allocation references the ATP record used for inventory commitment; this link supports order‑to‑inventory reconciliation and fulfillment reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Used for OTIF calculation, consumer satisfaction analysis, and carrier performance reporting.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Proof of Delivery; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was physically dispatched from the fulfillment warehouse. Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and carrier SLA adherence.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS - Shipment Date; SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Goods Issue Date

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the brand under which the product on this order line is marketed. Supports brand-level revenue reporting, Share of Market (SOM) analysis, and brand portfolio performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Brand; Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Identifies the specific DTC sub-channel through which this order line was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, subscription program, social commerce). Supports channel-level revenue attribution and consumer journey analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Channel Management; TradeEdge Channel Visibility

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Standard cost of goods for the units on this order line at time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation, DTC channel profitability analysis, and EBITDA reporting. Classified confidential as it reveals internal cost structure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Standard Cost; GAAP ASC 330; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this order line are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency DTC operations and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle state of this order line. Tracks progression from order confirmation through warehouse picking, packing, shipment, and delivery. Supports On Time In Full (OTIF) monitoring and consumer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picking|packed|shipped|delivered|cancelled|backordered — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Status; Blue Yonder WMS - Order Status

attributes.name: gift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line was designated as a gift by the consumer. True when the consumer selected gift options (e.g., gift wrapping, gift message). Supports gifting program analytics and packaging operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Order Management

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number for the product on this line. Enables cross-retailer product identification, barcode scanning, and regulatory traceability. Conforms to GS1 GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 formats.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards - GTIN Specification

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product on this order line is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, packaging, or shipping restrictions. True for products subject to DOT, IATA, or EPA hazmat regulations. Critical for carrier compliance and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (SDS); DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: is_returned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line has been subject to a consumer return. True when a return has been initiated or completed. Enables return rate analysis by SKU, category, and consumer segment for product quality and consumer experience programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Returns Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: line_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to this order line, including promotional discounts, coupon redemptions, and loyalty rewards. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) analysis and margin reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Discount Condition; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM

attributes.name: line_discount_pct
attributes.description: Discount rate applied to this order line expressed as a percentage of the gross unit price. Enables promotional effectiveness analysis and margin impact assessment without requiring price recalculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Discount Percentage; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of this order line after all discounts have been applied but before tax. Core revenue recognition field for DTC channel P&L reporting and COGS analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT monetary component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Amount; SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent DTC order. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-line orders. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Sales Order Item Number

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: Gross line value before tax, calculated as unit_price multiplied by quantity_ordered. Represents the pre-discount, pre-tax revenue contribution of this line item.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Net Value; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this order line inclusive of all discounts and taxes. Represents the actual amount charged to the consumer for this line item. Used for revenue reporting and consumer billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Total Amount; SOX Financial Reporting; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for purchasing this order line. Supports loyalty program accrual tracking, Consumer Lifetime Value (CLTV) modeling, and consumer engagement analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Loyalty Management; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this order line. Enables loyalty redemption rate analysis and program liability management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Loyalty Management

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product SKU as displayed to the consumer at time of purchase. Captured at order time to preserve historical accuracy independent of future product name changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Description

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date communicated to the consumer as the expected delivery date for this order line. Drives consumer expectation management, NPS impact analysis, and carrier performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Requested Delivery Date; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was committed to ship to the consumer at time of order placement. Basis for Available to Promise (ATP) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Confirmed Delivery Date; SAP IBP - ATP

attributes.name: quantity_cancelled
attributes.description: Number of units cancelled on this order line, either by the consumer or due to inventory unavailability. Supports cancellation rate analysis and demand signal correction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Cancelled Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU ordered by the consumer on this line. Basis for demand planning, inventory reservation, and fulfillment processing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Order Quantity

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Actual number of units of the SKU dispatched to the consumer for this line. May differ from quantity_ordered due to partial fulfillment, Out of Stock (OOS) situations, or split shipments. Key metric for On Time In Full (OTIF) measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Delivery Quantity; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is subject to a regulatory hold preventing fulfillment (e.g., FDA product recall, CPSC safety alert, EU REACH restriction). True when a hold is active. Supports compliance-driven order management and consumer safety programs.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault Regulatory

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the consumer return of this order line. Supports product quality analysis, Quality Control (QC) escalation, and consumer experience improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DEFECTIVE|WRONG_ITEM|NOT_AS_DESCRIBED|CHANGED_MIND|DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT|LATE_DELIVERY|DUPLICATE_ORDER|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Return Reason; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: subscription_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line was generated as part of a recurring subscription program (e.g., Subscribe & Save). True for subscription-triggered lines. Enables subscription revenue tracking and replenishment program analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Subscription Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to this order line, including applicable sales tax, VAT, or GST based on consumer jurisdiction. Required for tax compliance reporting and financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Tax Condition; CFR Title 26 (IRS); EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the SKU quantity is expressed on this order line (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, PK=Pack). Aligns with GS1 and SAP UOM standards for consistent quantity interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PK|BX|KG|LB|OZ|L|ML — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards - Unit of Measure; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Gross selling price per unit of the SKU at the time of order placement, before any discounts or promotions. Represents the consumer-facing price (RSP/MSRP or DTC-specific price). Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Condition Price; FTC Pricing Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this order line record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

products.name: dtc_return
products.description: Consumer return or refund request for a DTC order. Captures return request date, return reason code (defective, wrong item, changed mind, damaged in transit), return status (requested, approved, received, refunded, rejected), return method (mail-in, drop-off), refund amount, refund method (original payment, store credit, loyalty points), and associated order and order line references. Supports consumer satisfaction tracking and product quality feedback loops.

attributes.name: dtc_return_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a DTC return or refund request record. Primary key of this entity.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: DTC returns trigger AR credit memos against the originating invoice. Consumer goods AR teams must link returns to invoices for credit memo processing, deduction management, and accurate outstanding ba

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: Product recall scoping and FDA/CPSC complaint handling require tracing returned consumer units to their manufacturing batch_record. Quality teams use this link to determine defect scope, initiate targ

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: FK to logistics.carrier

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Returns and refunds must be processed within the originating legal entity for tax credit memo issuance, VAT reclaim, and statutory reporting. Consumer goods multinationals require company code on retu

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: dtc_return carries regulatory_report_required flag indicating the return must be reported under a specific compliance obligation (e.g., CPSC safety incident reporting). Linking to compliance_obligatio

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Return processing costs (restocking, quality inspection, reverse logistics) are allocated to cost centers. Consumer goods operations controllers track return handling costs by cost center for operatio

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Reverse logistics process: a consumer return must be received and dispositioned at a specific DC. Returns management, inventory disposition reporting, and refund authorization all require knowing whic

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.dtc_order. Business justification: A DTC return belongs to a DTC order at the header level. While dtc_return already links to dtc_order_line (which in turn links to dtc_order), a direct dtc_order_id FK on dtc_return enables order-level

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Return refunds and restocking charges post to specific GL accounts (returns & allowances, refund liability). Consumer goods P&L reporting requires GL coding on returns for accurate net revenue and ret

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.inbound_receipt. Business justification: When a consumer return arrives at a DC, an inbound receipt formally records its acceptance into inventory. Linking dtc_return to inbound_receipt enables reverse logistics traceability, quality inspect

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.logistics_shipment. Business justification: Return processing workflow needs the original shipment reference to manage reverse logistics, refunds, and OTIF metrics.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Returned products must be traced to their specific lot/batch for quality investigation, recall assessment, and regulatory reporting. Consumer goods companies require lot traceability on returns to ide

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.loyalty_account. Business justification: DTC returns trigger loyalty point refunds (loyalty_points_refunded field on dtc_return). Linking dtc_return directly to the loyalty_account to which points are refunded enables direct loyalty impact a

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: DTC returns with quality_defect_code or safety_incident_flag trigger nonconformance records in the quality system. Consumer goods QA teams require this traceability to aggregate consumer-reported defe

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original DTC order against which this return is raised. Links the return to the parent sales transaction for financial reconciliation and consumer satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: product_complaint_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.product_complaint. Business justification: DTC returns with safety_incident_flag or quality_defect_code must be traceable to a formal product complaint record for regulatory adverse event reporting and recall management. Consumer goods regulat

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.product_recall. Business justification: Recall management report requires linking each consumer return to the associated product recall record to track recall effectiveness.

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.recall_event. Business justification: Returns triggered by product recalls must link to the inventory recall_event record for recall effectiveness measurement (quantity recovered vs. distributed) and regulatory closure reporting. dtc_retu

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile who initiated the return request. Links to the SSOT consumer master record for CRM, loyalty, and consumer satisfaction analytics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product (SKU) being returned. Enables product-level return rate analysis, quality feedback loops, and defect trending by SKU.
attributes.references: GS1 GTIN Standard; SAP MM Material Master

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_movement. Business justification: Return movement tracking links each return to the inventory movement that records the inbound return flow.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Return processing records which stock position the returned SKU is returned to for inventory reconciliation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the return request was approved by the consumer service team or automated system. Used for SLA tracking and return processing time analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP SD Returns Processing

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Customer service case or ticket number associated with this return request in the CRM system. Enables cross-referencing between the return record and the consumer service interaction history in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Case Management

attributes.name: consumer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-return consumer satisfaction rating collected via survey (typically 1–5 or 1–10 scale). Used as an input to Net Promoter Score (NPS) calculations and consumer experience improvement programs. Collected via Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud post-return survey.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Distinct from request_timestamp which captures the business event time.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this return record (refund_amount, restocking_fee_amount, net_refund_amount). Supports multi-currency DTC operations across global markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the returned product after quality inspection. Drives inventory management, COGS impact, and regulatory compliance for product destruction. Valid values: restock (return to sellable inventory), refurbish (rework required), destroy (product destroyed per policy), return_to_vendor (sent back to supplier), quarantine (held pending investigation).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; SAP QM Usage Decision

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration or best-before date printed on the returned product. Used for FEFO compliance validation, quality assessment of returned goods, and regulatory reporting for expired product returns.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; EU REACH Regulation; ISO 22716

attributes.name: fraud_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return has been flagged for manual fraud review based on fraud_risk_score or other risk signals. Supports loss prevention workflows and return abuse management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: fraud_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric risk score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the fraud detection system to assess the likelihood of return fraud. Drives manual review routing and automated rejection thresholds. Supports loss prevention analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: loyalty_points_refunded
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points credited back to the consumer's account as part of the refund. Populated when refund_method is 'loyalty_points' or when loyalty points were originally redeemed on the order. Supports loyalty program financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Loyalty Management; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: net_refund_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary amount actually refunded to the consumer after deducting any restocking fees or adjustments from the gross refund amount. Used for financial settlement and consumer account reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Credit Memo; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: product_condition_code
attributes.description: Assessed condition of the returned product upon receipt at the warehouse. Determines disposition (restock, refurbish, destroy) and impacts inventory valuation. Assessed by warehouse quality inspection team per GMP guidelines.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; SAP QM Inspection

attributes.name: quality_defect_code
attributes.description: Standardized quality defect classification code assigned when the return reason indicates a product quality issue (defective, damaged). Feeds into the Quality Management (QM) system for defect trending, root cause analysis, and regulatory reporting. Sourced from SAP QM or Siemens Opcenter MES quality module.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; CPSC Product Safety; SAP QM Defect Catalog

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the returned product was physically received at the warehouse or returns processing center. Triggers refund processing and inventory restock workflows. Sourced from Blue Yonder WMS goods receipt.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Goods Receipt; SAP WM Returns Putaway

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount to be refunded or already refunded to the consumer, in the transaction currency. Represents the base refund before any deductions such as restocking fees. Used for financial reconciliation and COGS impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Credit Memo; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: refund_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the refund was issued to the consumer. Used for financial reconciliation, Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) adjustment, and consumer satisfaction SLA measurement.
attributes.references: SAP FI Credit Memo; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund is issued to the consumer. Drives financial processing workflows and consumer communication. Valid values: original_payment (refund to original payment instrument), store_credit (credit to consumer account), loyalty_points (converted to loyalty program points), bank_transfer (direct bank transfer), gift_card (issued as gift card value).
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP FI Payment Processing; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: regulatory_report_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this return requires submission of a regulatory report to a governing body (FDA, CPSC, EPA). Driven by safety_incident_flag, product category, and jurisdiction. Supports compliance workflow automation and audit readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 314; CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; EPA Reporting; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the return request was rejected. Populated only when return_status is 'rejected'. Used for consumer communication SLA tracking and dispute resolution analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the return request was rejected. Populated only when return_status is 'rejected'. Supports consumer dispute resolution and return policy analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer submitted the return request. Used for SLA measurement, return window eligibility validation, and trend reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Returns Order; FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the consumer submitted the return request. Used for SLA measurement at sub-day granularity and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: restocking_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee deducted from the refund amount to cover reverse logistics and restocking costs, where applicable per return policy. Used for net refund calculation and cost recovery reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Conditions; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: return_channel
attributes.description: Digital or service channel through which the consumer initiated the return request. Distinct from return method (physical logistics). Used for channel analytics and consumer experience optimization.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: return_label_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier tracking number assigned to the prepaid return shipping label issued to the consumer. Enables reverse logistics tracking and proof-of-return verification. Sourced from Blue Yonder WMS or carrier integration.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation; SAP SD Delivery Tracking

attributes.name: return_method
attributes.description: Physical method by which the consumer returns the product. Determines logistics handling, prepaid label issuance, and reverse logistics cost allocation. Valid values: mail_in (consumer ships via postal/courier), drop_off (consumer drops at designated location), carrier_pickup (carrier collects from consumer address), in_store (returned at retail partner location).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Reverse Logistics; SAP SD Returns Delivery

attributes.name: return_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) number assigned to this return request. Used in consumer communications, shipping labels, and customer service interactions. Sourced from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud or SAP SD returns order.
attributes.references: SAP SD Returns Order; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: return_policy_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the return policy that was in effect at the time the return was requested. Ensures consistent policy application and supports audit trails for policy change impact analysis.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Policy Management

attributes.name: return_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the product being returned in this return request. Used for inventory restock planning, refund calculation, and return rate KPI computation.
attributes.references: SAP SD Returns Order Quantity; GS1 Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the consumer is returning the product. Drives quality feedback loops, product improvement, and carrier claims. Valid values: defective (product malfunction), wrong_item (incorrect item shipped), changed_mind (consumer preference change), damaged_in_transit (carrier damage), not_as_described (product mismatch), missing_parts (incomplete product). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: defective|wrong_item|changed_mind|damaged_in_transit|not_as_described|missing_parts — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Return Reason; ISO 9001 Quality Management; CPSC Product Safety

attributes.name: return_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the consumer describing the specific reason for the return. Supplements the standardized return reason code with qualitative detail for quality analysis and consumer service resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP SD Returns Order

attributes.name: return_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the return request. Tracks the return workflow from initial consumer request through final resolution. Valid values: requested (consumer submitted), approved (return authorized), received (item received at warehouse), refunded (refund issued), rejected (return denied), cancelled (consumer cancelled). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|approved|received|refunded|rejected|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP SD Returns Processing

attributes.name: return_window_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return request was submitted within the brand's published return policy window (e.g., 30 days from delivery). Drives automated approval/rejection workflows and consumer communication.
attributes.references: FTC Consumer Protection Guidelines; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Return Policy

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return involves a consumer safety incident (e.g., injury, adverse reaction, product hazard). When true, triggers mandatory regulatory reporting workflows to FDA, CPSC, or EPA as applicable. Critical for product safety compliance and recall management.
attributes.references: CPSC Consumer Product Safety Act; FDA 21 CFR Part 314; EPA Reporting Requirements; ISO 9001

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this return record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

products.name: nps_response
products.description: Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey response captured from a consumer. Stores survey date, survey channel (email, in-app, SMS, post-purchase), NPS score (0-10), promoter/passive/detractor classification, verbatim comment, product or brand surveyed, survey campaign reference, and response status. Enables brand health tracking, consumer sentiment analysis, and closed-loop consumer feedback management for CPG brands.

attributes.name: nps_response_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each NPS survey response record in the Consumer Goods consumer feedback system. Primary key for the nps_response data product.
attributes.references: GS1 Data Model Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: NPS Survey Attribution ties each NPS response to the marketing campaign that triggered the survey for campaign effectiveness measurement.

attributes.name: category_id

attributes.description: Reference to the primary SKU enrolled in this subscription. Identifies the specific product variant (size, flavor, format) the consumer has subscribed to for auto-replenishment.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.sku_planning_param. Business justification: Subscription fulfillment is governed by SKU-level planning parameters (minimum order quantity, shelf life, order multiples, reorder point). Consumer goods subscription operations must validate each re

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_contract. Business justification: Ensures Subscription sourcing audit linking each consumer subscription to the supplier contract governing the product supply.

attributes.name: acquisition_source
attributes.description: Marketing source or campaign that drove the consumer to subscribe (e.g., email campaign code, paid search, influencer referral, loyalty program). Used for marketing ROI (Return on Investment) attribution and SOV (Share of Voice) analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the subscription is configured to automatically renew at the end of each billing cycle (True) or requires explicit consumer action to continue (False). Governs recurring revenue recognition and consumer notification obligations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Negative Option Rule; GDPR Article 7 (consent)

attributes.name: billing_cycle_day
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–31) on which the subscription billing charge is processed. Governs the recurring payment schedule and aligns with the consumer's preferred billing date. Used in accounts receivable and DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer formally cancelled the subscription. Distinct from end_date (which may be a future scheduled end). Used in churn cohort analysis and subscription tenure reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Consumer-stated or system-derived reason for cancelling the subscription. Populated when subscription_status transitions to 'cancelled'. Critical input for churn analysis, NPS (Net Promoter Score) correlation, and consumer retention strategy.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal data associated with this subscription (True = opted out). Mandatory for California consumers. Drives data sharing restrictions downstream.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the subscription was originally acquired (e.g., dtc_web, dtc_mobile). Supports DTC (Direct to Consumer) channel performance analysis, attribution reporting, and consumer acquisition cost tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Market Intelligence

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the subscription record was first created in the platform. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and subscription cohort analysis.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 30 (records of processing activities)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the subscription billing currency (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency DTC operations and financial consolidation reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the subscription price per billing cycle, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Reflects subscriber loyalty pricing, promotional offers, or TPM (Trade Promotion Management) funded discounts.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription is scheduled to end or was terminated. Null for open-ended subscriptions. Represents EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this agreement. Populated on cancellation or plan expiry.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: failed_payment_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of failed payment attempts on this subscription since inception. Used to trigger dunning workflows, payment retry logic, and subscription suspension rules. Key indicator for revenue leakage management.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; PCI DSS v4.0

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which the subscription order is automatically triggered and fulfilled. Drives the replenishment schedule and next order date calculation. Key input for demand planning and S&OP forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has provided explicit GDPR-compliant consent for data processing associated with this subscription (True) or not (False). Mandatory for EU consumers. Supports regulatory compliance and data governance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: last_order_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recently fulfilled subscription order. Used to validate subscription activity, detect stalled subscriptions, and support FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory allocation for replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Actual amount charged to the consumer per billing cycle after applying the discount rate. Equals subscription_price × (1 - discount_rate). Used in revenue recognition, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) analysis, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SOX Section 404; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: next_order_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next automatic order generation under this subscription. Used by fulfillment systems for ATP (Available to Promise) checks and demand sensing. Updated after each successful order cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey response from the subscriber, on a scale of 0–10. Used to correlate subscription satisfaction with churn risk and to segment consumers for retention and advocacy programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; Nielsen IQ - Consumer Panel

attributes.name: pause_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription pause is scheduled to end and auto-replenishment is set to resume. Null if the pause is indefinite. Used in demand forecasting to anticipate reactivation volumes.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; SAP IBP - Demand Planning

attributes.name: pause_reason
attributes.description: Consumer-stated reason for pausing the subscription. Populated when subscription_status transitions to 'paused'. Used in consumer retention analysis and proactive re-engagement campaign targeting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: pause_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the consumer-initiated subscription pause became effective. Used to calculate pause duration and adjust next_order_date upon resumption. Supports consumer retention lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: payment_method_type
attributes.description: Category of payment instrument used for recurring subscription billing (e.g., credit_card, digital_wallet). Stored as a type reference only — no raw card or account data is stored here per PCI DSS compliance. Supports payment failure analysis and retry logic.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials

attributes.name: payment_token_reference
attributes.description: Tokenized reference identifier for the consumer's stored payment method, issued by the payment processor vault. Never contains raw card or bank account data. Used to initiate recurring charges without storing PCI-sensitive data. Compliant with PCI DSS tokenization requirements.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0 Section 3.5; GDPR Article 25 (data minimization)

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Gross price charged to the consumer per billing cycle before any discounts are applied. Expressed in the subscription's billing currency. Used in subscription revenue forecasting and CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value) calculations.
attributes.references: Oracle Cloud ERP - Financials; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Number of units of the subscribed SKU to be fulfilled per order cycle. Drives replenishment volume, inventory reservation, and demand planning inputs for S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning).
attributes.references: SAP IBP - Demand Planning; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the subscription became effective and the first order cycle was initiated. Represents EFFECTIVE_FROM for this agreement. Used in cohort analysis and subscription tenure calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: subscription_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable subscription reference number communicated to the consumer in confirmation emails, invoices, and customer service interactions. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: subscription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the subscription. 'active' = fulfilling orders; 'paused' = consumer-initiated hold; 'cancelled' = permanently terminated; 'pending' = awaiting first payment confirmation; 'expired' = plan term ended without renewal. Drives LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; GDPR Article 17 (right to erasure on cancellation)

attributes.name: subscription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subscription program type. 'auto_replenishment' covers single-SKU DTC replenishment; 'subscription_box' covers curated multi-product boxes; 'bundle' covers fixed product bundles; 'trial' covers introductory trial subscriptions.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.name: total_orders_fulfilled
attributes.description: Cumulative count of successfully fulfilled subscription orders since the subscription start date. Non-derived operational counter maintained by the fulfillment system. Used in subscription tenure analysis and OTIF (On Time In Full) performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: trial_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the trial period ends and standard subscription billing commences. Null for non-trial subscriptions. Used to trigger trial-to-paid conversion communications and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: trial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this subscription was initiated as a trial or introductory offer (True) or as a standard paid subscription (False). Used to segment trial-to-paid conversion analytics and NPD (New Product Development) launch performance.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management; FTC Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the subscription record. Represents RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Owns end-to-end supply chain planning and orchestration including demand planning, supply planning, inventory optimization, S&OP/IBP processes, DRP execution, safety stock targets, ATP/CTP calculations, supply network design, demand sensing, forecast accuracy tracking, and supply risk management. Integrates with SAP IBP.

products.name: demand_plan
products.description: Core master entity representing the demand plan across all versions, stages, and consensus outcomes within the S&OP/IBP cycle for each SKU/location/channel/planning period combination. Each record represents a specific version-point: captures version name, version type (statistical baseline/field sales overlay/marketing-adjusted/consensus/final approved), planning cycle reference, created-by persona, approval status, effective date range, planning bucket (weekly/monthly), statistical baseline quantity, commercial overlay, marketing event uplift, new product launch volume, consensus quantity, variance to statistical baseline, channel disaggregation, promotional overlays, and lifecycle stage. The consensus version represents the single agreed demand signal passed to supply planning. Enables forecast accuracy benchmarking across versions. Sourced from SAP IBP Demand Planning module.

attributes.description: Indicates whether this consensus demand includes uplift from planned trade promotions or marketing events. True means promotional activity is planned; false means base demand only.

products.name: sku_lane_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment (sourcing rule) between a network_lane and a sku_planning_param. It captures which network lanes are valid sourcing options for a given SKU at a given planning node, along with the lane-specific planning parameters (priority, lead time, MOQ) that govern how the planning system uses each lane for that SKU. Each record links one network_lane to one sku_planning_param with attributes that exist only in the context of this SKU-lane sourcing relationship, and is actively managed during supply network design and S&OP reviews.. Existence Justification: In consumer goods supply chain planning, a network lane (source-destination pair) services many SKUs, and a single SKU may have multiple valid sourcing lanes with different priorities, lead times, and order quantities. This SKU-to-lane assignment is a recognized operational concept in planning systems like SAP IBP and is actively managed during supply network design reviews — planners create, update, and deactivate these assignments as sourcing strategies evolve. The relationship carries its own data (sourcing priority, effective dates, MOQ per lane) that belongs neither to the lane alone nor to the SKU planning parameters alone.

attributes.name: sku_lane_assignment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Lane Assignment - Sku Lane Assignment Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the sku_lane_assignment association

attributes.name: network_lane_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Lane Assignment - Network Lane Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the network lane that is being assigned as a valid sourcing option for the SKU

attributes.name: sku_planning_param_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sku Lane Assignment - Sku Planning Param Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the SKU planning parameter record for which this lane assignment applies

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this SKU-lane assignment. Active assignments are used by planning engines; inactive or suspended assignments are retained for audit and reactivation purposes.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this SKU-lane assignment is no longer active. Null indicates the assignment is open-ended. May differ from the lane's own effective_end_date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SKU-lane assignment becomes active and is used by planning engines for replenishment routing. May differ from the lane's own effective_start_date.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity specific to this SKU on this lane. Overrides both the lane's general MOQ and the SKU's general MOQ when this assignment is active, reflecting negotiated or operational constraints for this specific SKU-lane combination.

attributes.name: sourcing_priority
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the preference order for this lane when multiple sourcing lanes are valid for the same SKU. Lower values indicate higher priority. Distinct from the lane's general sourcing_priority as it is specific to this SKU-lane combination.

attributes.name: standard_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days for this specific SKU on this lane, from order placement to goods receipt. May differ from the lane's general lead time due to SKU-specific handling, inspection, or processing requirements.

domains.name: sales

products.name: trade_account

This is the golden record for all trade partner identity — every other customer domain entity references this product via FK.

attributes.name: consumer_segment_id

A key account manager expects to know which consumer seg

products.name: account_hierarchy

Captures parent account, child account, hierarchy level (store, banner, chain, parent corporation), effective date range, hierarchy type (commercial, logistics, financial), and consolidation flag. attributes.description: Identifier of the child account in the hierarchy. References the lower-level organizational entity (e.g., store, banner, chain).

attributes.name: primary_trade_account_id

attributes.name: acv_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether All Commodity Volume (ACV) metrics should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in ACV aggregation; false means exclude. Critical for market coverage and distribution analysis.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the hierarchical relationship change. Draft indicates the relationship is being defined; pending approval indicates the relationship is awaiting management review; approved indicates the relationship has been validated; rejected indicates the relationship was not approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user who approved the hierarchical relationship. Used for audit trail and governance purposes.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the hierarchical relationship was approved. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether financial and operational metrics from the child account should be consolidated into the parent account for reporting purposes. True means consolidate; false means report separately. Critical for All Commodity Volume (ACV), Total Distribution Points (TDP), trade spend, and sales performance roll-ups.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the account hierarchy record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship ends or is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended relationship. Critical for historical analysis and point-in-time reporting.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the hierarchical relationship becomes effective. Used for temporal tracking of organizational changes, mergers, acquisitions, and restructuring events.

attributes.name: hierarchy_depth
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the hierarchy tree, with 1 representing the top level (parent corporation) and increasing numbers representing deeper levels (chain, banner, store). Used for recursive queries and hierarchy traversal.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Level of the child account within the organizational hierarchy. Store represents individual retail locations; banner represents a retail brand or fascia; chain represents a retail chain or group; parent corporation represents the ultimate parent entity; division represents a business division; region represents a geographic region.

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path representing the full lineage from root to child account, typically formatted as slash-separated account identifiers (e.g., /1/23/456/7890). Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries for Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Trade Promotion Management (TPM) reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Type of organizational hierarchy relationship. Commercial hierarchies support sales and trade promotion roll-ups; logistics hierarchies support distribution and delivery planning; financial hierarchies support invoicing and payment consolidation; reporting hierarchies support management reporting structures; legal hierarchies represent corporate ownership; operational hierarchies support day-to-day execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the account hierarchy record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the hierarchical relationship. May include business context, special handling instructions, or historical information about organizational changes.

attributes.name: ownership_percentage

attributes.name: primary_hierarchy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary hierarchical relationship for the child account when multiple hierarchy types exist. True means this is the default hierarchy for reporting and analytics; false means this is a secondary or alternate hierarchy.

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: Business code or identifier representing the nature of the parent-child relationship. May include codes for wholly-owned subsidiary, franchise, joint venture, affiliate, or other relationship types specific to the consumer goods trade channel.

attributes.name: relationship_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the hierarchical relationship. Provides business context for the parent-child linkage (e.g., Regional Banner Group, Corporate Ownership, Distribution Network).

attributes.name: relationship_status

Active indicates the relationship is currently in effect; inactive indicates the relationship has ended; pending indicates the relationship is awaiting activation; suspended indicates the relationship is temporarily paused; terminated indicates the relationship has been permanently ended.

attributes.name: rollup_weight
attributes.description: Weighting factor applied when rolling up metrics from child to parent account. attributes.name: sales_rollup_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether sales performance metrics should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in sales aggregation; false means exclude. Essential for Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) and Integrated Business Planning (IBP).

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.description: Indicates whether trade promotion spending should be rolled up from child to parent account. True means include in trade spend aggregation; false means exclude. Critical for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) reporting.

products.name: account_segment
products.description: Commercial segmentation, channel classification taxonomy, and go-to-market tier assignment for trade accounts. Owns the complete channel reference hierarchy (primary: retail, foodservice, wholesale, DTC; secondary: grocery, mass, club, drug, convenience, e-commerce, QSR, institutional) as well as the commercial segment assignment (strategic, key account, regional, emerging, tail). Captures channel code, channel name, channel tier, segmentation model version, customer tier, strategic priority flag, assigned sales region, applicable region, active status, and effective date range. Drives trade promotion allocation, field sales call frequency, and standardized channel reporting across all downstream domains.

products.name: order
products.description: Core sales order record capturing all commercial sales transactions across retail, wholesale, DTC, and e-commerce channels. Contains order header details (order number, date, channel type, status, delivery dates, OTIF status, payment terms, currency, totals, SAP SD document number) and line-level detail (SKU/GTIN, quantities ordered/confirmed/shipped, unit pricing, discounts, trade promotion references, line status, COGS, gross margin, delivery schedule). Serves as the primary transactional backbone of the sales domain enabling both order-level and SKU-level revenue and margin analysis.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the sales order record. Primary key for the order entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id

attributes.name: event_id

attributes.name: pricing_agreement_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer location where goods should be delivered. May differ from bill-to location for multi-site customers.

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative or account manager who created or owns this order. Used for commission calculation and SFA reporting.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Order Fulfillment Allocation report requires linking each order to the supply network node that will source inventory for accurate ATP/CTP calculations.

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Directly assigning a territory to an order simplifies reporting and analytics.

attributes.name: channel_type

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this order. Determines currency for pricing, tax, and totals.

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: The distribution channel through which products are sold. Defines the route-to-market and channel-specific pricing rules.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: The product division or business unit for this order. Used for divisional P&L reporting and product line segmentation.

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Freight and shipping charges applied to the order. May be customer-paid or supplier-absorbed depending on terms.

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: Gross profit on the order calculated as total revenue less COGS. Key profitability metric for order-level margin analysis.

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: Three-letter Incoterm code defining the transfer of risk and cost responsibility between buyer and seller. Examples: FOB, CIF, DDP.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this order record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: order_date

attributes.name: order_number

attributes.name: order_source

attributes.name: otif_status

attributes.name: sales_office

attributes.name: special_instructions

attributes.name: total_amount

products.name: invoice

Contains invoice header (invoice number, date, billing type, payment terms, gross/net values, tax, currency, payment status, DSO tracking, EDI status) and line-level detail (SKU/GTIN, billed quantities, unit prices, trade discounts, net line values, tax codes, revenue recognition categories, COGS allocation). Links to the originating sales order and serves as the accounts receivable source record enabling SKU-level revenue and profitability reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: billing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type: standard invoice for goods/services, credit memo for returns/adjustments, debit memo for additional charges, proforma for advance notice, intercompany for internal transfers, or consignment for stock-based billing.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was cancelled or voided. Null for active invoices. Used for cancelled invoice reporting and audit.

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold_amount
attributes.description: Total standard cost of all products billed on this invoice. Used for gross margin calculation and profitability analysis at invoice level.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the billing system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: days_sales_outstanding
attributes.description: Number of days between invoice date and payment date (or current date if unpaid). Key metric for working capital management and customer payment behavior analysis.

attributes.name: invoice_number
