attributes.name: outstanding_quantity
attributes.description: Remaining quantity yet to be received on this purchase order line. Calculated as ordered quantity minus goods received quantity.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may over-deliver beyond the ordered quantity. Used to control goods receipt tolerances.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or facility code where the material will be received and consumed. Determines the receiving location for goods receipt.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Quantity unit for which the net price applies. For example, price per 100 units or per 1000 units. Used to calculate total line value.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the procurement team or buyer responsible for this purchase order line. Used for workload distribution and performance tracking.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee or department that requested this material through a purchase requisition. Provides accountability and cost center traceability.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Additional short text or notes specific to this purchase order line. Provides supplementary information for procurement and receiving teams.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or warehouse area within the plant where the material will be stored upon receipt. Used for inventory positioning.

attributes.name: supplier_material_number
attributes.description: Supplier's own material or part number for this item. Used for cross-referencing and communication with the supplier.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code determining the applicable tax rate and jurisdiction for this line item. Used for invoice verification and tax reporting.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Acceptable percentage by which the supplier may under-deliver below the ordered quantity. Used to control goods receipt tolerances and automatic PO closure.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity. Standard codes such as KG (kilogram), LT (liter), EA (each), MT (metric ton), CS (case).

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Goods receipt (GR) event recorded when raw materials, packaging, or indirect goods are physically received at a plant or distribution center against a purchase order. Captures GR document number, posting date, receiving plant, storage location, received quantity per line, unit of measure, batch number, FEFO expiry date, quality inspection flag, movement type, and GR status. Triggers inventory update and three-way match process. Supports GR reversal and return-to-vendor scenarios.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO / MSEG movement type 101)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Primary key for goods_receipt

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.inventory_storage_location. Business justification: REQUIRED: Records the exact storage location where goods receipt is posted, enabling accurate stock updates.

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inbound shipment or transportation leg that delivered these goods. Links to logistics tracking and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Goods receipt posting in consumer goods creates or references the specific lot/batch received. Quality inspection, shelf-life tracking, and batch traceability all require linking the GR document to th

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Goods receipts occur at a specific manufacturing facility (receiving plant). The existing receiving_plant_code is a denormalized code; a proper FK enables facility-level receiving reports, inbound qua

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item on the purchase order for which goods were received. Enables line-level tracking and three-way match.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which goods were received. Links this goods receipt to the originating procurement document.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Receiving teams verify the SDS against the received goods; the receipt records the SDS ID instead of a simple flag.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or vendor who delivered the goods. Used for supplier performance scorecards and VMI reconciliation.

attributes.name: supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: Inbound logistics requires linking each goods receipt to the warehouse node for accurate inventory updates and OTIF reporting.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided or internally-assigned batch or lot number for traceability. Critical for quality management, recalls, and FEFO inventory management.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider who delivered the goods. Used for carrier performance analysis.

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier-provided Certificate of Analysis was received with the shipment. Required for GMP compliance and quality assurance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was first created in the database. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the valuation amount is expressed. Typically the company code currency.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The supplier-provided delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for cross-referencing and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the supplier delivery note or packing slip. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which the received material must be consumed or disposed of. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory rotation and shelf-life management.

attributes.name: gr_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this goods receipt transaction. Used for audit trails, supplier communication, and three-way match processing.

attributes.name: gr_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt has been reversed (cancelled). True means the inventory posting has been negated due to return-to-vendor or data correction.

attributes.name: gr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the goods receipt. Indicates whether the receipt is active, has been reversed, or is awaiting quality inspection clearance.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the quality inspection lot created for this goods receipt. Links to QM inspection results and certificate of analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The system timestamp when this goods receipt record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the material was produced by the supplier. Used for shelf-life calculation and quality assurance.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for the raw material, packaging component, or indirect good that was received. Links to material master data.

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: The SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the goods receipt transaction (e.g., 101 for GR against PO, 122 for return delivery). Determines inventory and financial posting logic.

attributes.name: otif_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this goods receipt met the On Time In Full criteria (received on or before requested date with full ordered quantity). Used for supplier performance scorecards.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the goods receipt was posted to inventory. This is the principal business event timestamp for inventory valuation and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received goods must undergo quality inspection before being released for use. True triggers QM workflow and blocks stock until clearance.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: The physical quantity of goods received and accepted into inventory. This is the principal quantitative fact for this transaction.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, exceptions, or special handling instructions related to this goods receipt. Used for operational communication and audit context.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversing goods receipt transaction, if this receipt was cancelled. Links to the offsetting inventory movement.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: The business reason why this goods receipt was reversed. Used for root cause analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: The specific storage location or warehouse zone within the receiving plant where goods were placed. Used for inventory positioning and picking optimization.

attributes.name: sustainable_sourcing_certification
attributes.description: The sustainability certification standard under which the received material was sourced (e.g., FSC for paper/packaging, RSPO for palm oil). Supports ESG reporting and sustainable sourcing initiatives.
attributes.references: FSC Chain of Custody, RSPO Supply Chain Certification

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the received quantity is expressed (e.g., KG for kilograms, EA for each, L for liters). Must align with material master UOM.

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The per-unit price used for inventory valuation at the time of goods receipt. May be standard cost, moving average price, or PO price depending on valuation method.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: The total inventory value of the received goods in the company currency, calculated as received quantity multiplied by standard or moving average price. Used for financial posting and COGS calculation.

products.name: supplier_invoice
products.description: Supplier invoice received for goods or services delivered against a purchase order. Captures invoice header (supplier-assigned number, invoice date, posting date, gross amount, tax amount, currency, payment due date, three-way match status, tolerance check result, blocking reason, processing status) and invoice line items (referenced PO line, material/service description, invoiced quantity, unit price, line amount, tax code, line-level match status). Supports granular three-way match (PO vs GR vs invoice) at both header and line level. Feeds accounts payable and COGS allocation. Owns all line-level detail as embedded attributes.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification / Logistics Invoice Verification (MIRO / RBKP)

attributes.name: supplier_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier invoice record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Invoices are allocated to cost centers for expense tracking; required by internal budgeting controls.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AP invoices must map to a GL account for posting; essential for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Three-way match (PO line → Goods Receipt → Invoice) is a core procurement control. supplier_invoice currently links to purchase_order but not to the specific po_line, making line-level invoice verific

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center allocation of supplier invoices supports profitability analysis of purchased goods.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice was issued.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: Invoices for regulated chemicals must reference the SDS to support audit trails and tax compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who issued this invoice.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved the invoice for payment.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was approved for payment.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date used for calculating payment due date and cash discount periods.

attributes.name: blocking_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the invoice is blocked from payment, if applicable. Empty if not blocked.

attributes.name: blocking_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason the invoice is blocked from payment.

attributes.name: cash_discount_days
attributes.description: The number of days within which payment must be made to qualify for the cash discount.

attributes.name: cash_discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage discount available for early payment per payment terms.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The company code within the ERP system that is responsible for this invoice.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the invoice amounts.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount amount applied to the invoice, including early payment discounts.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which the invoice was posted.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice was posted.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date goods were received or services were confirmed, used for three-way match validation.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the supplier issued the invoice. This is the principal business event timestamp for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description or notes about the invoice provided by the supplier or entered during processing.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The unique invoice number assigned by the supplier. This is the externally-known identifier for the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received by the organization.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts payable workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|paid|blocked|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice type indicating the nature of the transaction.

attributes.name: line_item_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items included in this invoice.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the invoice record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was last modified.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount payable after taxes and discounts. This is the final amount due to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date payment was made to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the supplier per payment terms.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which payment will be made to the supplier.

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned when payment is made, linking the invoice to the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the supplier (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: The plant or facility code where goods were received or services were rendered.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the financial accounting system.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice at header level.

attributes.name: tolerance_check_result
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice passed tolerance checks for price and quantity variances.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of withholding tax deducted from the invoice payment per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Code representing the withholding tax type and rate applied.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the invoice record in the system.

products.name: supplier_scorecard
products.description: Periodic supplier performance scorecard evaluating suppliers across key procurement KPIs: OTIF delivery rate, quality rejection rate (defect PPM), invoice accuracy, responsiveness, sustainability compliance, and regulatory adherence. Captures scorecard period, overall weighted score, individual KPI scores, trend vs prior period, scorecard status, and recommended action (maintain/develop/escalate/delist). Supports strategic supplier relationship management, sourcing decisions, and category reviews.
products.reference: Supplier Performance Management / SAP Ariba Supplier Risk

attributes.name: supplier_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier scorecard record. Primary key.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_brand. Business justification: Brand-level supplier performance reporting: in consumer goods, supplier scorecards are evaluated per brand (e.g., packaging supplier for Brand X vs. Brand Y). Brand managers review supplier KPIs scope

attributes.name: spend_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the procurement category or commodity group this supplier primarily serves, used for category-level benchmarking.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier being evaluated in this scorecard.

attributes.name: action_plan_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal corrective action plan or performance improvement plan is required based on scorecard results.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the scorecard was formally approved and published.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text commentary providing qualitative context, notable achievements, concerns, or recommendations for supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: cost_competitiveness_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier pricing competitiveness relative to market benchmarks and alternative suppliers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary values in this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: innovation_collaboration_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier contribution to new product development, process improvements, and collaborative innovation initiatives.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of invoices submitted without errors requiring correction or dispute during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for invoice accuracy performance, weighted to contribute to overall score.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this scorecard record was last updated.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier performance review and scorecard generation.

attributes.name: otif_delivery_rate_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Delivery Rate Percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of purchase orders delivered on time and in full during the evaluation period. Key supply chain reliability metric.

attributes.name: otif_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for OTIF performance, typically weighted and scaled to contribute to overall weighted score.

attributes.name: overall_weighted_score
attributes.description: Composite weighted score aggregating all KPI scores, typically on a 0-100 scale. Primary metric for supplier performance ranking.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier assigned based on overall score and KPI performance, determining supplier relationship management strategy.

attributes.name: prior_period_overall_score
attributes.description: Overall weighted score from the previous evaluation period, used for trend analysis and performance tracking.

attributes.name: quality_rejection_rate_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Quality Rejection Rate Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Defect rate measured in parts per million, indicating the number of rejected units per million units received. Critical quality metric.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Normalized score for quality performance based on rejection rates and quality incidents, weighted to contribute to overall score.

attributes.name: recommended_action
attributes.description: Strategic recommendation for supplier relationship management based on scorecard results: maintain current relationship, develop capabilities, monitor closely, escalate issues, or delist supplier.

attributes.name: regulatory_adherence_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier compliance with regulatory requirements including SDS documentation, GMP standards, FDA regulations, EPA requirements, and REACH compliance.
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, EU REACH Regulation, ISO 22716 (GMP for Cosmetics)

attributes.name: responsiveness_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier responsiveness to inquiries, requests for quotation, change orders, and issue resolution. Based on response time and communication quality.

attributes.name: scorecard_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the supplier scorecard, typically following format SC-YYYYMMDD or similar.

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scorecard indicating its approval and publication state.

attributes.name: sustainability_compliance_score
attributes.description: Score evaluating supplier adherence to sustainability requirements including FSC certification, RSPO compliance, environmental standards, and ethical sourcing practices.
attributes.references: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), ISO 14001

attributes.name: total_po_count
attributes.description: Total number of purchase orders issued to this supplier during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: total_purchase_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of purchases from this supplier during the evaluation period, used for spend-weighted analysis.

attributes.name: trend_vs_prior_period
attributes.description: Directional indicator showing whether overall performance improved, declined, or remained stable compared to the previous evaluation period.

products.name: spend_category
products.description: Hierarchical classification taxonomy for procurement spend categories covering raw materials (oils, surfactants, fragrances, actives, excipients), primary and secondary packaging, MRO, capex, and indirect services. Captures category code, category name, parent category, category level (L1/L2/L3/L4), commodity type, applicable regulatory frameworks (REACH, FDA, RSPO), preferred sourcing strategy, and category owner. Enables spend analytics, category management, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: spend_category_id
attributes.description: Primary key for spend_category

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Spend categories in consumer goods (Fragrance Ingredients, Preservatives, Packaging Chemicals) are governed by specific compliance obligations (REACH, FDA, IFRA). Category managers need this link for

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: In Consumer Goods, each spend category maps to a default GL account for financial posting and spend analytics. This mapping drives automatic account determination during PO creation and supports spend

attributes.name: parent_category_spend_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent spend category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level (L1) categories.

attributes.name: annual_spend_budget_amount
attributes.description: Planned annual procurement spend budget for this category in base currency (USD). Used for budget tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the spend category in procurement systems. Used as the business identifier for category classification and reporting.

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the spend category scope, including materials, services, and goods covered under this classification.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category in the spend taxonomy (L1=top level, L2=sub-category, L3=detailed category, L4=granular classification).

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the spend category (e.g., Surfactants, Primary Packaging, MRO Supplies).

attributes.name: category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the spend category in the procurement taxonomy (active=in use, inactive=deprecated, under_review=being evaluated, consolidating=merging with other categories, phasing_out=being eliminated).

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the commodity type covered by this category (raw materials, packaging, maintenance/repair/operations, capital expenditure, indirect services, logistics, professional services). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|packaging|mro|capex|indirect_service|logistics|professional_service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_coverage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of category spend covered by formal contracts or pricing agreements (0-100). Higher coverage indicates better spend management.

attributes.name: cost_savings_target_percentage
attributes.description: Annual cost reduction target for this category as a percentage of baseline spend. Used for procurement performance management.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this category record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for spend budget and reporting (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this category classification is no longer effective. Null for currently active categories.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this category record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this spend category record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent category strategy review and performance assessment.

attributes.name: lead_time_days_typical
attributes.description: Average procurement lead time in days for materials in this category from purchase order to goods receipt.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Material group classification from ERP system (SAP MM material group) for raw materials and packaging components.

attributes.name: moq_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether minimum order quantity constraints typically apply to materials in this category.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next category strategy review and supplier performance evaluation.

attributes.name: preferred_sourcing_strategy
attributes.description: Recommended sourcing approach for this category (single source, dual source, multi-source, spot buy, strategic partnership, vendor managed inventory, consignment). attributes.description: Target number of preferred suppliers for this category as part of supplier rationalization strategy.

attributes.name: sustainable_sourcing_flag

attributes.name: unspsc_code

The ASL approval_basis and compli

attributes.description: Name or role of the person or committee who authorized the supplier approval. Provides accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_basis
attributes.description: Method or evidence used to grant supplier approval. Audit = on-site supplier audit; Certification = third-party certification (ISO, FSC, RSPO); Qualification test = material sample testing; Performance review = historical performance analysis; Risk assessment = supply chain risk evaluation; Legacy approval = pre-existing authorization.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was approved for this material-plant combination. Represents the effective start of authorization.

attributes.name: approval_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current approval expires and requires re-evaluation. Null indicates indefinite approval subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current authorization status of the supplier for this material-plant combination. Approved = full authorization; Conditional = approved with restrictions; Blocked = temporarily prohibited; Delisted = permanently removed; Pending = under evaluation; Suspended = on hold pending review.

attributes.name: blocking_date
attributes.description: Date when the supplier was blocked, delisted, or suspended. Null when status is approved, conditional, or pending.

attributes.name: blocking_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the supplier is blocked, delisted, or suspended. Includes quality issues, compliance violations, delivery failures, financial instability, or ethical concerns. Null when status is approved or conditional.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory and policy compliance status for this supplier-material combination. Compliant = meets all requirements; Non-compliant = violations identified; Under review = compliance assessment in progress; Exempted = waiver granted.
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, REACH, OSHA Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: conditional_terms
attributes.description: Specific restrictions or requirements when approval status is conditional. Examples: reduced order quantities, enhanced inspection, expedited payment terms, or geographic limitations. Null when status is not conditional.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASL entry was first created in the system. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_rating
attributes.description: Supplier delivery performance rating for this material-plant combination. A = excellent (>95% OTIF); B = good (90-95% OTIF); C = acceptable (85-90% OTIF); D = marginal (80-85% OTIF); F = failing (<80% OTIF).
attributes.references: On Time In Full (OTIF) Performance Standard

attributes.name: edi_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic purchase orders and confirmations are enabled for this supplier-material-plant combination. True = EDI transactions supported; False = manual processing.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether incoming goods from this supplier-material combination require quality inspection before goods receipt posting. True = inspection mandatory; False = direct posting allowed.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Control, SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier audit or site visit for this material-plant combination. Used to track audit currency and schedule follow-ups.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this ASL entry. Tracks change accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ASL entry was last modified. Follows ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days from PO issuance to goods receipt for this supplier-material-plant combination. Used for MRP and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Requirements Planning (MRP)

attributes.name: moq_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum order quantity required by the supplier for this material-plant combination. Used to enforce purchasing constraints in PO creation.

attributes.name: moq_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the minimum order quantity. Examples: KG (kilograms), EA (each), LT (liters), MT (metric tons). Follows ISO 80000 or UN/CEFACT standards.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier audit or site visit. Drives proactive supplier quality management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding the supplier approval, special handling instructions, historical issues, or other relevant information for procurement and quality teams.

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the preferred source for this material-plant combination. True = preferred supplier with priority allocation; False = approved but not preferred.

attributes.name: price_validity_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current pricing agreement. Null indicates open-ended pricing subject to change notification.

attributes.name: price_validity_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current pricing agreement for this supplier-material-plant combination. Used to enforce valid pricing periods in PO creation.

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Supplier quality performance rating for this material-plant combination. A = excellent (>98% acceptance); B = good (95-98%); C = acceptable (90-95%); D = marginal (85-90%); F = failing (<85%). Derived from quality inspection results.

attributes.name: re_evaluation_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supplier performance review or qualification audit. Drives proactive supplier management activities.

attributes.name: risk_category
attributes.description: Supply chain risk classification for this supplier-material-plant combination. Low = stable supply, multiple sources; Medium = moderate dependency; High = single source or volatile region; Critical = business-critical material with supply constraints.

attributes.name: sole_source_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier is the only approved source for this material-plant combination. True = sole source (supply risk); False = multiple sources available.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Sustainability certifications held by the supplier for this material. Pipe-separated list of certifications: FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, B Corp, Carbon Neutral. Supports sustainable sourcing initiatives.

attributes.name: vmi_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier-material-plant combination is eligible for Vendor Managed Inventory programs. True = VMI enabled; False = traditional procurement.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this ASL entry. Provides accountability and audit trail.

domains.name: promotion
domains.description: Owns trade promotion planning, execution, and optimization (TPM/TPO). Manages promotional calendars, trade spend allocation, retailer funding agreements, promotional pricing (Hi-Lo, EDLP), accruals, deductions, post-event analysis, promotional lift measurement, ROI/GMROI analysis, and retailer rebate settlements. Integrates with Salesforce TPM.

products.name: trade_promotion
products.description: Core master entity for trade promotion programs. Captures the full definition of a trade promotion including name, type (Hi-Lo, EDLP, display, coupon, scan-back, off-invoice), promotional period, owning brand/category, status (planned, active, closed, cancelled), total authorized trade spend budget, promotion objectives, promotion type classification (temporary price reduction, feature ad, display, BOGO, multi-buy, scan-back, coupon, loyalty reward), applicable channels, and integration reference to Salesforce TPM. Serves as the SSOT for all trade promotion definitions and the parent entity for all promotion events, spend allocations, and post-event analyses.
products.reference: TPM Promotion Header (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud)

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Trade promotions are tracked against profit centers for brand and channel P&L reporting. Consumer Goods companies allocate trade spend to profit centers to measure net revenue by brand/channel. Essent

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: REQUIRED: Supplier‑funded trade promotions need a link for budgeting and compliance; experts expect a sponsor supplier on each promotion.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.trade_calendar. Business justification: A trade promotion program is planned and executed within a specific trade calendar cycle (annual or periodic). The trade_calendar is the master planning container for all promotional activity for a br

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: Total accrued trade spend liability for this promotion, representing funds reserved or committed but not yet paid to the retailer.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade promotion was formally approved by authorized business stakeholders and authorized for execution.

attributes.name: authorized_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total authorized trade spend budget allocated for this promotion, including all funding mechanisms (off-invoice, scan-back, display allowances, etc.). Expressed in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: baseline_volume_units
attributes.description: Expected sales volume in units without the promotion, used as the baseline for calculating incremental lift and ROI.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Retail channel classification where this promotion is executed. Grocery (supermarkets), mass merchandiser (Walmart/Target), drug (pharmacy chains), convenience (c-stores), club (warehouse clubs), ecommerce (online retail).

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where this promotion is executed.

attributes.name: coupon_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion includes manufacturer or retailer coupons (print, digital, or mobile). True if coupons are part of the promotion, false otherwise.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade promotion record was first created in the system. Represents the business event time of promotion planning initiation.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total deductions taken by the retailer against invoices for this promotion. Used for reconciliation and settlement tracking.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered to the retailer or consumer as part of this promotion. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.00 for 15% off).

attributes.name: display_type
attributes.description: Type of in-store merchandising display associated with this promotion. End-cap (end of aisle), free-standing (floor display), shelf-talker (shelf signage), pallet (bulk display), cooler (refrigerated display), none (no special display).

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade promotion concludes and promotional pricing/terms expire at retail.

attributes.name: expected_roi_percentage
attributes.description: Expected return on investment for this promotion, calculated as (incremental profit / trade spend) * 100. Used for pre-event planning and approval.

attributes.name: feature_ad_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this promotion includes feature advertising in retailer circulars, flyers, or digital media. True if featured, false otherwise.

attributes.name: funding_type
attributes.description: Mechanism by which trade funds are provided to the retailer. Off-invoice (deducted at purchase), scan-back (reimbursed based on POS sales), bill-back (invoiced after event), lump-sum (fixed payment), accrual (reserved funds).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade promotion record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: maximum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum number of units a consumer can purchase at the promotional price. Null if no maximum limit applies.

attributes.name: minimum_purchase_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of units a consumer must purchase to qualify for the promotional offer. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special terms, execution notes, or post-event observations related to this trade promotion.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: Retailer pricing strategy context for this promotion. Hi-Lo (high-low promotional pricing with deep discounts), EDLP (everyday low price with minimal promotions), hybrid (combination approach).

attributes.name: promotion_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the trade promotion program for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: promotion_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the trade promotion program, typically generated by the TPM system. Format: TPM-YYYYNNNN where YYYY is year and NNNN is sequence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM Standards

attributes.name: promotion_objective
attributes.description: Primary business objective driving the trade promotion strategy. Volume growth (increase unit sales), market share gain (capture competitor share), new product launch (trial generation), competitive defense (respond to competitor activity), inventory clearance (reduce excess stock), seasonal event (holiday/event-driven).

attributes.name: promotion_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade promotion. Planned (in design), approved (authorized for execution), active (currently running), closed (completed with results finalized), cancelled (terminated before completion), on-hold (temporarily suspended).

attributes.name: promotion_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade promotion mechanism. Temporary price reduction (Hi-Lo), feature ad (retailer circular), display (end-cap/shelf), BOGO (buy-one-get-one), multi-buy (quantity discount), scan-back (post-sale rebate). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temporary_price_reduction|feature_ad|display|bogo|multi_buy|scan_back|off_invoice|coupon|loyalty_reward|edlp|slotting_allowance|markdown_allowance — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Status of financial settlement and reconciliation for trade promotion deductions and accruals. Pending (awaiting settlement), in-progress (reconciliation underway), settled (fully reconciled and paid), disputed (discrepancies under review).

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the trade promotion becomes active and promotional pricing/terms take effect at retail.

attributes.name: target_volume_units
attributes.description: Target sales volume in units expected to be achieved during the promotion period, including baseline and incremental lift.

attributes.name: tpm_system_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the source Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud TPM module). Used for system integration and traceability.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Integration Standards

products.name: event
products.description: Represents a discrete promotional execution event tied to a trade promotion program. A single trade promotion may have multiple events across different retailers, geographies, or time windows. Captures event-level details: event type (feature ad, display, temporary price reduction, BOGO, scan-back), event start/end dates, retailer account, ship-to location, participating SKUs, planned vs. actual event status, and event-level trade spend allocation. Integrates with Salesforce TPM event records.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the promotion event. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Required for integrated ROI reporting: each trade promotion event is executed as part of a marketing campaign, enabling campaign‑level performance analysis.

attributes.name: consumer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.consumer_segment. Business justification: CPG promotion events are designed to target specific consumer segments (e.g., a feature ad targeting millennial health-conscious buyers). Linking promotion_event to marketing-defined consumer segments

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for promotion spend accounting reports linking each event to the responsible cost center for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Enables profit‑center level reporting of promotion performance and ROI, a standard finance requirement.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: REQUIRED: Promotion events are often sponsored by a specific supplier; linking enables event‑level spend tracking and audit.

attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Account Management

attributes.description: Reference to the parent trade promotion program under which this event is executed. A single program may have multiple events across different retailers or time windows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: The financial accrual amount reserved for this promotional event, representing the estimated liability for trade promotion obligations.

attributes.name: actual_trade_spend_amount
attributes.description: The realized trade spend for this promotional event, representing the total investment actually incurred by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: actual_volume_units
attributes.description: The realized sales volume in units achieved during the promotional event, used for post-event analysis and lift measurement.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional event was approved for execution by the authorized business stakeholder.

attributes.name: baseline_volume_units
attributes.description: The expected sales volume in units without promotional activity, used as the baseline for calculating promotional lift.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date when this promotional event was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why this promotional event was cancelled, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this promotional event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this promotional event record.

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: The total deductions claimed by the retailer against invoices for this promotional event, representing retailer-initiated trade spend recovery.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional event concludes execution at retail or distribution level.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the promotional event, including objectives, mechanics, and special conditions.

attributes.name: event_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the promotional event for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the promotion event, used for external communication and reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the promotional event. Planned: event scheduled but not yet approved; Approved: event approved for execution; In Execution: event currently active; Completed: event finished; Cancelled: event terminated before completion.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the promotional event mechanism. Feature Ad: product featured in retailer circular; Display: in-store display placement; Temporary Price Reduction (TPR): short-term price discount; BOGO: Buy One Get One offer; Scan-Back: post-sale rebate based on scanned sales; Coupon: manufacturer or retailer coupon redemption.

attributes.name: funding_source
attributes.description: The primary source of funding for this promotional event. Manufacturer: fully funded by manufacturer; Retailer: fully funded by retailer; Cooperative: jointly funded by both parties.

attributes.name: geography_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the geographic market where the event is executed.

attributes.name: gmroi_ratio
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Margin Return on Investment (GMROI) Ratio
attributes.description: The gross margin return on investment for this promotional event, calculated as Gross Margin / Average Inventory Investment, measuring profitability efficiency.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this promotional event record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: planned_trade_spend_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted trade spend allocation for this promotional event, representing the total investment planned by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: planned_volume_units
attributes.description: The forecasted sales volume in units expected during the promotional event, used for planning and ROI estimation.

attributes.name: post_event_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether post-event analysis has been completed for this promotional event, including lift measurement and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: post_event_analysis_date
attributes.description: The date when post-event analysis was completed for this promotional event.

attributes.name: pricing_strategy
attributes.description: The pricing approach applied during this event. Hi-Lo: high-low promotional pricing with deep temporary discounts; EDLP: Everyday Low Price with minimal promotional variation; Hybrid: combination of both strategies.

attributes.name: promotional_lift_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage increase in sales volume attributable to the promotional event, calculated as (Actual Volume - Baseline Volume) / Baseline Volume * 100.

attributes.name: rebate_amount
attributes.description: The total rebate amount paid to the retailer for this promotional event, typically calculated post-event based on performance metrics.

attributes.name: roi_percentage
attributes.description: The return on investment for this promotional event, calculated as (Incremental Profit - Trade Spend) / Trade Spend * 100, measuring promotional effectiveness.

attributes.name: salesforce_tpm_event_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Salesforce Trade Promotion Management (TPM) Event ID
attributes.description: The unique identifier from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Trade Promotion Management system for this event record, used for system integration and data lineage.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Trade Promotion Management

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date when financial settlement for this promotional event was completed and all trade spend obligations were resolved.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: The current status of financial settlement for this promotional event. Pending: settlement not yet initiated; In Progress: settlement calculations underway; Settled: all financial obligations resolved; Disputed: settlement under dispute resolution.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the promotional event begins execution at retail or distribution level.

products.name: event_sku
products.description: Association entity linking individual SKUs (GTINs/UPCs) to a specific promotion event with full promotional pricing authority. Captures SKU-level promotional details including promoted price, promoted price type (Hi-Lo temporary price reduction, EDLP, multi-buy, BOGO, scan-back, off-invoice, bill-back), price reduction depth (%), regular shelf price (RSP/MSRP), effective date range, planned promotional volume (cases/units), actual promotional volume, baseline volume estimate, incremental lift volume, promotional discount amount per unit, retailer account, channel, and pricing approval status. Serves as the SSOT for SKU-level promotional pricing within trade events — distinct from standard list pricing owned by the product domain. Enables SKU-level trade spend, lift analysis, and promotional price compliance per event.
products.reference: TPM Event Product Line (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud)

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.recall_event. Business justification: SKUs actively featured in promotion events may be subject to recall events, requiring immediate suspension of promotional activity. Linking event_sku to recall_event enables rapid identification of pr

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Compliance team validates each promoted SKU against its registration before launch; direct FK enables automated compliance checks.

attributes.name: retailer_funding_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer funding agreement or trade contract governing the promotional terms for this SKU.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU participating in this promotion event.

attributes.name: standard_cost_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.standard_cost. Business justification: Event SKU profitability analysis requires standard cost to calculate promotional margin per SKU. Consumer Goods trade teams use standard cost to evaluate promotional_gmroi and promotional_roi_percent

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade account for which this promotional SKU pricing applies.

attributes.name: accrual_amount
attributes.description: Accrued trade spend liability for this promotional SKU. Represents the estimated financial obligation based on planned volume and discount.

attributes.name: actual_promotional_volume_cases
attributes.description: Actual volume of cases sold during the promotion period for this SKU. Captured post-event from POS or shipment data.

attributes.name: actual_promotional_volume_units
attributes.description: Actual volume of consumer units sold during the promotion period for this SKU. Used for promotional lift and ROI analysis.

attributes.name: baseline_volume_estimate_units
attributes.description: Estimated volume of units that would have been sold without the promotion. Used to calculate incremental lift. Typically derived from historical sales trends.

attributes.name: compliance_check_status
attributes.description: Status of promotional pricing compliance verification for this SKU. Ensures promotional pricing was executed as agreed with the retailer.

attributes.name: compliance_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when promotional pricing compliance was verified for this SKU through retail execution audits or POS data validation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this promotion event SKU record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Actual deduction amount claimed by the retailer for this promotional SKU. Used for trade spend reconciliation and settlement.

attributes.name: display_location_type
attributes.description: Type of in-store display location where this promotional SKU is merchandised. Impacts visibility and promotional lift. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Shelf|End Cap|Free Standing Display|Pallet|Cooler|Checkout|Secondary Placement — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: feature_type
attributes.description: Type of promotional feature or advertising support provided for this SKU during the promotion event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Circular Ad|Digital Ad|In-Store Signage|Shelf Talker|Coupon|Loyalty Offer|None — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: Global Trade Item Number uniquely identifying the product SKU in the promotion. Supports EAN-8, EAN-13, UPC-A, UPC-E, and GTIN-14 formats.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_percent
attributes.description: Percentage lift in volume due to the promotion. Calculated as (incremental_lift_volume_units / baseline_volume_estimate_units) * 100.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_volume_units
attributes.description: Incremental volume of units sold above baseline due to the promotion. Calculated as actual_promotional_volume_units - baseline_volume_estimate_units.

attributes.name: is_featured_sku
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a featured hero product in the promotion event. Featured SKUs typically receive premium merchandising and advertising support.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this promotion event SKU record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

Feeds TPO optimization models and post-event ROI calculations.

attributes.name: cannibalization_rate

attributes.name: confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: The lower bound of the confidence interval for the lift measurement, typically at 95% confidence level.

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper

attributes.name: confidence_level_percentage
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level of the lift measurement, typically 90%, 95%, or 99%.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: discount_percentage

attributes.name: halo_effect_units
attributes.description: The additional volume lift observed in related non-promoted SKUs due to the promotion, representing positive spillover effects.

attributes.name: incremental_lift_percentage

attributes.name: incremental_lift_units
attributes.description: The incremental volume in units attributable to the promotion, calculated as actual promoted volume minus baseline volume.

attributes.name: incremental_revenue
attributes.description: The incremental revenue generated by the promotion, calculated as incremental lift units multiplied by promotional price.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lift measurement record was last updated.

attributes.name: lift_source

attributes.name: measurement_methodology

attributes.name: measurement_notes

attributes.name: measurement_week_end_date

attributes.name: measurement_week_start_date

attributes.name: p_value

attributes.name: post_promotion_dip_units

attributes.name: regular_price

attributes.name: statistical_significance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the measured lift is statistically significant at the specified confidence level.

products.name: retailer_compliance
products.description: Transactional record capturing retailer execution compliance for a promotion event — whether the retailer delivered the agreed promotional mechanics (feature ad, display, price point, shelf placement per POG). Tracks compliance check date, compliance type (ad feature, display, price compliance, OSA), compliance score (%), non-compliance reason, penalty amount applied, auditor/field rep reference, and data source (SFA field audit, third-party compliance service). Feeds deduction dispute resolution and future funding negotiations.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific retail store location where compliance was audited. Enables store-level compliance tracking and analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retailer or trade account whose compliance is being measured. Identifies the party responsible for executing the promotional mechanics.

attributes.description: Reference to the trade promotion event being audited for compliance. Links this compliance record to the parent promotional campaign.

attributes.name: actual_retail_price
attributes.description: The actual price observed at the retail location during the compliance audit. Compared against agreed promotional price to determine price compliance.

attributes.name: ad_feature_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer included the promoted product in their feature advertisement or circular as agreed. True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: agreed_promotional_price
attributes.description: The promotional price point that was contractually agreed between the manufacturer and retailer. Used as the benchmark for price compliance verification.

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify compliance. Field rep visit = in-person store check by manufacturer sales team, third-party audit = independent compliance service, POS data analysis = automated analysis of retailer sales data, photo verification = photographic evidence submitted digitally, retailer self-report = retailer-provided compliance attestation.

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: The name of the field representative or third-party auditor who conducted the compliance check. Provides human-readable reference for audit accountability.

attributes.name: compliance_check_date
attributes.description: The date when the compliance audit or field check was performed. Represents the business event timestamp for this compliance observation.

attributes.name: compliance_score_percentage
attributes.description: The overall compliance score expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Represents the degree to which the retailer met the agreed promotional execution terms. Used for funding adjustments and future negotiation leverage.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The overall compliance determination for this audit record. Compliant = all mechanics met, non-compliant = one or more mechanics failed, partial compliant = some mechanics met, pending review = audit submitted but not yet adjudicated, disputed = retailer has challenged the compliance finding.

attributes.name: compliance_type
attributes.description: The category of promotional mechanic being audited. Ad feature = retailer circular/flyer inclusion, display = in-store promotional display presence, price compliance = agreed promotional price point adherence, OSA = On Shelf Availability during promotion, POG placement = planogram compliance, multi-mechanic = combined audit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this compliance record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The system or channel from which this compliance record originated. SFA field audit = Salesforce mobile app, third-party service = external compliance vendor, POS integration = retailer point-of-sale data feed, retailer portal = retailer self-service submission, manual entry = back-office data entry.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: data_source_reference_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier from the originating system (e.g., SFA visit ID, third-party audit ticket number, POS transaction batch ID). Enables traceability back to source system for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: display_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer set up the agreed in-store promotional display (end cap, floor stand, shipper display). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer has formally disputed this compliance assessment. True = dispute filed, False = no dispute. Disputed records feed deduction dispute resolution workflows.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the retailer for why they are disputing the compliance finding. Captures retailer perspective and supporting evidence for dispute resolution.

attributes.name: funding_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The net adjustment to trade spend funding based on compliance performance. Positive values indicate additional funding earned through over-compliance; negative values indicate funding clawback due to non-compliance.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compliance record was last updated. Tracks changes due to dispute resolution, data corrections, or status updates.

attributes.name: non_compliance_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the non-compliance root cause. Enables aggregated analysis of compliance failure patterns across retailers and promotions.

attributes.name: non_compliance_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the retailer failed to meet compliance requirements. Captures root cause details such as inventory shortage, operational error, pricing system failure, or deliberate non-execution.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text observations or context from the auditor. May include qualitative details about store conditions, retailer cooperation, or extenuating circumstances affecting compliance.

attributes.name: osa_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the promoted product was in stock and available on shelf during the promotional period. True = compliant (in stock), False = non-compliant (out of stock).

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The financial penalty or funding adjustment applied due to non-compliance. May be deducted from retailer rebate or future funding allocations. Null if fully compliant.

attributes.name: photo_evidence_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to photographic evidence captured during the compliance audit. Supports visual verification of display presence, pricing signage, shelf placement, and ad feature inclusion.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud - Retail Execution

attributes.name: pog_placement_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product was placed according to the agreed planogram specifications (shelf position, facings, adjacency). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: price_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retailer honored the agreed promotional price point (Hi-Lo or EDLP pricing strategy). True = compliant, False = non-compliant.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date when a disputed compliance record was resolved or when final compliance determination was made. Null if still pending or not disputed.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of a disputed compliance record. Upheld = original non-compliance finding stands, overturned = retailer dispute accepted and compliance restored, partial adjustment = compromise reached with reduced penalty, withdrawn = manufacturer withdrew the compliance claim.

products.name: baseline_volume
products.description: Transactional record capturing the statistical baseline volume estimate for a SKU-retailer-period combination, representing expected sales absent any promotional activity. Stores baseline volume (units/cases), baseline revenue, baseline methodology (moving average, regression, Nielsen IQ panel, Bayesian structural time series), data source, baseline period, confidence interval, last refresh date, analyst override flag, and model version. Serves as the reusable baseline denominator consumed by post_event_analysis for incremental lift calculation across all promotion events. Maintained independently of any single promotion event to enable consistent cross-event comparison and baseline trend monitoring.
products.reference: Promotional Baseline (Nielsen IQ, TradeEdge, SAP IBP)

attributes.name: baseline_status

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp

attributes.name: cases

attributes.name: confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: The upper bound of the confidence interval for the baseline volume estimate, representing statistical uncertainty.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: geography_code

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_refresh_date

attributes.name: model_accuracy_score
attributes.description: A statistical measure of the baseline model accuracy, such as R-squared or Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), represented as a decimal value.

attributes.name: model_version

attributes.name: override_reason

attributes.name: promotional_periods_excluded_count
attributes.description: The number of promotional periods that were excluded from the historical data when calculating the baseline volume.

attributes.name: seasonality_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The multiplicative factor applied to adjust for seasonal patterns in the baseline volume calculation.

attributes.name: tpm_system_reference_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Trade Promotion Management (TPM) System Reference ID
attributes.description: External reference identifier from the source Trade Promotion Management system (e.g., Salesforce TPM) for traceability.

attributes.name: trend_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: The multiplicative factor applied to adjust for long-term trend patterns in the baseline volume calculation.

attributes.name: units
attributes.description: The estimated baseline sales volume in units, representing expected sales absent any promotional activity.

attributes.name: offer_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the consumer offer for redemption tracking and identification. Used by consumers at point of sale or digital checkout.

attributes.name: offer_name
attributes.description: Marketing name or title of the consumer offer as displayed to consumers in promotional materials and digital channels.

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consumer offer. Draft = under development; Approved = ready for activation; Active = currently redeemable; Paused = temporarily suspended; Expired = validity period ended; Cancelled = terminated before expiration.

attributes.name: offer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consumer offer mechanism. Coupon = physical or digital coupon; Digital Offer = app-based or online promotion; Loyalty Reward = points-based redemption; Instant Rebate = immediate price reduction; Free Goods = complimentary product with purchase; BOGO = Buy One Get One; Bundle Discount = multi-product savings. attributes.name: qualifying_sku_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SKU identifiers or product codes that qualify for this offer. May reference specific products, product families, or categories. Null if offer applies to all products.

attributes.name: redemption_channel
attributes.description: Channel where the consumer can redeem the offer. In-Store = physical retail; Online = e-commerce website; Mobile App = DTC (Direct-to-Consumer) mobile application; Call Center = phone order; Any = omnichannel redemption allowed.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this offer can be combined with other offers or promotions. True = can be stacked; False = exclusive offer.

attributes.name: terms_and_conditions

attributes.name: total_budget_allocated
attributes.description: Total budget amount allocated for this consumer offer across all redemptions. Used for financial planning and spend tracking.

attributes.name: total_redemption_limit
