attributes.name: transferable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the offer can be transferred or shared between consumers. True = transferable; False = non-transferable, tied to original recipient.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date when the consumer offer becomes active and redeemable. Consumers cannot redeem the offer before this date.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date when the consumer offer expires and is no longer redeemable. Consumers cannot redeem the offer after this date.

domains.name: marketing
domains.description: Owns brand management, consumer engagement campaigns, digital marketing, and market research. Manages campaign planning, media spend, creative assets, influencer partnerships, social media engagement, marketing attribution, brand health metrics, SOV (Share of Voice), SOM, consumer sentiment analysis, and Nielsen IQ panel insights.

products.name: marketing_brand
products.description: Master record for each brand in the Consumer Goods portfolio. Captures brand identity, positioning, architecture tier (masterbrand, subbrand, endorsed), target consumer segment, brand equity scores, SOV (Share of Voice) benchmarks, brand health KPI targets, and lifecycle stage. Serves as the SSOT for brand master data referenced across campaign, media, and trade promotion domains.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the brand record. Primary key for the brand master data product.

attributes.name: parent_brand_marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent brand in the brand hierarchy. Null for masterbrand level. Used to establish brand family relationships and roll-up reporting.

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Brand Supplier Management: each brand designates a primary supplier for sourcing, required for supplier performance and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: annual_marketing_budget
attributes.description: Total allocated marketing investment for the brand for the fiscal year, including media spend, trade promotion, consumer promotion, and agency fees.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_target
attributes.description: Planned annual revenue goal for the brand in the base currency. Used for budget planning, performance tracking, and brand portfolio prioritization.

attributes.name: architecture_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the brand within the corporate brand architecture hierarchy. Masterbrand represents the corporate umbrella, subbrand is a distinct offering under the masterbrand, endorsed carries both corporate and product brand, ingredient brand is a component brand, private label is retailer-owned, and house brand is a proprietary store brand.

attributes.name: awareness_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who recognize or recall the brand when prompted or unprompted. Measured through consumer surveys and market research panels.

attributes.name: brand_category
attributes.description: Primary product category or market segment in which the brand competes. Examples include personal care, household cleaning, health and wellness, beauty, food and beverage.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code assigned to the brand for operational reference across systems. Used in SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) hierarchies, trade promotion systems, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the brand's purpose, value proposition, and positioning in the market. Used for internal reference and marketing brief development.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The official registered name of the brand as it appears on product packaging, marketing materials, and consumer-facing communications.

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Operational status of the brand. Active indicates current market presence with ongoing marketing investment, inactive is temporarily paused, pending launch is approved but not yet in market, under review is strategic assessment phase, sunset is planned phase-out, and archived is historical record only.

attributes.name: consideration_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who would consider purchasing the brand when making a category purchase decision. Key indicator of brand relevance and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was officially discontinued or withdrawn from active marketing. Null for active brands. Used for portfolio rationalization reporting and historical analysis.

attributes.name: equity_score
attributes.description: Composite metric measuring the overall strength and value of the brand based on consumer awareness, perceived quality, brand associations, and loyalty. Typically scaled 0-100 with higher scores indicating stronger brand equity.

attributes.name: geographic_market_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the brand's distribution and marketing activities. Global indicates worldwide presence, regional covers multiple countries in a region, national is single-country, and local is sub-national markets.

attributes.name: guidelines_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Guidelines Document Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the comprehensive brand guidelines document containing logo usage, color specifications, typography, tone of voice, and visual identity standards.

attributes.name: is_licensed_brand
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the brand is operated under a licensing agreement from another entity. True indicates licensed brand, false indicates owned brand.

attributes.name: is_private_label
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the brand is a private label or store brand owned by a retail customer rather than the manufacturer. True indicates private label, false indicates manufacturer-owned brand.

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: Date when the brand was first introduced to the market. Used for brand age calculations, anniversary campaigns, and lifecycle analysis.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the brand in its market lifecycle. Development indicates pre-launch planning, launch is initial market introduction, growth is rapid expansion phase, maturity is stable market presence, decline is decreasing market share, revitalization is strategic renewal effort, and discontinued indicates end of active marketing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: development|launch|growth|maturity|decline|revitalization|discontinued — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Brand Logo Asset Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: URL or file path to the official brand logo asset in the digital asset management system. Used for marketing materials, packaging design, and digital campaigns.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score measuring consumer willingness to recommend the brand to others. Calculated as percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors, ranging from -100 to +100.

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Legal entity or business unit that owns the intellectual property rights to the brand. May differ from the manufacturing or distribution entity.

attributes.name: positioning_statement
attributes.description: Concise statement defining the brand's unique value proposition, competitive differentiation, and emotional benefit to the target consumer. Foundation for all marketing communications.

attributes.name: preference_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of target consumers who prefer this brand over competitive alternatives. Indicates brand loyalty and pricing power potential.

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the primary brand color used in packaging, marketing materials, and digital assets. Ensures consistent brand identity across touchpoints.

attributes.name: primary_distribution_channel
attributes.description: Main channel through which the brand reaches consumers. Examples include mass retail, specialty retail, e-commerce, DTC (Direct to Consumer), professional/salon, or foodservice.

attributes.name: som_percent
attributes.description: Brand's percentage of total category sales volume or value. Primary metric for competitive market position and growth tracking.

attributes.name: sov_percent
attributes.description: Brand's share of total advertising and promotional activity within the category, measured across paid media, earned media, and owned channels. Key indicator of marketing investment relative to competitors.

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Specific subcategory within the broader brand category. Provides granular classification for competitive analysis and shelf placement strategy.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Third-party sustainability certifications or eco-labels associated with the brand, such as FSC (Forest Stewardship Council), RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil), or B Corp. Multiple certifications separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: FSC, RSPO, B Corp Certification Standards

attributes.name: target_consumer_segment
attributes.description: Primary demographic and psychographic profile of the intended consumer audience for the brand. Includes age range, income level, lifestyle attributes, and purchase behaviors.

attributes.name: target_som_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's market share. Used for annual planning, performance evaluation, and resource allocation decisions.

attributes.name: target_sov_percent
attributes.description: Strategic target for the brand's share of voice in the category. Used for media planning and budget allocation decisions. Typically set to exceed current SOM (Share of Market) to drive growth.

attributes.name: trademark_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current trademark registration expires and requires renewal. Critical for maintaining legal protection of brand assets.

attributes.name: trademark_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Geographic territories or countries where the brand trademark is registered and legally protected. May include multiple jurisdictions separated by semicolons.
attributes.references: WIPO Madrid System for International Trademark Registration

attributes.name: trademark_registration_date
attributes.description: Date when the trademark was officially registered with the relevant trademark authority. Used for renewal tracking and IP portfolio management.

attributes.name: trademark_registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number assigned by the trademark authority for the brand name, logo, or other protected brand elements. Used for legal protection and IP (Intellectual Property) management.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial value of the brand as an intangible asset. Calculated using income, market, or cost approaches for financial reporting and M&A (Mergers and Acquisitions) purposes.

products.name: campaign
products.description: Master record for each marketing campaign executed by Consumer Goods. Captures campaign name, type (ATL, BTL, digital, shopper, influencer, integrated), objective, target audience, brand association, channel mix, planned vs. actual media spend, campaign start/end dates, creative concept, campaign status, and owning brand/category. Sourced from Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and internal campaign management systems.
products.reference: Campaign Management / Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: category_id

attributes.name: primary_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Campaign planning and ROI attribution need a primary SKU reference to allocate budget and measure lift per product.

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_claim. Pre-launch regulatory clearance requi

attributes.name: sales_rep_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.rep. Business justification: Campaigns are owned by a sales rep responsible for execution and alignment with sales activities.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Campaign Sponsorship Procurement: marketing campaigns often have a sponsoring supplier; linking enables sponsor spend tracking and ROI calculation.

attributes.name: target_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the predefined consumer segment this campaign is designed to reach. Links to consumer segmentation master data.

attributes.name: territory_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign concluded. May differ from planned end date due to extensions, early termination, or performance-based adjustments.

attributes.name: actual_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual total media spend incurred for this campaign, in the company's reporting currency. Includes all paid media costs across channels.

attributes.name: actual_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost incurred for creative production, including all content creation, design, video production, and asset development expenses.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: The actual date the campaign went live and began execution. May differ from planned start date due to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign was formally approved for execution by authorized stakeholders, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: campaign_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify and track the campaign across systems, media buys, and analytics platforms.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards for Product and Campaign Identification

attributes.name: campaign_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the campaign's purpose, strategy, key messages, and expected outcomes.

attributes.name: campaign_name
attributes.description: The official name or title of the marketing campaign as used in internal planning and external communications.

attributes.name: campaign_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the campaign: draft (initial planning), planned (scheduled), approved (ready for execution), active (currently running), paused (temporarily suspended), completed (finished), or cancelled (terminated before completion). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|planned|approved|active|paused|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: campaign_type
attributes.description: Classification of the campaign by execution approach: ATL (Above The Line - mass media), BTL (Below The Line - targeted), digital (online channels), shopper (in-store/retail), influencer (social media partnerships), or integrated (multi-channel).

attributes.name: channel_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of marketing channels used in the campaign (e.g., TV, digital display, social media, print, radio, OOH, in-store).

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where the campaign is executed (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: creative_concept
attributes.description: High-level description of the creative theme, messaging strategy, and visual identity used in the campaign.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this campaign record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: Geographic reach of the campaign: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country region), national (single country), or local (city/metro area).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the campaign is currently active (True) or inactive (False). Active campaigns are either running or scheduled to run.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this campaign record was last updated or modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: objective
attributes.description: Primary business goal of the campaign: awareness (brand visibility), consideration (product evaluation), conversion (purchase), loyalty (retention), launch (new product introduction), or relaunch (product refresh).

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign conclusion as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: planned_media_spend_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted total media spend allocated to this campaign during the planning phase, in the company's reporting currency.

attributes.name: planned_production_cost_amount
attributes.description: The budgeted cost for creative production, including content creation, design, video production, and asset development.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: The originally scheduled date for campaign launch as defined during planning phase.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this campaign record originated (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud, internal campaign management system).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this campaign in the source operational system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: target_audience
attributes.description: Textual description of the intended consumer segment for this campaign, including demographic, psychographic, and behavioral characteristics.

products.name: campaign_flight
products.description: Transactional record of campaign execution at the flight level, capturing performance metrics across ALL channels (digital, TV, OOH, print, social, search, programmatic) at the campaign-channel-market-date grain. Defines scheduled media run dates, channel, market/geography, budget allocation, and flight-level performance targets. Captures planned and actual impressions, clicks, CTR, video views, view-through rate, conversions, CPC, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency, GRPs (traditional), and platform-specific metrics (Meta, Google, TikTok, programmatic DSP). A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies. Sourced from digital ad platform APIs, agency post-buy reports, and media monitoring systems. Serves as the unified granular performance record for omnichannel campaign measurement.

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the campaign flight record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: FK to marketing.agency

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent marketing campaign. A single campaign may have multiple flights across different channels or geographies.

attributes.name: consumer_segment_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.retail_store. Business justification: Flight schedules are executed at individual retail stores; linking flight to store enables store‑level media execution tracking and OTIF reporting.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Flight-level SKU attribution reporting: in consumer goods, individual media flights are often executed for specific SKU launches or hero SKUs. Linking flight to SKU enables SKU-level ROAS and conversi

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution ended. Captures real execution timeline for post-campaign analysis.

attributes.name: actual_impressions
attributes.description: Actual number of impressions delivered during the flight. Core metric for reach and frequency analysis.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the flight media execution began. Used for variance analysis against planned schedule.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: Attribution methodology used to assign conversion credit to this flight. Critical for multi-touch attribution analysis.

attributes.name: budget_allocated_amount
attributes.description: Total budget allocated to this flight. Represents the planned media spend for this specific flight execution.

attributes.name: budget_spent_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount spent on this flight. Used for budget variance analysis and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) calculation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary media channel for this flight execution. Supports omnichannel campaign measurement across digital, TV, out-of-home, print, social media, and search.

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of clicks generated by the flight. Primary engagement metric for digital and search campaigns.

attributes.name: conversion_rate
attributes.description: Conversion rate expressed as a decimal (conversions divided by clicks or impressions). Measures campaign effectiveness in driving desired actions.

attributes.name: conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions attributed to this flight. Conversion definition varies by campaign objective (purchase, sign-up, download, etc.).

attributes.name: cpa
attributes.description: Average cost per conversion for this flight. Critical metric for performance marketing and Return on Investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: cpc
attributes.description: Average cost per click for this flight. Key efficiency metric for paid search and digital campaigns.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: ctr
attributes.description: Click-through rate expressed as a decimal (clicks divided by impressions). Key performance indicator for digital campaign effectiveness.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this flight record.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Source system or platform from which performance data was captured (e.g., Meta API, Google Ads API, agency post-buy report, Nielsen IQ). Used for data lineage and quality assessment.

attributes.name: flight_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the campaign flight for business user identification and reporting.

attributes.name: flight_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the flight within the campaign. Used for external reporting and agency coordination.

attributes.name: flight_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the campaign flight.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Average number of times an individual was exposed to the campaign (impressions divided by reach). Measures message repetition.

attributes.name: grp
attributes.description: Gross Rating Points for traditional media (TV, radio, OOH). Measures total audience delivery as a percentage of target population multiplied by frequency.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this flight record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: market_geography
attributes.description: Geographic market or region where the flight is executed. Supports market-level performance tracking and regional campaign optimization.

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Date on which performance metrics were measured or reported. Supports daily granular performance tracking at the campaign-channel-market-date grain.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the flight execution, performance anomalies, or special circumstances. Supports qualitative context for quantitative performance data.

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Specific placement or ad format type within the channel (e.g., banner, video, native, sponsored post, display, search text ad). Enables placement-level optimization.

attributes.name: platform
attributes.description: Specific advertising platform or network (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, programmatic DSP, linear TV network). Enables platform-specific performance analysis.

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Product category or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) group being promoted. Supports category-level marketing effectiveness analysis.

attributes.name: reach
attributes.description: Estimated number of unique individuals exposed to the campaign flight. Used for audience coverage analysis.

attributes.name: roas
attributes.description: Return on Ad Spend expressed as a ratio (revenue generated divided by ad spend). Primary metric for campaign profitability assessment.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_date
attributes.description: Planned end date for the flight media run. Defines the flight duration for budget allocation and performance measurement.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the flight media run. Used for campaign planning and scheduling.

attributes.name: target_impressions
attributes.description: Planned number of impressions for this flight. Used for media planning and performance target setting.

attributes.name: video_completion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of video views that were completed (watched to end). Measures creative engagement quality.

attributes.name: video_views
attributes.description: Total number of video views for video creative flights. Applicable to digital video, social, and TV campaigns.

products.name: brand_health_tracker
products.description: Consolidated periodic brand performance scorecard capturing all consumer perception, market position, competitive share, media share, and social sentiment metrics for a brand in a specific market and time period. Captures awareness (spontaneous, aided), consideration, preference, purchase intent, NPS, brand equity index, SOV% (Share of Voice by channel — TV, digital, OOH, social), SOM% (value share, volume share by category/channel/geography), total category spend, competitor benchmarks, social sentiment scores (positive/neutral/negative breakdown), mention volume, share of conversation, platform distribution, net sentiment score, and key image attribute scores. Sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel/Kantar media monitoring (SOV), Nielsen IQ Retail Measurement/Circana (SOM), proprietary brand tracking studies (awareness/equity), and social listening platforms (sentiment). Serves as the single authoritative brand scorecard enabling longitudinal brand health monitoring, SOV vs. SOM gap analysis, competitive benchmarking, market share trend tracking, and sentiment trend analysis.

products.name: gl_account

products.name: ledger
products.description: Financial ledger master defining the accounting ledgers maintained in the enterprise — leading ledger (IFRS/GAAP), parallel ledgers for local GAAP, and extension ledgers for management reporting. Each ledger record captures ledger type, accounting principle, currency type, fiscal year variant, and posting period variant. Supports multi-GAAP reporting requirements common in global CPG companies operating across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI batch processing, Oracle Cloud GL_INTERFACE

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Code representing the business area or division for cross-company code reporting. Used for consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which this open item was cleared. Used for DSO and DIO calculation. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-AUGDT, DSO/DIO tracking

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing document if this open item has been cleared (paid or offset). Used for accounts payable and receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BSEG-AUGBL, DSO/DIO tracking

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: Organizational unit in management accounting that represents a closed system for cost accounting. Used for internal management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO controlling area, Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the document currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated. Examples: USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice, receipt, payment voucher). May differ from posting date. Used for document control and audit trail. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BLDAT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the accounting document within the company code and fiscal year. This is the externally visible business key for the journal entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BELNR, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_HEADERS.JE_HEADER_ID

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification code indicating the nature and source of the journal entry. Examples: SA (General Ledger Document), AB (Accounting Document), KR (Vendor Invoice), DR (Customer Invoice), DZ (Customer Payment), KA (Vendor Payment), KG (Vendor Credit Memo), KN (Customer Credit Memo), KZ (Payment Request), RE (Invoice Receipt), RV (Invoice Reversal), WA (Goods Issue), WE (Goods Receipt), ZP (Payment Posting). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|KR|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KZ|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was created or entered into the system. Used for audit trail and process monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-CPUDT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert document currency amounts to local currency. Expressed as local currency per one unit of document currency. Null if document currency equals local currency.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_type
attributes.description: Code indicating the type of exchange rate used for currency translation. Examples: M (Average Rate), B (Bank Buying Rate), G (Bank Selling Rate), P (Posting Date Rate).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Numeric period within the fiscal year (typically 1-12 for monthly periods, or 1-13 for year-end adjustments). Determines the reporting period for financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-MONAT, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year representing the fiscal year to which this journal entry is assigned. Used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-GJAHR, IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Code classifying the journal entry by functional area (e.g., Production, Sales, Administration, R&D). Used for cost of goods sold (COGS) allocation and functional expense reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO BSEG-FKBER, COGS allocation, EBITDA reporting

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information or explanation about the journal entry. Used for documentation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BKTXT, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between different company codes within the enterprise. True if intercompany, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI intercompany processing, IFRS 10, US GAAP ASC 810

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger or accounting principle under which this entry is recorded. Examples: 0L (Leading Ledger - IFRS), 2L (Local GAAP), 3L (Management Reporting). Supports parallel accounting for multiple reporting standards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI New GL RLDNR, IFRS, US GAAP

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the company code local currency. All amounts are translated to this currency for statutory reporting.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for tracking changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms applicable to this document (e.g., Net 30, 2/10 Net 30). Used for cash flow forecasting and DSO tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-ZTERM, DSO calculation

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and determines the fiscal period assignment. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-BUDAT, IFRS IAS 1, US GAAP ASC 205

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry. Values: draft (entry created but not posted), posted (entry successfully posted to GL), parked (entry saved for later posting), cancelled (entry voided before posting), reversed (entry reversed by a subsequent document).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI workflow status, Oracle Cloud GL_JE_HEADERS.STATUS

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a previous entry. True if this is a reversal document, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STBLG, US GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for reversing the original document. Examples: 01 (Reversal in Current Period), 02 (Reversal in Next Period), 03 (Correction), 04 (Accrual Reversal), 05 (Error Correction), 06 (Period-End Adjustment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 01|02|03|04|05|06|07|08|09 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STGRD, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original journal entry that is being reversed by this entry. Populated only when reversal_indicator is True.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-STBLG, US GAAP ASC 250

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this journal entry originated. Examples: SAP_FI (SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting), SAP_CO (SAP Controlling), ORACLE_GL (Oracle Cloud General Ledger), ORACLE_AP (Oracle Accounts Payable), ORACLE_AR (Oracle Accounts Receivable), SFDC (Salesforce), WMS (Warehouse Management System), MES (Manufacturing Execution System). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAP_FI|SAP_CO|ORACLE_GL|ORACLE_AP|ORACLE_AR|SFDC|WMS|MES — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is subject to SOX internal control testing and audit procedures. True if SOX-controlled, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, COSO Internal Control Framework, PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: tax_reporting_date
attributes.description: The date relevant for tax reporting purposes. May differ from posting date based on tax jurisdiction rules. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI tax date, IRS Publication 538, EU VAT Directive

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the intercompany trading partner if this is an intercompany transaction. Used for consolidation and elimination entries. Null if not an intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: transaction_code
attributes.description: SAP transaction code or Oracle program identifier used to create this journal entry. Examples: FB01 (Post Document), FB50 (G/L Account Posting), MIRO (Enter Invoice), F-28 (Post Incoming Payments). Used for audit trail and process analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI BKPF-TCODE, SOX Section 404

Enables granular cost allocation, COGS decomposition, and audit trail tracing at the line level as required by SOX compliance.

attributes.name: amount_group_currency
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the group reporting currency. Enables consolidated financial reporting across all subsidiaries.

attributes.name: amount_transaction_currency

attributes.name: assignment_field

attributes.name: baseline_payment_date

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Enables consolidated financial statements by business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Business Area Accounting

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this open item was cleared or settled. Null if the item remains open.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Open Item Management

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that settled this open item. Null if the item remains open.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Open Item Management

attributes.name: company_code_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the company code local currency. Typically the statutory reporting currency of the legal entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number for revenue and receivables postings. Links financial transactions to customer master data.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental to double-entry bookkeeping and account balance calculation.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is due for payables or expected for receivables. Critical for DSO and cash flow management.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert transaction currency to company code or group currency. Critical for currency translation audit trail.

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification (e.g., production, sales, administration, R&D). Supports cost-of-sales accounting and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: group_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the group reporting currency. Typically USD or EUR for multinational consumer goods companies.

attributes.name: internal_order_number
attributes.description: Internal order for tracking costs of short-term jobs, events, or overhead activities. Enables job costing and overhead allocation.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry header. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the document.

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: posting_key

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of material or units associated with this line item. Enables unit cost calculation and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External or internal document number referenced by this line (e.g., invoice, purchase order, contract). Supports document linkage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this is a reversal entry.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original entry that this line reverses. Null if this is not a reversal.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Special GL indicator for down payments, bills of exchange, guarantees, or other special transactions. Enables special ledger processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Special GL Transactions

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Storage location within the plant for inventory-related postings. Enables warehouse-level inventory tracking and valuation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in transaction currency. Supports VAT, sales tax, and other indirect tax reporting.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code determining the tax treatment of this line item. Drives automatic tax calculation and tax reporting compliance.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Descriptive text explaining the nature or purpose of this journal entry line. Provides human-readable context for audit and review.

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the intercompany trading partner for intercompany transactions. Enables intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount. Identifies the currency in which the original transaction was denominated.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field (e.g., EA, KG, LT). Standardizes quantity representation across transactions.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Value date for cash management and bank reconciliation. Represents the effective date for interest calculation and cash position.

attributes.name: vendor_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor account number for procurement and payables postings. Links financial transactions to vendor master data.

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: WBS element for project-related postings. Links costs and revenues to specific projects, phases, or deliverables in project accounting.

products.name: ar_invoice
products.description: Accounts receivable master record representing the full trade receivable lifecycle for consumer goods sales to retailers, distributors, and wholesalers. Owns invoice creation, payment terms, cash receipt application, partial payments, deductions/short-payments, clearing, and write-offs. Captures invoice number, billing date, due date, payment terms, gross amount, trade discounts, net amount, tax, currency, payment method, payment date, amount received, clearing reference, DSO aging bucket, dunning level, and deduction reason codes. The single source of truth for all receivable balances, cash application, deduction management, DSO tracking, cash flow forecasting, and revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA SD billing and FI-AR.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the accounts receivable invoice record. Primary key for the AR invoice entity.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: AR invoices are issued by a specific legal entity (company code). Normalizing the existing company_code STRING to a FK ensures referential integrity with the company_code master.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AR invoices reference GL accounts by code; adding FK normalizes accounting data.

attributes.name: sales_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.invoice. Business justification: AR invoice reconciliation process matches each AR invoice to the originating sales invoice for cash application.

attributes.name: sales_order_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the trade account (customer) to whom this invoice was issued. Links to the customer master record.

attributes.name: amount_received
attributes.description: Total amount received from the customer against this invoice. May be less than total amount due to partial payments or deductions. Null for unpaid invoices.

attributes.name: billing_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was created and issued to the customer. Principal business event timestamp for the invoice lifecycle.

attributes.name: billing_document_type
attributes.description: SAP billing document type code indicating the nature of the invoice (e.g., F2=standard invoice, G2=credit memo, L2=debit memo). Determines accounting treatment and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Billing Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was cleared in the financial system, either through full payment or write-off. Null for open invoices.

attributes.name: clearing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned when the invoice is cleared in the financial system. Links to the clearing document for audit trail. Null for open invoices.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the AR system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Critical for multi-currency reporting and foreign exchange management.

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of deductions taken by the customer against this invoice. Includes short-payments, chargebacks, and unauthorized deductions requiring resolution.

attributes.name: deduction_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for customer deductions (e.g., pricing dispute, damaged goods, short shipment, promotional allowance). Used for deduction root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Deduction Reason Code Master

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is currently under dispute by the customer. True if disputed, false otherwise. Disputed invoices are excluded from standard collection processes.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the customer is disputing the invoice. Used for dispute resolution and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the goods were sold (e.g., retail, wholesale, DTC, e-commerce). Used for channel profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Distribution Channel Master

attributes.name: dso_aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging category based on number of days the invoice has been outstanding past the due date. Used for DSO reporting, collections prioritization, and bad debt provisioning.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment is expected from the customer based on agreed payment terms. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation and dunning.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: Current dunning level indicating the escalation stage of collection efforts (0=no dunning, 1=first reminder, 2=second reminder, etc.). Higher levels indicate more aggressive collection actions.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the invoice was posted. Used for monthly financial reporting and trend analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the invoice was posted. Used for year-over-year financial analysis and annual reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Used for financial period assignment and month-end close processes.

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any trade discounts, deductions, or adjustments. Represents the full billed value of goods or services.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique invoice number assigned by the billing system. Used for customer communication and payment reference.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Billing Document Number

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the accounts receivable process. Tracks progression from open through payment to clearing or write-off. attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent dunning notice was sent to the customer. Used to track collection activity frequency and determine next dunning action.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the invoice record. Required for SOX compliance and segregation of duties controls.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was last modified. Used for change tracking and SOX compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Invoice amount after trade discounts but before tax. This is the base amount subject to taxation and the primary value for revenue recognition.

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Calculated as total amount minus amount received. Zero when invoice is fully paid or cleared.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when payment was received from the customer. Null for unpaid invoices. Used for DSO calculation and cash flow analysis.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the customer is expected to remit payment. Used for cash application automation and payment reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the customer (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Determines due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue from this invoice is recognized in the financial statements under ASC 606/IFRS 15. May differ from billing date based on performance obligation fulfillment.

attributes.name: sales_organization
attributes.description: SAP sales organization responsible for the sale. Used for sales performance reporting and commission calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Master

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice, including sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable indirect taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final invoice amount including all discounts and taxes. This is the total amount due from the customer and the target for cash application.

attributes.name: trade_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total trade discounts applied to the invoice, including volume discounts, promotional allowances, and negotiated rebates. Reduces gross amount to net amount.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount written off as uncollectible bad debt. Null for invoices not written off. Impacts bad debt expense and allowance for doubtful accounts.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date when the invoice or portion thereof was written off as uncollectible. Null for invoices not written off.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for write-off (e.g., customer bankruptcy, uncollectible, small balance write-off). Used for bad debt analysis and credit policy refinement.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status for this standard cost estimate. Ensures proper governance and SOX compliance for cost changes.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the manager or controller who approved this standard cost estimate. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this standard cost estimate was approved. Critical for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: The BOM usage type (e.g., production, costing, engineering) that was used as the basis for material cost calculation in this estimate.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_created_by

attributes.name: cost_estimate_created_timestamp

attributes.description: The date and time when this standard cost record was last modified in the source system. Critical for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: cost_estimate_number
attributes.description: The unique business identifier for the cost estimate document in the source ERP system. Used for audit trail and traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Estimate Number

attributes.name: cost_variance_amount
attributes.description: The absolute difference between the current standard cost and the previous standard cost. Positive indicates cost increase, negative indicates cost decrease.

attributes.name: cost_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage change in standard cost compared to the previous period. Calculated as (current - previous) / previous * 100.

attributes.name: costing_lot_size
attributes.description: The production lot size (quantity) used as the basis for calculating the standard cost. Fixed costs are spread over this quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Costing Lot Size

attributes.name: costing_lot_size_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Costing Lot Size Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the costing lot size (e.g., EA, KG, L, CS). Must align with the materials base unit of measure.

attributes.name: costing_sheet
attributes.description: The costing sheet identifier that defines the overhead calculation rules and surcharge rates applied in this cost estimate.

attributes.name: costing_type
attributes.description: The type of cost estimate: standard (for inventory valuation), planned (for budgeting), actual (for variance analysis), or simulated (for what-if scenarios).

attributes.name: costing_version
attributes.description: The costing version identifier that groups standard cost estimates for a specific planning or valuation scenario (e.g., current year, budget, simulation). Enables parallel costing scenarios.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the standard cost is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: direct_labor_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for direct production labor (machine operators, line workers) allocated to one unit based on standard labor hours and rates.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for which this standard cost estimate is applicable. Enables period-specific cost tracking.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this standard cost estimate is applicable. Standard costs are typically set annually and used for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fixed_overhead_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for fixed manufacturing overhead (plant management, utilities, rent) allocated to one unit based on the costing lot size.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Split

attributes.name: freight_in_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for inbound freight and logistics to bring raw materials and packaging to the plant, allocated to one unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Split

attributes.name: machine_overhead_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for machine and equipment overhead (depreciation, maintenance, energy) allocated to one unit based on machine hours.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Split

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this standard cost estimate, such as assumptions, special considerations, or reasons for cost changes.

attributes.name: packaging_material_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for packaging materials (primary, secondary, tertiary) used for one unit. Critical for CPG cost structure analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Split

attributes.name: previous_standard_cost
attributes.description: The total standard cost from the prior costing period or version. Used for variance analysis and cost trend reporting.

attributes.name: raw_material_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for raw materials consumed in the production of one unit. Key input for COGS and margin analysis.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date when this standard cost estimate was officially released and became active for inventory valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: The lifecycle status of the standard cost record: draft (under development), released (active for valuation), locked (frozen for audit), or archived (historical).

attributes.name: routing_usage
attributes.description: The routing usage type (e.g., production, costing) that was used as the basis for labor and machine cost calculation in this estimate.

attributes.name: total_standard_cost
attributes.description: The total standard cost per unit of the material, summing all cost components (raw material, packaging, labor, overhead, freight). This is the authoritative cost for inventory valuation and COGS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Standard Cost Estimate

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which this standard cost estimate is effective. Used for time-dependent cost valuation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The end date until which this standard cost estimate is effective. Nullable for open-ended validity.

attributes.name: valuation_variant
attributes.description: The valuation variant that defines the costing methodology and cost component structure used for this estimate (e.g., full costing, marginal costing).

attributes.name: variable_overhead_cost
attributes.description: The cost component for variable manufacturing overhead (indirect materials, supplies, variable utilities) allocated to one unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PC Cost Component Split

products.name: finance_budget
products.description: Financial budget record for the consumer goods enterprise covering annual, rolling, and zero-based budgets at both summary and line-item granularity. Captures budget version (original, revised, latest estimate), fiscal year, period, company code, cost center, profit center, GL account, cost element, product line, channel, planned quantity, planned amount in local and group currency, budget category (opex, capex, headcount), approval status, budget owner, and justification notes. Supports S&OP/IBP financial integration, variance-to-budget reporting, EBITDA bridge analysis, ZBB, and activity-based costing methodologies. Managed in SAP S/4HANA CO and Oracle Cloud Financials.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: Fixed asset master and lifecycle record for capital assets owned by the consumer goods enterprise — manufacturing equipment, production lines, warehouse automation, vehicles, buildings, and IT infrastructure. Covers the full asset lifecycle: acquisition, capitalization, depreciation, transfer, revaluation, impairment, and disposal. Captures asset class, description, acquisition date/cost, useful life, depreciation method, accumulated depreciation, net book value, plant/location, responsible cost center, and all transaction events (transaction type, posting date, amount, document reference, originating business process). Supports capex tracking, depreciation run reconciliation, asset lifecycle audit trail, and SOX-compliant fixed asset management. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI-AA and Oracle Cloud Fixed Assets.

Critical for consolidated financial reporting, transfer pricing compliance, intercompany elimination in group close, and regulatory documentation under OECD transfer pricing guidelines.

attributes.name: business_area_code

attributes.name: clearing_date

attributes.name: clearing_document_number

attributes.name: created_by_user

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: document_date

attributes.name: due_date

attributes.name: elimination_flag

attributes.name: exchange_rate

attributes.name: fiscal_year

attributes.name: group_currency_amount

attributes.name: group_currency_code

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: netting_status

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: posting_date

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction. Represents the crediting entity in the intercompany posting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_reference

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: sox_control_flag

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code

attributes.references: GS1 Country Codes / Internal Tax Master

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency, before any adjustments or eliminations.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code

attributes.name: transaction_description

attributes.name: transaction_document_number

attributes.name: transaction_status

attributes.name: transaction_type

attributes.name: transfer_price
attributes.description: The price charged for goods or services in this intercompany transaction, established according to the company's transfer pricing policy.

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method

attributes.name: variance_amount

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Revenue recognition event record capturing the timing and amount of revenue recognized under ASC 606 / IFRS 15 for consumer goods sales transactions. Stores performance obligation ID, contract reference, recognition date, recognition method (point-in-time vs over-time), recognized revenue amount, deferred revenue amount, variable consideration estimate (trade promotions, rebates, returns), constraint applied flag, and cumulative catch-up adjustment. Supports compliant revenue reporting and audit trail for complex CPG revenue arrangements.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Primary key for revenue_recognition

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Revenue recognition events are scoped to a specific legal entity (company code) for ASC 606 compliance. Normalizing the existing company_code STRING to a FK ensures referential integrity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id

Consumer goods finance teams require this link to tie revenue recognition events to specific di

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer invoice associated with this revenue recognition event.

attributes.name: original_event_revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original revenue recognition event ID if this record is a reversal or adjustment.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition events are attributed to profit centers for segment revenue reporting under ASC 606. The existing profit_center_code STRING column should be normalized to a proper FK referencing t

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_registration. Business justification: Under ASC 606/IFRS 15, revenue for regulated consumer goods products cannot be recognized until the product holds valid market registration. Linking revenue_recognition to regulatory_registration enab

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or transaction that triggered this revenue recognition event.

attributes.name: sku_id

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer or trade account for whom revenue is being recognized.

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who approved this revenue recognition event for posting.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue recognition event was approved for posting.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the audit trail or approval workflow associated with this revenue recognition event.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Sales channel through which the transaction occurred (e.g., retail, e-commerce, wholesale, DSD).

attributes.name: constraint_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a constraint was applied to the variable consideration estimate to prevent revenue reversal in future periods.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this revenue recognition event record.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue recognition event record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_catch_up_adjustment
attributes.description: Cumulative catch-up adjustment to revenue recognized in prior periods due to changes in estimates of variable consideration or performance obligation satisfaction.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which revenue amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue deferred to future periods because the performance obligation has not yet been satisfied.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Unique accounting document number assigned to the revenue recognition journal entry in the financial system.

attributes.name: estimated_returns_reserve
attributes.description: Reserve amount set aside for estimated product returns based on historical return rates and current sales.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which the revenue recognition event occurred.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the revenue recognition event occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this revenue recognition event record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this revenue recognition event record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context or justification for the revenue recognition treatment applied.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the revenue recognition entry was posted to the general ledger.

attributes.name: product_line_code
attributes.description: Product line or category code for the goods or services being recognized.

attributes.name: rebate_accrual
attributes.description: Accrued rebate amount expected to be paid to the customer based on volume or performance thresholds.

attributes.name: recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue is recognized in the financial statements under ASC 606 or IFRS 15. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: Method by which revenue is recognized: point-in-time (at delivery or transfer of control) or over-time (as performance obligation is satisfied over a period).

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event: draft (pending approval), posted (finalized in GL), reversed (cancelled), or adjusted (modified after posting).

attributes.name: recognized_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The amount of revenue recognized in this event after applying all constraints and adjustments.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event is a reversal or correction of a previously recognized amount.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this revenue recognition event originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle Cloud Financials).

attributes.name: sox_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event complies with SOX internal control requirements and has passed all required approval workflows.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from transaction price due to trade promotion allowances, discounts, or incentives provided to customers.

attributes.name: transaction_price
attributes.description: Total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation before adjustments for variable consideration.

attributes.name: variable_consideration_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated amount of variable consideration including trade promotions, rebates, volume discounts, returns, and other price concessions that reduce the transaction price.

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Owns transportation management, freight optimization, and delivery execution across inbound and outbound networks. Manages carrier contracts, shipment planning, route optimization, freight audit, track-and-trace, 3PL coordination, proof of delivery, cold-chain compliance, and transportation cost tracking. Distinct from distribution (warehouse-focused) — logistics covers inter-facility and last-mile movement.

products.name: carrier
products.description: Master record for all transportation carriers (trucking, rail, ocean, air, parcel) contracted by Consumer Goods. Captures carrier identity, SCAC/IATA codes, carrier type, service modes, geographic coverage, insurance certificates, safety ratings (FMCSA/DOT), EDI capability flags, and contractual status. SSOT for carrier identity referenced by shipments, freight orders, contracts, and invoices across inbound and outbound networks.
products.reference: SCAC (Standard Carrier Alpha Code) / IATA Carrier Code

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the transportation carrier record in the Consumer Goods logistics master data. Primary key for all carrier-related references across shipments, freight orders, contracts, and invoices.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standards; SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Master

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Carrier compliance management requires linking carriers to their primary operating jurisdiction for regulatory authority validation (FMCSA, DOT, EU transport regulations). Consumer Goods logistics tea

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corresponding vendor/supplier master record in the ERP system (SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud ERP) for this carrier. Links the carrier master to the procurement and accounts payable vendor record for freight invoice processing and payment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1); Oracle Cloud Procurement Supplier

attributes.name: api_tracking_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides a real-time shipment tracking API for track-and-trace integration. Enables automated shipment status updates in the TMS without manual EDI 214 processing. Used in carrier technology capability assessment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Integration Framework; SAP S/4HANA TM Track and Trace

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier in the Consumer Goods approved carrier program. Active carriers are eligible for shipment tendering. Suspended carriers are temporarily blocked pending compliance review. Blacklisted carriers are permanently disqualified. Drives carrier selection eligibility in TMS routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Status; FMCSA Compliance Review

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Primary transportation mode classification of the carrier. Drives rate card selection, shipment planning rules, and EDI transaction sets. TL (Truckload), LTL (Less-Than-Truckload), parcel, rail, ocean, air, intermodal, and courier are the standard classifications in consumer goods logistics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|less_than_truckload|parcel|rail|ocean|air|intermodal|courier — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Transport Mode Codes; SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Type; Blue Yonder WMS Carrier Classification

attributes.name: cold_chain_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has certified temperature-controlled transportation capability (refrigerated or frozen) for cold-chain compliant shipments of health, hygiene, and personal care products requiring temperature management. Critical for product safety and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDP (Good Distribution Practice) Guidelines

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the current master transportation services agreement. Triggers contract renewal workflows and rate renegotiation processes. Shipment tendering to the carrier may be restricted after this date if no renewal is in place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Oracle Cloud Procurement Contracts

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current master transportation services agreement between Consumer Goods and the carrier. Defines the period during which contracted rates and service commitments are valid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Oracle Cloud Procurement Contracts

attributes.name: country_of_registration
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the carrier is legally registered and incorporated. Used for cross-border compliance checks, customs documentation, and carrier eligibility for specific trade lanes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier master record was first created in the Consumer Goods logistics data platform. Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX IT General Controls; ISO 9001 Record Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which freight rates and invoices are denominated for this carrier. Used in multi-currency freight cost management, FX conversion, and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the U.S. Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) to commercial motor carriers operating in interstate commerce. Required for regulatory compliance verification and safety rating lookup. Mandatory for US-based trucking carriers.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 390; U.S. DOT Registration

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the carrier's business entity globally. Used for supplier risk assessment, credit verification, and EDI trading partner identification.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Registry; GS1 GLN Standards; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) for automated exchange of shipment tenders (204), load tenders (990), shipment status (214), and freight invoices (210). EDI-capable carriers are preferred for high-volume automated tendering in the TMS.
attributes.references: ANSI ASC X12 EDI Standards; GS1 EDI Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA TM EDI Configuration

attributes.name: edi_code
attributes.description: Carrier's EDI interchange identifier used in the ISA segment of X12 EDI transactions. Combined with the EDI qualifier, this uniquely identifies the carrier as an EDI trading partner. Required for automated tender and status message routing.
attributes.references: ANSI ASC X12 ISA Segment Specification; SAP S/4HANA TM EDI Partner Profile

attributes.name: edi_qualifier
attributes.description: Two-digit qualifier code identifying the type of EDI sender/receiver identifier used in ISA segment of X12 EDI transactions (e.g., 02 = DUNS, 08 = UCC/EAN, ZZ = Mutually Defined). Required for EDI trading partner setup and message routing.
attributes.references: ANSI ASC X12 ISA Segment Specification; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: fmcsa_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current FMCSA safety rating was issued or last updated. Used to assess rating currency and trigger re-evaluation workflows when ratings are older than the compliance review threshold.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 385; FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS)

attributes.name: fmcsa_safety_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) Safety Rating
