attributes.description: Official safety fitness rating assigned by the FMCSA to motor carriers based on compliance reviews and safety audits. Satisfactory rating is required for carrier approval in Consumer Goods' carrier program. Conditional or Unsatisfactory ratings trigger carrier review or suspension. Mandatory compliance field for US trucking carriers.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 385; FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS)

attributes.name: geographic_coverage
attributes.description: Description of the carrier's operational geographic coverage scope, including regions, countries, or trade lanes served. Used in TMS routing logic to filter eligible carriers by origin-destination pair. Examples: 'Continental US', 'US-Canada cross-border', 'Trans-Pacific', 'EU domestic'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Transportation Lane; Blue Yonder WMS Carrier Zone Configuration

attributes.name: hazmat_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the carrier's hazardous materials transportation certification. Triggers compliance alerts and blocks HAZMAT shipment tendering to the carrier if certification has lapsed.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; FMCSA HAZMAT Registration

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds valid certification to transport hazardous materials (HAZMAT) as defined by DOT 49 CFR. Required for shipments of aerosols, flammable products, and chemical-based consumer goods. Validated against DOT HAZMAT registration database.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA RCRA

attributes.name: headquarters_address
attributes.description: Full street address of the carrier's principal place of business or corporate headquarters. Used for legal correspondence, contract execution, and regulatory filings. Includes street, city, state/province, postal code, and country.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration; GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master Address

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Carrier Code
attributes.description: 2-3 character alphanumeric code assigned by IATA to identify air freight carriers. Used for air waybill generation, air freight booking, and international air cargo tracking. Applicable only to air freight carriers.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 762; IATA Airline Coding Directory

attributes.name: insurance_cargo_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage amount (in USD) of the carrier's cargo insurance policy covering loss or damage to goods in transit. Consumer Goods mandates minimum cargo insurance thresholds based on shipment value profiles. Critical for high-value CPG product shipments.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; ISO 9001 Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the carrier's current certificate of insurance (COI) on file with Consumer Goods. Used for insurance verification, claims processing, and audit trail of carrier compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's insurance certificate expires. Triggers automated renewal reminder workflows and carrier status suspension if insurance lapses. Critical compliance field for carrier program management.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Certificate Management

attributes.name: insurance_liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum coverage amount (in USD) of the carrier's general liability insurance policy. Consumer Goods requires minimum liability coverage thresholds as a condition of carrier approval. Validated during carrier onboarding and annual renewal.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; ISO 9001 Supplier Qualification; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: last_compliance_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance review conducted for this carrier, covering safety ratings, insurance certificates, HAZMAT certifications, and contractual obligations. Used to schedule periodic re-evaluations and flag overdue reviews.
attributes.references: FMCSA Safety Measurement System; ISO 9001 Supplier Audit; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered business name of the transportation carrier as filed with regulatory authorities (FMCSA, state business registry). Used in contracts, freight invoices, and regulatory filings. Must match the name on the carrier's operating authority.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master (LFA1)

attributes.name: max_payload_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity in kilograms that the carrier's standard equipment can transport per shipment. Used in load planning, shipment consolidation, and carrier eligibility checks to prevent overweight violations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 395; SAP S/4HANA TM Capacity Management; Blue Yonder WMS Load Planning

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Operating authority number issued by the FMCSA to for-hire motor carriers transporting regulated commodities in interstate commerce. Distinct from DOT number — MC number grants operating authority while DOT number is for safety registration. Used in carrier compliance validation.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 365; FMCSA Operating Authority

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier was formally approved and onboarded into Consumer Goods' carrier program, completing all compliance checks, insurance verification, and EDI/API setup. Marks the start of the carrier's operational eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Onboarding; ISO 9001 Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the carrier for freight invoice settlement. Drives accounts payable scheduling and cash flow planning. Standard terms in consumer goods logistics range from Net 15 to Net 60 days.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Financials AP; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: preferred_carrier
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has been designated as a preferred carrier in Consumer Goods' carrier program, typically based on negotiated rates, service performance, and strategic partnership status. Preferred carriers receive priority in TMS automated tendering sequences.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Selection; Blue Yonder WMS Carrier Preference

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the primary carrier contact for operational communications, tender notifications, and account management. Used in EDI onboarding and carrier portal access provisioning.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA Vendor Contact; Blue Yonder WMS Carrier Profile

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the carrier organization responsible for account management, contract negotiations, and escalation handling. Used in carrier relationship management and communication workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Contact; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud Account Management

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the carrier contact, used for operational coordination, shipment tracking inquiries, and exception management. Formatted per E.164 international standard.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 Telephone Numbering

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Unique 2-4 character alpha code assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify transportation carriers in North America. Used in EDI transactions (204, 214, 990) and freight billing. Mandatory for motor carriers operating in the US.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Registry; ANSI ASC X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: service_area_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing the countries in which the carrier provides transportation services. Used for international shipment routing, customs compliance validation, and carrier eligibility filtering in cross-border logistics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Country Codes; SAP S/4HANA TM Transportation Lane

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Service level classification offered by the carrier indicating transit speed and handling commitment. Drives SLA assignment, freight cost tier selection, and shipment routing logic in the TMS. Used in OTIF (On Time In Full) performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Shipping Conditions; Blue Yonder WMS Service Level

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number (EIN/TIN) or VAT registration number of the carrier, used for tax compliance, 1099 reporting, and cross-border customs documentation. Required for freight invoice processing and IRS reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; SOX Tax Compliance; EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature (in degrees Celsius) that the carrier's cold-chain equipment can maintain during transit. Combined with the minimum temperature range, defines the carrier's certified temperature corridor for cold-chain shipments.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature (in degrees Celsius) that the carrier's cold-chain equipment can maintain during transit. Used to validate carrier eligibility for temperature-sensitive product shipments and cold-chain compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; GDP Guidelines

attributes.name: tracking_url_template
attributes.description: URL template for the carrier's web-based shipment tracking portal, with a placeholder (e.g., {tracking_number}) for dynamic substitution. Used to generate direct tracking links in shipment notifications, customer portals, and internal TMS dashboards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Carrier Integration; SAP S/4HANA TM Track and Trace

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Doing-business-as (DBA) or trade name used by the carrier in commercial operations, which may differ from the legal registered name. Used in operational communications, carrier portals, and reporting where the trade name is more recognizable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Vendor Master; Blue Yonder TMS Carrier Profile

products.name: carrier_contract
products.description: Freight contract, rate agreement, and granular rate schedule between Consumer Goods and a carrier. Captures contract term dates, lane coverage, mode of transport, negotiated base rates, fuel surcharge tables, accessorial charge schedules, volume commitments, OTIF penalty clauses, contract status, and detailed rate records including rate type (per-mile/per-cwt/per-pallet/flat), origin/destination zones, weight breaks, effective/expiry dates, and currency. Supports freight cost estimation, tender evaluation, freight audit rate lookup, and carrier performance management.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the carrier contract record in the logistics data platform. Primary key for the carrier_contract entity.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (transportation service provider) party who is the counterparty to this freight contract. Links to the carrier master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Vendor Master; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Carrier contracts are legally owned by a specific company code entity in multi-national consumer goods companies. This determines the contracting legal entity for tax, intercompany freight billing, an

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Cross-border carrier contracts are governed by jurisdiction-specific transport regulations (liability limits, customs compliance, OTIF penalty enforceability). Legal and regulatory teams must validate

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.marketing_brand. Business justification: In consumer goods, premium or specialized brands (e.g., cold-chain skincare, infant nutrition) negotiate dedicated brand-specific carrier contracts with distinct SLAs, temperature requirements, and li

attributes.name: accessorial_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the accessorial charge schedule applicable to this contract. Accessorial charges include liftgate, residential delivery, inside delivery, detention, layover, hazmat handling, and temperature-controlled surcharges. Links to the accessorial rate table for freight audit and cost estimation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Accessorial Condition Records; NMFC Accessorial Definitions

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier contract was formally approved by the authorized approver. Used in contract governance, SOX audit trails, and procurement compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; Oracle Cloud Procurement Approval Workflow; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the authorized approver who signed off on this carrier contract. Required for SOX financial controls compliance and procurement governance. Supports audit trail for contract authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; Oracle Cloud Procurement Approval Workflow

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier contract automatically renews at expiry unless terminated with advance notice. When true, the renewal_notice_days field defines the required notice period. Supports contract lifecycle management and procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The primary negotiated freight rate under this contract before surcharges and accessorial charges are applied. The unit of measure for this rate is defined by the rate_type field (e.g., per mile, per CWT, per pallet, flat). Used as the foundation for freight cost estimation and freight audit rate lookup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Freight Condition Records; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the carrier submits freight invoices under this contract. Per-shipment billing generates an invoice for each delivery; weekly/bi-weekly/monthly billing consolidates charges into periodic invoices. Impacts freight audit workflow and accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Processing; Oracle Cloud AP; EDI X12 210 Freight Invoice

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract covers temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipments requiring refrigerated or frozen transport. When true, cold chain compliance monitoring, temperature logging, and FEFO inventory management protocols apply. Relevant for health, hygiene, and perishable consumer goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 (Cold Chain); ISO 9001 Quality Management; FSMA

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the procurement or logistics team. Used in EDI communications, freight audit, and carrier correspondence. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM contract document number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; EDI X12 Standard

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the carrier contract. Draft indicates contract is being authored; pending_approval is awaiting sign-off; active means the contract is in force; suspended means temporarily halted; expired means the term has lapsed; terminated means the contract was ended before expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Lifecycle; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the freight contract by commercial arrangement type. Spot contracts cover single-shipment rates; committed contracts lock volume at negotiated rates; preferred carrier agreements define priority tender; dedicated contracts reserve capacity; intermodal covers multi-mode arrangements; 3PL master covers third-party logistics umbrella agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Types; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier contract record was first created in the logistics data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all rates, charges, and financial commitments under this contract are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost management and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the destination country covered by this contract. Used for cross-border freight classification, customs compliance, and international rate applicability.

attributes.name: destination_region
attributes.description: Geographic destination zone or region covered by this contract for lane-level rate applicability. May represent a state, ZIP zone, city cluster, or carrier-defined zone code. Used in freight cost estimation and tender evaluation.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN; SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation Zones

attributes.name: detention_free_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours the carrier's equipment (trailer/container) may remain at a Consumer Goods facility for loading or unloading without incurring detention charges. Exceeding this threshold triggers accessorial detention fees per the contract rate schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Detention Condition Types; NMFC Detention Standards

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated tender, shipment status, and invoice exchange under this contract. EDI-capable carriers enable automated load tendering (EDI 204), shipment status updates (EDI 214), and freight invoice processing (EDI 210).
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards (204, 210, 214); GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carrier contract becomes legally binding and rates become applicable for freight tendering and cost estimation. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM contract validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; UCC Article 2 Contract Law

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carrier contract ceases to be valid and rates are no longer applicable. Nullable for evergreen contracts with no fixed end date. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM contract validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; UCC Article 2 Contract Law

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_basis
attributes.description: Defines how the fuel surcharge is calculated and applied: as a percentage of the base freight rate, a flat amount per mile, a flat amount per shipment, or dynamically linked to the DOE diesel fuel price index. Determines the fuel surcharge computation method in freight audit.
attributes.references: DOE Diesel Fuel Index; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Calculation Types

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: Contracted fuel surcharge rate expressed as a percentage of the base rate or as a fixed amount per unit, applied on top of the base freight rate to account for fuel cost variability. Linked to a fuel index table or DOE diesel price index. Critical for freight cost estimation and audit.
attributes.references: DOE (U.S. Department of Energy) Diesel Fuel Index; SAP S/4HANA SD Surcharge Conditions

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is certified and authorized under this contract to transport hazardous materials (hazmat) including flammable, corrosive, or toxic consumer goods ingredients. When true, DOT/IATA hazmat compliance documentation is required.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; EPA RCRA

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Maximum cargo insurance coverage amount provided by the carrier under this contract, expressed in the contract currency. Defines the financial liability limit for cargo loss or damage claims. Used in risk management and claims processing.
attributes.references: Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); CPSC; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: liability_limit_per_kg
attributes.description: Contractual carrier liability limit per kilogram of cargo for loss or damage claims, expressed in the contract currency. Used in freight claims management to calculate maximum recoverable amounts for damaged or lost shipments.
attributes.references: Carmack Amendment (49 U.S.C. § 14706); Montreal Convention (Air Freight); CMR Convention (Road)

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum shipment weight in kilograms at which this contract rate applies. Defines the upper bound of the weight break tier. Null indicates no upper limit (applies to all weights above the minimum). Used in freight cost estimation and audit.
attributes.references: NMFC Weight Break Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Freight Scales

attributes.name: min_weight_kg
attributes.description: Minimum shipment weight in kilograms at which this contract rate applies. Defines the lower bound of the weight break tier for rate applicability. Used in freight cost estimation and audit to validate correct rate application.
attributes.references: NMFC Weight Break Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Freight Scales

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the origin country covered by this contract. Used for cross-border freight classification, customs compliance, and international rate applicability.

attributes.name: origin_region
attributes.description: Geographic origin zone or region covered by this contract for lane-level rate applicability. May represent a state, ZIP zone, city cluster, or carrier-defined zone code. Used in freight cost estimation and tender evaluation.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN; SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation Zones

attributes.name: otif_penalty_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Penalty Rate
attributes.description: Contractual penalty rate applied to the carrier for OTIF (On Time In Full) failures, expressed as a percentage of the invoice value or a fixed amount per incident. OTIF is a key KPI in consumer goods supply chain performance management. Supports carrier performance management and deduction processing.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Penalty Conditions; CPSC Compliance

attributes.name: otif_threshold_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Threshold Percentage
attributes.description: Minimum OTIF performance percentage the carrier must achieve to avoid penalty charges under this contract. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 98.5 means 98.5% OTIF compliance required). Below this threshold, the otif_penalty_rate is triggered.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Standards; SAP IBP Supply Planning KPIs

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms defining when freight invoices must be settled after receipt. Net_30 means payment due within 30 days of invoice date. 2/10 Net 30 means a 2% discount if paid within 10 days. Drives accounts payable scheduling and freight audit payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Financials AP; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: pickup_lead_time_hours
attributes.description: Contracted lead time in hours from tender acceptance to carrier pickup at the origin facility. Used in shipment planning, load scheduling, and Blue Yonder WMS labor planning for dock door assignment.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS Transportation Planning; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Point Configuration

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Defines the unit basis on which the base_rate is charged. Per-mile rates apply to distance-based pricing; per-CWT (hundredweight) applies to weight-based LTL pricing; per-pallet applies to unit-load pricing; flat rate is a fixed charge per shipment regardless of weight or distance; per-kg and per-lb are weight-based variants used in air and parcel freight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_mile|per_cwt|per_pallet|per_shipment|flat|per_kg|per_lb — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification); SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Types

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice required to terminate or renegotiate this contract before auto-renewal. Applicable only when auto_renewal is true. Used in contract lifecycle management to trigger procurement review workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Lifecycle; Oracle Cloud Procurement Contract Management

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted service level defining the speed and handling tier for shipments under this agreement. Drives SLA commitments, OTIF measurement thresholds, and rate applicability. Examples: standard ground, expedited, overnight, two-day, deferred, white-glove.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery; Blue Yonder WMS SLA Configuration

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that must be maintained throughout transit for cold chain shipments under this contract. Applicable only when cold_chain_required is true. Exceedance triggers non-conformance reporting and potential product rejection.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that must be maintained throughout transit for cold chain shipments under this contract. Applicable only when cold_chain_required is true. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring and carrier performance audits.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: track_trace_method
attributes.description: Method by which shipment tracking and status updates are provided by the carrier under this contract. EDI 214 is the standard electronic shipment status transaction; API enables real-time integration; portal requires manual check-in; email is manual notification. Drives track-and-trace capability in logistics operations.
attributes.references: EDI X12 214 Shipment Status; Blue Yonder WMS Track and Trace; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: transit_time_days
attributes.description: Contracted standard transit time in calendar days from pickup to delivery for shipments under this contract and lane. Used as the SLA baseline for OTIF measurement, delivery promise, and ATP/CTP calculations in demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Scheduling; SAP IBP ATP Configuration

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation covered by this contract. TL (Truckload), LTL (Less-than-Truckload), intermodal, rail, ocean freight, air freight, parcel/small package, or drayage (port/terminal moves). Drives rate table applicability and freight audit logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|intermodal|rail|ocean|air|parcel|drayage — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping; Blue Yonder WMS; NMFC Classification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier contract record was most recently modified in the logistics data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format. Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: volume_commitment_units
attributes.description: Contracted minimum volume commitment by Consumer Goods to the carrier over the contract term, expressed in the unit defined by volume_commitment_uom (e.g., shipments, pallets, CWT, revenue miles). Failure to meet this commitment may trigger shortfall penalties or rate renegotiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement Target Quantity; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: volume_commitment_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume_commitment_units field. Defines whether the volume commitment is expressed in number of shipments, pallets, hundredweight (CWT), revenue miles, kilograms, or truckloads.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure Configuration; GS1 Standards

products.name: lane
products.description: Defined origin-to-destination transportation lane used for freight planning, carrier assignment, and cost benchmarking. Captures origin and destination location codes, transport mode, distance, transit time standard, lane classification (inbound/outbound/inter-facility/last-mile), preferred carrier assignments, volume history, and lane-level cost benchmarks. Foundational reference for route optimization, freight tendering, and network design.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the transportation lane record. Primary key for the lane entity in the logistics domain.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier contract or rate agreement governing freight pricing and service terms on this lane. Links to the carrier contract master in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: destination_location_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination facility, distribution center, retail store, or customer location where freight is delivered on this lane. Links to the location master in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/WM; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: lane_backup_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the secondary/backup carrier for this lane, used when the preferred carrier declines the tender or is unavailable. Represents the second position in the routing guide.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: lane_preferred_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary/preferred carrier assigned to this lane for freight tendering. Represents the first-tender carrier in the routing guide hierarchy. Links to the carrier master in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: lane_supply_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin facility, distribution center, plant, or supplier location from which freight departs on this lane. Links to the location master in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM; GS1 GLN Standard

attributes.name: annual_volume_loads
attributes.description: Historical or planned annual shipment volume on this lane expressed in number of loads (truckloads, containers, or equivalent units). Used for carrier contract negotiations, network design, and freight spend forecasting.

attributes.name: annual_volume_weight_kg
attributes.description: Historical or planned annual freight weight moved on this lane in kilograms. Used for carrier contract negotiations, modal optimization, and carbon emissions intensity calculations per ISO 14001.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA MM/SD

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_flat
attributes.description: Lane-level flat cost benchmark (all-in rate per load/shipment) in the operating currency. Used for truckload lanes where per-km pricing is not applicable. Supports freight audit and carrier contract negotiation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: benchmark_rate_per_km
attributes.description: Lane-level cost benchmark expressed as rate per kilometer in the operating currency. Used for freight audit, carrier performance benchmarking, and transportation cost variance analysis. Confidential as it reflects negotiated contract intelligence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: carbon_emission_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Emission Factor (kg CO2e per km)
attributes.description: Lane-level carbon emission intensity factor expressed as kilograms of CO2 equivalent per kilometer, based on transport mode and equipment type. Used for Scope 3 emissions reporting, sustainability KPIs, and ESG disclosures per ISO 14001 and EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program; FSC; RSPO

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Directional and functional classification of the lane within the supply chain network. Inbound covers supplier-to-plant/DC movements; outbound covers DC-to-customer/retailer; inter-facility covers plant-to-DC or DC-to-DC; last-mile covers final delivery to end consumer or store; reverse covers returns flow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane requires temperature-controlled transportation to maintain product integrity. When true, cold-chain compliance monitoring, temperature logging, and qualified carrier requirements apply. Critical for health, hygiene, and perishable consumer goods.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lane record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: cross_border
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane crosses an international border, requiring customs documentation, import/export compliance, and potentially additional transit time for border clearance. Drives customs broker assignment and trade compliance workflows.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; FDA Import Regulations; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the lane benchmark rates and cost data (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost consolidation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: customs_trade_zone
attributes.description: Trade zone or customs agreement applicable to this cross-border lane (e.g., USMCA, EU Single Market, ASEAN). Determines duty rates, documentation requirements, and customs clearance procedures. Populated only for cross-border lanes.
attributes.references: FDA Import Regulations; EU REACH Regulation; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: destination_city
attributes.description: City name of the lane destination point. Used for geographic lane analysis, carrier rate zone determination, and network design reporting.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the lane destination. Required for cross-border lane classification, customs documentation, and international freight rate benchmarking.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Business-facing code for the destination location (e.g., customer DC code, store code, or GS1 Global Location Number). Used in EDI transactions, carrier communications, and freight audit matching.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: destination_state_province
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for the lane destination. Used in carrier rate zone mapping and freight cost benchmarking.

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Measured or calculated road/route distance between origin and destination in kilometers. Used for transit time estimation, fuel surcharge calculation, carrier rate benchmarking, and carbon emissions reporting per ISO 14001 and EPA guidelines.
attributes.references: ISO 14001; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting; SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management

attributes.name: dsd_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane supports Direct Store Delivery (DSD), where product is delivered directly from the manufacturer or distributor to the retail store, bypassing the retailer's distribution center. Relevant for high-velocity CPG categories.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD; DSD Industry Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this lane definition becomes active and available for freight planning, carrier assignment, and cost benchmarking. Used to manage lane versioning and contract period alignment.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this lane. Refrigerated (reefer) equipment is critical for cold-chain compliance in temperature-sensitive consumer goods. Drives carrier qualification and cost benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|refrigerated|flatbed|tanker|container_20ft|container_40ft|container_45ft|parcel|bulk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS; FDA 21 CFR (Cold Chain)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this lane definition is no longer valid for freight planning. Nullable for open-ended lanes. Used to manage contract renewals, network redesigns, and lane decommissioning.

attributes.name: hazmat_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane requires carriers certified for hazardous materials (HAZMAT) transport. Applicable for lanes carrying chemical, aerosol, or regulated consumer goods. Triggers carrier qualification checks and regulatory documentation requirements per DOT/EPA/OSHA.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; DOT 49 CFR; EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: lane_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the transportation lane, used in carrier contracts, freight tenders, and TMS systems. Typically formatted as ORIGIN-DEST-MODE (e.g., CHI-NYC-TL). Aligns with SAP TM lane master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: lane_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the transportation lane, typically combining origin and destination location names and transport mode (e.g., 'Chicago DC to New York RDC - Truckload'). Used in reporting and carrier communication.

attributes.name: lane_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the transportation lane. Active lanes are available for freight tendering and route optimization. Inactive or suspended lanes are excluded from planning runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lane record was last updated. Used for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Geographic or operational network region to which this lane belongs (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West Coast, EMEA, APAC). Used for network design segmentation, regional freight cost analysis, and carrier portfolio management.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management

attributes.name: origin_city
attributes.description: City name of the lane origin point. Used for geographic lane analysis, carrier rate zone determination, and network design reporting.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the lane origin. Required for cross-border lane classification, customs documentation, and international freight rate benchmarking.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Business-facing code for the origin location (e.g., plant code, DC code, or GS1 Global Location Number). Used in EDI transactions, carrier communications, and freight audit matching.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standard; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: origin_state_province
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for the lane origin. Used in carrier rate zone mapping, regulatory compliance (e.g., CARB emissions zones), and freight cost benchmarking.

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target OTIF (On Time In Full) performance percentage for this lane, representing the contractual or operational delivery reliability goal. Used as the KPI baseline for carrier performance scorecards and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OTIF Industry Standard; SAP IBP; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: routing_guide_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank of the preferred carrier in the lane routing guide sequence. Rank 1 is the primary carrier; higher ranks are fallback options. Used in automated freight tendering workflows to determine tender sequence.

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted service level for this lane defining the speed and priority of freight movement. Standard is regular scheduled service; expedited is premium fast transit; economy is cost-optimized slower service; dedicated is exclusive carrier capacity; spot is ad-hoc market rate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this lane record originated (e.g., SAP Transportation Management, Blue Yonder WMS). Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: standard_transit_days
attributes.description: Contractually agreed or operationally standard number of calendar days for freight to travel from origin to destination on this lane. Used as the baseline for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement, delivery promise, and ATP/CTP calculations in SAP IBP.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA SD; OTIF Industry Standard

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain lanes. Freight must be maintained at or below this threshold throughout transit. Used for carrier qualification, SLA monitoring, and regulatory compliance under FDA and GMP guidelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain lanes. Freight must be maintained at or above this threshold throughout transit. Used for carrier qualification, SLA monitoring, and regulatory compliance under FDA and GMP guidelines.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GMP Guidelines

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used on this lane. Determines carrier pool, equipment type, transit time standards, and freight cost benchmarks. Truckload (TL) and Less-than-Truckload (LTL) are most common in CPG domestic networks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|less_than_truckload|intermodal|rail|air|ocean|parcel|courier|drayage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Transportation Management; GS1 Global Standards

products.name: logistics_shipment
products.description: Core transactional record representing a physical movement of goods from origin to destination. Captures shipment number, BOL (Bill of Lading), PRO number, carrier assignment, mode of transport (TL/LTL/parcel/ocean/air/rail), origin and destination facility, planned and actual ship/delivery dates, total weight and volume, freight terms (prepaid/collect/third-party), shipment status lifecycle, incoterms, cold-chain flag, and consolidation references. Central entity for track-and-trace, OTIF measurement, and freight cost allocation. References carrier, lane, and freight order.
products.reference: BOL / Shipment Order / Freight Order (SAP TM)

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the logistics shipment record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted carrier (trucking company, ocean liner, air freight provider, parcel carrier) responsible for executing this shipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: destination_facility_distribution_center_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (distribution center, retail store, customer location, or 3PL node) to which the shipment is consigned.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Required for Promotion Execution Report linking shipments to promotion events for spend attribution and compliance.

attributes.name: freight_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.freight_rate. Business justification: A logistics shipment is executed at a specific freight rate from the rate schedule. Linking logistics_shipment to freight_rate enables direct rate-to-actuals reconciliation — comparing the contracted

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted transportation lane (origin-destination pair) governing rate, transit time, and carrier assignment for this shipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. Business justification: Traceability: link each shipment to its originating manufacturing facility for cost allocation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.brand. Business justification: Enables brand‑level logistics KPI aggregation (OTIF, cost) by associating every shipment with the owning brand of the shipped SKU.

attributes.name: origin_trade_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.trade_account. Business justification: Shipment origin account is needed for cost attribution, SLA reporting, and regulatory shipment origin documentation.

attributes.name: primary_logistics_distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (plant, distribution center, warehouse, or supplier location) from which the shipment departs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Required for shipment compliance verification: each shipment must reference the product's regulatory registration to confirm valid registration at shipping time.

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Shipment tracking must reference the originating sales order for fulfillment status and revenue reconciliation.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual date the shipment was received and confirmed at the destination facility. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI calculation and carrier performance scorecarding.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the shipment was delivered and signed for at the destination, as captured by the carrier's POD (Proof of Delivery) system or electronic signature device. Enables time-window compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: The actual date the shipment physically departed from the origin facility, as confirmed by the WMS or carrier. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number issued by the carrier as the legal contract of carriage and receipt of goods. Required for freight audit, customs clearance, and proof of delivery. Key document in SAP S/4HANA SD and Blue Yonder WMS.
attributes.references: UCC Article 7; GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment requires temperature-controlled cold chain handling throughout transit. Triggers cold chain compliance monitoring, reefer equipment assignment, and regulatory documentation for applicable product categories (e.g., perishables, pharmaceuticals).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO 6346 standardized container identification number for ocean freight shipments (e.g., MSCU1234567). Used for port tracking, customs clearance, and demurrage/detention management.
attributes.references: ISO 6346; GS1 Global Standards; U.S. Customs and Border Protection

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was first created in the source system (TMS/ERP/WMS). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order-to-ship cycle time analysis.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the shipment relative to the enterprise network: inbound (from supplier), outbound (to customer/retailer), interplant (between internal facilities), or return (reverse logistics).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: exception_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the reason for a shipment exception or delay (e.g., weather delay, carrier capacity, customs hold, address correction, damaged goods). Used for root cause analysis and carrier performance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather_delay|carrier_capacity|customs_hold|address_correction|damaged_goods|mechanical_failure|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total contracted or invoiced freight cost for this shipment in the transaction currency. Used for freight cost allocation to COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), carrier spend analytics, and freight audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight spend reporting and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment terms indicating who bears the freight cost: prepaid (shipper pays), collect (consignee pays), or third_party (a designated third party pays). Drives freight invoice routing and cost allocation.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Carrier-applied fuel surcharge amount for this shipment, separate from the base freight rate. Used for freight audit, cost variance analysis, and carrier contract compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Cloud Procurement; DOE Fuel Surcharge Index

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and documentation per DOT/IATA/IMDG regulations. Triggers HAZMAT compliance workflow and carrier notification.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; EPA; OSHA; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations between shipper and consignee. Governs freight cost allocation and insurance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC - International Chamber of Commerce); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: otif_in_full
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) - In Full Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment was delivered with the complete ordered quantity, contributing to the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI. Supports retailer compliance scorecarding and deduction management.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Standards; SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: otif_on_time
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) - On Time Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment was delivered on or before the planned delivery date, contributing to the OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI. Derived from planned vs. actual delivery date comparison and stored for reporting efficiency.
attributes.references: Walmart OTIF Standards; SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipment is expected to arrive at the destination facility, based on contracted transit time and lane performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; SAP IBP; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: planned_ship_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipment is scheduled to depart from the origin facility, as determined by the transportation plan or S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) process.
attributes.references: SAP IBP; SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: pod_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Proof of Delivery (POD) document has been received and validated for this shipment. Required for freight invoice payment release and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the Proof of Delivery (POD) was electronically captured or received, as recorded by the carrier's mobile device or ePOD system. Used for freight audit and dispute resolution timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to track LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) shipments through the carrier's network. Essential for freight audit and claims management.
attributes.references: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification); SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted carrier service level for this shipment, determining transit time commitment and freight rate tier. Drives SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: ship_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the shipment departed the origin facility, as recorded by the WMS or gate system. Used for transit time calculation and carrier SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: shipment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the shipment, typically generated by the TMS or ERP (e.g., SAP outbound delivery number or transportation order number). Used for track-and-trace and carrier communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: shipment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shipment. Drives OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement, exception management, and track-and-trace visibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|tendered|confirmed|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|cancelled|exception — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments. Exceedances trigger quality holds, product disposition reviews, and regulatory notifications.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 (GMP for Cosmetics); SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments. Used for reefer equipment configuration, carrier instructions, and cold chain compliance auditing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 (GMP for Cosmetics); SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: three_pl_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) provider for this shipment in their WMS or TMS. Enables cross-system reconciliation and 3PL billing validation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Cloud Supply Chain

attributes.name: total_cases
attributes.description: Total number of cases (cartons) included in the shipment. Used for pick/pack verification, receiving reconciliation, and OTIF (On Time In Full) quantity compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: total_pallets
attributes.description: Total number of pallets included in the shipment. Used for dock scheduling, trailer loading planning, and carrier billing for LTL shipments.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment in cubic meters. Used for dimensional weight calculation, trailer utilization, and freight cost optimization.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; IATA Air Cargo Standards

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including packaging and pallets. Used for freight rate calculation, carrier billing, and compliance with road weight limits.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; NMFC

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for parcel or express shipments (e.g., UPS, FedEx, DHL tracking number). Enables real-time track-and-trace via carrier APIs and customer-facing shipment visibility portals.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for this shipment. TL = Truckload, LTL = Less-Than-Truckload, parcel = small package carrier, ocean = sea freight, air = air freight, rail = rail freight. Drives freight cost allocation and transit time expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Blue Yonder WMS; INCOTERMS 2020 (ICC)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the shipment record in the source system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA SD

products.name: shipment_item
products.description: Line-item detail of goods included in a shipment. Captures SKU/GTIN, product description, ordered quantity, shipped quantity, unit of measure, gross weight, net weight, volume, hazmat flag, temperature-sensitive flag, lot/batch number, expiry date (FEFO compliance), and packaging type. Enables item-level traceability and cold-chain compliance tracking.

attributes.name: shipment_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment line item record in the logistics data platform. Primary key for the shipment_item entity.

attributes.name: batch_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.batch_record. Business justification: FDA/EU GMP lot traceability requires linking each shipped line item to its manufacturing batch record. Enables lot-level recall execution, expiry date validation, and regulatory audit trails. Consumer

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center from which this item was picked and dispatched. Used for inventory depletion tracking, warehouse performance analytics, and DRP (Distribution Requirements Planning).
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: event_sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event_sku. Business justification: Needed for Promotional SKU shipment reconciliation to calculate allocated vs actual promotional volume per shipment.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection_lot. Business justification: Required for lot traceability report linking inspected lots to shipped items, enabling recall and compliance verification.

attributes.name: label_version_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.label_version. Business justification: Consumer Goods regulatory compliance requires that shipped products carry the jurisdiction-approved label version for the destination market. This link enables label compliance audits, recall traceabi

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment header record. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for all items within a single shipment dispatch event. Aligns with SAP SD delivery document header.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: FDA/FSMA traceability and recall management require direct lot/batch identification on shipped items. Consumer goods recall coordinators query shipment items by lot to determine distribution scope. ex

attributes.name: pack_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.pack_hierarchy. Business justification: SSCC labeling, pallet configuration validation, and carrier compliance in consumer goods require knowing the exact pack level (each/case/pallet) being shipped. Pack hierarchy defines TI/HI, GTIN, and

attributes.name: packaging_spec_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.product_packaging_spec. Business justification: Freight audit, carrier compliance, and OTIF reporting require knowing which packaging spec (dimensions, weight, hazmat, cold-chain flags) was used for each shipment line. Consumer goods logistics team

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: shipment_item.purchase_order_number is a denormalized text reference to the originating PO line. Replacing with a proper FK to po_line enables OTIF measurement at PO line level, goods receipt reconcil

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.recall_event. Business justification: During a product recall, consumer goods recall coordinators must identify all shipment items containing affected lots in the distribution network. Direct recall_event_id on shipment_item enables recal

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.registration. Business justification: Needed for item‑level compliance reporting; links each shipped item to its regulatory registration for traceability and audit.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.sds. Business justification: ADR/IATA/IMDG regulations mandate that Safety Data Sheets accompany hazardous shipment items in transit. Consumer Goods compliance teams must verify the correct SDS version is associated with each haz

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Required for shipping manifest and inventory reconciliation; each shipment line must reference the master SKU to enable traceability, OTIF reporting, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: Needed for Pick Allocation process linking each shipment item to the specific stock position it was sourced from, supporting inventory reservation and traceability.

attributes.name: supply_replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_replenishment_order. Business justification: Shipment items represent line-level shipped quantities that must be reconciled against replenishment order lines for goods receipt confirmation and over/under-shipment resolution — a standard consumer

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity confirmed as received by the consignee at the delivery destination, captured from proof of delivery (POD) or EDI 214 acknowledgment. Used for invoice reconciliation and OTIF final measurement.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or substantially transformed. Required for customs declarations, import duty determination, and trade compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WTO Rules of Origin; FDA Import Regulations; EU Customs Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shipment item record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which unit_cost and line_value are expressed. Enables multi-currency financial consolidation and FX reporting.

attributes.name: delivery_document_number
attributes.description: ERP delivery document number (e.g., SAP outbound delivery number) associated with this shipment line. Serves as the primary cross-reference between the logistics execution system and the financial/order management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/WM Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of this shipment line item in kilograms, including product, inner packaging, and outer packaging. Used for freight cost calculation, carrier capacity planning, and customs declarations.
attributes.references: GS1 Logistic Label Standards; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: harmonized_tariff_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code for the product, used for customs clearance, import duty calculation, and international trade compliance. Typically 6-10 digits per WCO HS nomenclature.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; CBP 19 CFR; EU Combined Nomenclature

attributes.name: is_controlled_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item contains a controlled substance subject to DEA scheduling, FDA drug regulations, or equivalent international narcotics controls. Triggers enhanced chain-of-custody documentation requirements.
attributes.references: DEA 21 CFR Part 1301; FDA 21 CFR; EU Regulation 273/2004

attributes.name: is_dsd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is fulfilled via Direct Store Delivery (DSD) channel, bypassing the retailer's distribution center and delivering directly to the store. Impacts route planning, SFA integration, and trade promotion settlement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; DSD Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment item is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, labeling, and transport documentation per DOT, IATA, or IMDG regulations. Triggers mandatory SDS (Safety Data Sheet) attachment.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IMDG Code; EPA Regulations; OSHA HazCom Standard

attributes.name: is_temperature_sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item requires temperature-controlled handling and transport (cold chain). When true, temperature range requirements and cold-chain compliance monitoring are enforced throughout the shipment lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716; GDP Guidelines for Pharmaceuticals and Consumer Health

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the product being shipped, including product name, variant, and pack size. Used on shipping documents, proof of delivery, and freight audit records.

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this shipment line item. Tracks progression from warehouse picking through delivery confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|picked|loaded|in_transit|delivered|short_shipped|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number of this item within the parent shipment, used for ordering and referencing individual line items. Corresponds to SAP SD delivery item position number.

attributes.name: line_value
attributes.description: Total declared value of this shipment line item (shipped_quantity × unit_cost), used for customs valuation, cargo insurance, and financial reporting. Expressed in the shipment currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/CO Module; SOX Financial Reporting; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement

attributes.name: max_temperature_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for storage and transport of this item. Applicable when is_temperature_sensitive is true. Exceedances trigger quality holds and non-conformance reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; GDP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for storage and transport of this item. Applicable when is_temperature_sensitive is true. Used to configure cold-chain monitoring alerts and carrier SLA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; GDP Cold Chain Guidelines; ISO 22716

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the product content only in kilograms, excluding all packaging materials. Required for regulatory labeling compliance, customs documentation, and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EU Regulation 1169/2011; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of this item originally ordered by the customer or requested in the purchase order. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) calculation and order fulfillment rate reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; S&OP Best Practices

attributes.name: packaging_type
attributes.description: Type of packaging unit in which the item is shipped. Determines handling requirements, stacking rules, and warehouse slotting. Aligns with GS1 packaging hierarchy levels.
attributes.references: GS1 Packaging Hierarchy Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: quality_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipment line item has been placed on a quality hold due to a failed QC inspection, temperature exceedance, or regulatory non-conformance. Items on hold must not be delivered until released by QA.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; FDA 21 CFR Part 211; SAP S/4HANA QM Module; Siemens Opcenter MES

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Product registration or regulatory approval number required for cross-border shipments of regulated consumer goods (e.g., FDA registration, EPA registration, EU REACH authorization). Stored for customs and import compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR; EPA Regulations; EU REACH Regulation; Veeva Vault

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for any quantity rejected or short-shipped on this line item, such as OOS (Out of Stock), quality hold, weight discrepancy, or carrier refusal. Used for root cause analysis and OTIF exception reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; ISO 9001 Non-Conformance Reporting

attributes.name: sales_order_line
attributes.description: Line item number within the originating sales order corresponding to this shipment item. Used for precise order-to-shipment reconciliation and partial fulfillment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; EDI 856 ASN Standards

attributes.name: sales_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order number from the ERP system (SAP SD) that triggered this shipment line. Enables order-to-delivery traceability and OTIF measurement at the order line level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; EDI 856 ASN Standards

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned to an individual product unit, applicable for serialized items requiring unit-level traceability (e.g., high-value consumer electronics, regulated health products). Null for non-serialized bulk items.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 830; GS1 SGTIN Standards; DSCSA Serialization Requirements

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of this item loaded and dispatched in the shipment. May differ from ordered quantity due to partial fulfillment, OOS (Out of Stock) conditions, or substitution. Core metric for OTIF compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; GS1 ASN Standards

attributes.name: sscc
attributes.description: GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) — an 18-digit identifier assigned to the logistic unit (pallet, case) containing this item. Enables pallet-level traceability and EDI 856 ASN compliance with retail trading partners.
attributes.references: GS1 SSCC Standard; EDI X12 856 ASN; CPSC Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: storage_location
