attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Charges; Blue Yonder TMS; NMFC Accessorial Standards

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the carrier completed delivery at the destination location. Core field for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement, carrier scorecard, and proof-of-delivery reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Event Management; Blue Yonder TMS Track and Trace; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: actual_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time the carrier picked up the freight at the origin location. Compared against the pickup window to determine on-time pickup performance for OTIF reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Event Management; Blue Yonder TMS Track and Trace; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: agreed_freight_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated or spot-quoted rate agreed with the carrier for executing this freight order, expressed in the transaction currency. Used for freight cost accrual, freight audit, and carrier rate benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Agreement; Blue Yonder TMS Rate Management; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number serving as the legal contract of carriage between the shipper and carrier. Required for freight claims, customs clearance, and proof-of-delivery documentation.
attributes.references: UCC Article 7 Bills of Lading; SAP TM; GS1 EDI 856 ASN Standard; FDA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: carrier_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number issued by the carrier for this freight order. Used for freight audit and payment matching in accounts payable. Populated upon receipt of carrier invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; SAP TM Freight Settlement; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight order record was first created in the source TMS system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement from order creation to carrier acceptance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the agreed freight rate and all monetary amounts on this freight order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: delivery_window_end
attributes.description: End of the agreed delivery time window at the destination location. Defines the latest acceptable delivery time per retailer or customer SLA.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS; Retailer SLA

attributes.name: delivery_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the agreed delivery time window at the destination location. Defines the earliest acceptable delivery time per retailer or customer SLA.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS; Retailer SLA

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the freight movement relative to the company's network: inbound (from supplier to plant/DC), outbound (from plant/DC to customer/retailer), or interplant (between internal facilities).
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Type; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this freight order (e.g., dry van, refrigerated/reefer, flatbed, tanker, intermodal container). Critical for cold-chain compliance for temperature-sensitive consumer goods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|reefer|flatbed|tanker|intermodal|curtainsider|box_truck — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Equipment Type; Blue Yonder TMS; ISO 668 Container Standards

attributes.name: freight_audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the freight invoice audit process for this freight order. Tracks whether the carrier invoice has been received, validated against the agreed rate, approved for payment, or disputed due to discrepancies.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Settlement; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: freight_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the freight order as issued by the Transportation Management System (TMS). Used in carrier communications, EDI transactions, and proof-of-delivery documents.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; GS1 EDI Standard

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Fuel surcharge applied to this freight order by the carrier, expressed in the transaction currency. Fuel surcharges are typically indexed to DOE diesel fuel price indices and are a standard component of carrier invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Charges; Blue Yonder TMS; DOE Diesel Fuel Index

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms, including product, packaging, and pallet weight. Used for carrier rate calculation, weight-based freight billing, and regulatory compliance for road transport weight limits.
attributes.references: SAP TM Shipment Weight; GS1 Logistics Label Standard; EU Road Transport Regulation

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk, cost responsibility, and delivery obligations between buyer and seller for this freight order. Governs freight cost ownership and insurance responsibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle Cloud ERP

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight order requires temperature-controlled cold-chain transportation (e.g., refrigerated or frozen consumer goods). Triggers reefer equipment assignment and temperature monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight order contains hazardous materials (hazmat) requiring special handling, placarding, and regulatory documentation per DOT 49 CFR and IATA/IMDG regulations.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; IATA DGR; IMDG Code; EPA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight order record was last modified in the source TMS system. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail in the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shipment load mode. FTL (Full Truckload) indicates the carrier's entire trailer is dedicated to this shipment; LTL (Less-than-Truckload) indicates shared trailer space; parcel indicates small-package carrier service; intermodal indicates multi-modal container movement; rail indicates rail freight.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Mode; NMFC Classification; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the freight order. Tracks progression from tendering to carrier through acceptance, in-transit movement, and final delivery or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tendered|accepted|rejected|in_transit|delivered|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Status; Blue Yonder TMS Status Model

attributes.name: pallet_count
attributes.description: Number of pallets included in this freight order. Used for dock scheduling, trailer space planning, and carrier rate calculation for pallet-based pricing agreements.
attributes.references: SAP TM Handling Units; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Pallet Label Standard

attributes.name: pickup_window_end
attributes.description: End of the agreed pickup time window at the origin location. Defines the latest time the carrier may arrive for loading without incurring a late pickup penalty.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS Appointment Scheduling

attributes.name: pickup_window_start
attributes.description: Start of the agreed pickup time window at the origin location. Defines the earliest time the carrier may arrive for loading. Used for dock scheduling and carrier compliance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Time Window; Blue Yonder TMS Appointment Scheduling

attributes.name: pod_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Proof of Delivery (POD) document has been received and recorded for this freight order. Required for freight payment release, dispute resolution, and retailer compliance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Proof of Delivery; Blue Yonder TMS; GS1 EDI 214

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the Proof of Delivery (POD) was received and confirmed. Used for delivery confirmation, OTIF (On Time In Full) final measurement, and freight payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Proof of Delivery; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used as the primary tracking identifier for LTL (Less-than-Truckload) shipments. Issued by the carrier upon freight pickup and used for track-and-trace and freight claims.
attributes.references: NMFC LTL PRO Number Standard; SAP TM; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests delivery at the destination location. Core input for OTIF (On Time In Full) performance measurement and retailer compliance scoring.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI Standard

attributes.name: requested_pickup_date
attributes.description: The date on which the shipper requests the carrier to pick up the freight at the origin location. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) measurement and carrier performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order; Blue Yonder TMS; OTIF KPI Standard

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Contracted service level for this freight order defining the expected transit time commitment (e.g., standard ground, expedited 2-day, overnight, same-day). Drives carrier selection and freight cost.
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Level; Blue Yonder TMS; Carrier SLA

attributes.name: shipment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number used by the carrier or 3PL to identify this shipment in their system. Enables cross-system track-and-trace and carrier invoice reconciliation via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange).
attributes.references: SAP TM External Reference; GS1 EDI 214 Transport Status; Blue Yonder TMS

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Applicable when is_cold_chain is True. Exceedance triggers a quality hold and potential product rejection per GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) standards.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GDP Guidelines (EU); GMP

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain shipments. Applicable when is_cold_chain is True. Used for carrier compliance verification and cold-chain excursion detection.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GDP Guidelines (EU)

attributes.name: tendering_method
attributes.description: Method used to tender the freight order to a carrier. Contract indicates a pre-negotiated rate agreement; spot indicates a one-time market rate; load_board indicates posting to a freight exchange; dedicated indicates a committed fleet arrangement; auction indicates a competitive bidding process.
attributes.references: SAP TM Tendering; Blue Yonder TMS Carrier Selection

attributes.name: tms_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the source Transportation Management System (TMS) from which this freight order record was ingested into the lakehouse. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Blue Yonder TMS; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: total_freight_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of this freight order including base rate, fuel surcharge, and all accessorial charges. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) allocation, freight budget vs. actuals reporting, and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Cost; Blue Yonder TMS; SOX Financial Reporting; COGS Accounting

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this freight order. Drives regulatory requirements, transit time expectations, and carbon emissions calculation for sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Mode; GS1 Transport Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Reporting

attributes.name: volume_m3
attributes.description: Total cubic volume of the shipment in cubic meters. Used for LTL (Less-than-Truckload) dimensional weight calculation, trailer utilization analysis, and freight cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Shipment Volume; Blue Yonder TMS; NMFC Dimensional Weight Rules

products.name: route
products.description: Optimized delivery route plan for a vehicle or driver covering multiple sequential stops. Captures route ID, route date, vehicle/trailer assignment, driver reference, total planned distance and duration, planned departure time, route optimization algorithm used, route status (planned/dispatched/in-progress/completed), and ordered stop details including stop sequence, consignee reference, delivery address, planned/actual arrival and departure times, stop type (delivery/pickup/cross-dock), cases/pallets to deliver, stop status, and dwell time. Supports last-mile route optimization, DSD execution, and stop-level performance tracking.

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the delivery route plan. Primary key for the route entity in the logistics domain.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or 3PL partner responsible for executing this route. Relevant for outsourced last-mile and DSD operations.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating depot, distribution center, or warehouse from which this route departs. Links to the facility/location master.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: DSD routes are planned and executed within sales territories in consumer goods. Territory-based route efficiency reporting, sales rep coverage alignment, and call frequency compliance all require link

attributes.name: vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.vehicle. Business justification: A route is executed by a specific vehicle — this is a fundamental operational relationship in last-mile and DSD logistics. The route table already has a `vehicle_code` column typed as BIGINT, which is

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.warehouse. Business justification: Route planning in consumer goods requires knowing the originating warehouse for dock scheduling, load sequencing, and inventory availability checks. A logistics planner cannot plan a DSD or replenishm

attributes.name: actual_departure_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp at which the vehicle departed the depot. Compared against planned_departure_time to measure on-time departure performance and identify dispatch delays.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: actual_distance_km
attributes.description: Actual driving distance recorded for the route in kilometers, typically captured via telematics or GPS. Compared against planned distance for route efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: actual_duration_min
attributes.description: Actual total route duration in minutes from depot departure to return. Used to measure route execution efficiency and identify deviations from plan.

attributes.name: actual_return_time
attributes.description: Actual timestamp at which the vehicle returned to the depot. Used to calculate total route duration, driver overtime, and vehicle utilization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OSHA Hours-of-Service Regulations

attributes.name: co2_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Estimated carbon dioxide emissions in kilograms for this route, calculated from fuel consumption and vehicle type. Supports sustainability reporting, ESG disclosures, and ISO 14001 environmental management.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system, typically when the route plan was generated by the optimization engine or manually by a dispatcher.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the freight_cost field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations across global distribution networks.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: freight_cost
attributes.description: Total planned or actual freight cost for this route in the operating currency. Used for transportation cost tracking, carrier invoice reconciliation, and freight audit processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle Cloud Financials; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_liters
attributes.description: Estimated or actual fuel consumed in liters for this route. Used for fleet cost management, carbon emissions calculation, and sustainability reporting under ISO 14001.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route carries hazardous materials (e.g., aerosols, flammable cleaning products) requiring special handling, placarding, and regulatory compliance under DOT and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Regulations; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials; OSHA SDS Requirements

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route requires cold-chain compliance (temperature-controlled vehicle and handling). Critical for perishable consumer goods, dairy, frozen foods, and pharmaceutical products subject to FDA and GMP requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: is_dsd
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is a Direct Store Delivery (DSD) route, where the manufacturer delivers directly to retail store shelves bypassing the retailer's distribution center. Drives specific execution workflows in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 DSD Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or instructions for the route, such as special handling requirements, access restrictions, or dispatcher comments. Visible to drivers via mobile dispatch applications.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: optimization_algorithm
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the route optimization algorithm or engine used to generate this route plan (e.g., 'VRP-TW', 'Clarke-Wright', 'Blue Yonder Optimizer v4.2'). Supports algorithm performance benchmarking and audit.

attributes.name: optimization_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the route optimization algorithm was executed to generate this route plan. Used to track plan freshness and identify routes built on stale demand data.

attributes.name: otif_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: On Time In Full (OTIF) Compliant Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route achieved full OTIF (On Time In Full) compliance — all stops were serviced within the agreed time windows and all ordered quantities were delivered. Key KPI for retailer scorecards.
attributes.references: GS1 OTIF Standards; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; SAP IBP

attributes.name: planned_departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp at which the vehicle is planned to depart the depot for this route. Used for driver scheduling, dock door allocation, and on-time departure KPI tracking.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: planned_distance_km
attributes.description: Total planned driving distance for the route in kilometers, as calculated by the route optimization algorithm. Used for fuel cost estimation, carbon footprint calculation, and driver pay.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: planned_duration_min
attributes.description: Total planned route duration in minutes, including drive time and estimated stop dwell times. Used for driver scheduling and OTIF planning.

attributes.name: planned_return_time
attributes.description: Scheduled timestamp at which the vehicle is expected to return to the depot after completing all stops. Used for driver hours-of-service compliance and dock planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; OSHA Hours-of-Service Regulations

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic or physical proof of delivery (POD) must be captured at each stop on this route. Drives mobile app workflows for drivers and supports dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; Blue Yonder WMS; GS1

attributes.name: route_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this route is planned to be executed. Used for daily route scheduling, driver dispatch, and OTIF performance tracking.

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the route, typically reflecting the geographic territory or customer cluster served (e.g., 'Northeast Metro DSD Run').
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: route_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the route, used in operational communications, driver manifests, and carrier EDI exchanges. May align with SAP Transportation Management route codes.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD; EDI X12 204

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the route. Tracks progression from planning through dispatch, active execution, and completion or cancellation. Supports real-time track-and-trace and operational dashboards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route by operational purpose. DSD (Direct Store Delivery) routes serve retail outlets directly; mixed routes combine deliveries and pickups; cross-dock routes transfer goods between facilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery|pickup|mixed|cross_dock|dsd|milk_run — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1

attributes.name: service_time_window_end
attributes.description: Latest allowable timestamp for the route to complete servicing stops. Breaching this window results in OTIF failures and potential retailer chargebacks.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud; GS1 OTIF Standards

attributes.name: service_time_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest allowable timestamp for the route to begin servicing stops, as defined by customer or retailer receiving window constraints. Used as an input constraint in the route optimization algorithm.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain routes. Breaches trigger non-conformance events and potential product quarantine per GMP and FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable cargo temperature in degrees Celsius for cold-chain routes. Enforced during transit to maintain product integrity and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211; ISO 22716 GMP; GS1 Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: total_cases_delivered
attributes.description: Actual number of cases delivered across all stops on this route. Compared against total_cases_planned to compute fill rate and identify short-shipments.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_cases_planned
attributes.description: Total number of cases (selling units) planned for delivery across all stops on this route. Used for vehicle load planning and OTIF measurement.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_pallets_planned
attributes.description: Total number of pallets planned for loading on this route. Used for vehicle capacity utilization and dock door planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: total_stops_completed
attributes.description: Actual number of stops successfully completed during route execution. Compared against total_stops_planned to measure route completion rate and identify failed deliveries.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: total_stops_planned
attributes.description: Total number of delivery or pickup stops planned for this route. Used for workload balancing, route complexity scoring, and driver capacity planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud

attributes.name: total_volume_m3
attributes.description: Total planned cargo volume in cubic meters for the route. Used alongside total_weight_kg to assess vehicle cube utilization and prevent overloading.

attributes.name: total_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total planned payload weight in kilograms for the route. Used to verify compliance with vehicle gross vehicle weight (GVW) regulations and optimize load efficiency.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; DOT Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this route record, such as stop additions, driver reassignments, or status updates. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; ISO 9001 Quality Management; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the vehicle's rated payload capacity utilized by the planned load on this route. Key metric for fleet efficiency and freight cost optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: Carrier-issued freight invoice submitted to Consumer Goods for transportation services rendered. Captures invoice number, carrier reference, invoice date, payment due date, shipment/BOL references, invoiced charges (line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorials), currency, invoice status (received/under-audit/approved/disputed/paid), and variance amount vs. contracted rate. Central to freight audit and pay (FAP) process.
products.reference: Freight Invoice / Carrier Invoice / FAP Invoice

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.manufacturing_facility. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_replenishment_order. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; NMFTA Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_code
attributes.description: EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transaction set identifier for invoices received electronically via EDI 210 (Motor Carrier Freight Invoice) or equivalent. Enables traceability of electronic invoice transmission.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Transaction Set 210 — Motor Carrier Freight Invoice; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: freight_class
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC) Freight Class
attributes.description: National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC) freight class assigned to the shipment (e.g., 50, 70, 100, 150). Determines LTL (Less-Than-Truckload) base rates and is a key audit point for freight invoice validation.
attributes.references: NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association) — NMFC Classification

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Carrier-applied fuel surcharge amount added to the base line-haul charge. Typically calculated as a percentage of line-haul based on the DOE (Department of Energy) fuel index. Key component for freight cost variance analysis.
attributes.references: U.S. DOE Fuel Index; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the carrier issued the freight invoice. Used to calculate payment due date, aging, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) metrics in freight payables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned invoice number as printed on the freight invoice document. Externally known identifier used for carrier communication, dispute resolution, and payment remittance.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice

attributes.name: invoice_source
attributes.description: Channel through which the freight invoice was received by Consumer Goods. Used to track EDI adoption rates and identify manual processing inefficiencies.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the freight invoice within the freight audit and pay (FAP) process. Drives processing actions and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the freight invoice by document type. Distinguishes standard carrier invoices from credit memos, debit memos, rebills, and adjustments for accurate financial processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Document Type; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: invoiced_total_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount invoiced by the carrier, inclusive of line-haul, fuel surcharge, accessorials, and taxes. This is the amount the carrier is requesting for payment before audit adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: is_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight invoice covers a temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipment requiring refrigerated or frozen transport. Relevant for Consumer Goods products with cold-chain compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211 — Good Manufacturing Practice; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment covered by this invoice contains hazardous materials requiring special handling, labeling, and regulatory compliance. Triggers validation of hazmat accessorial charges.
attributes.references: U.S. DOT CFR Title 49 — Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA Standards

attributes.name: line_haul_amount
attributes.description: Base transportation charge for moving freight from origin to destination, excluding surcharges and accessorials. Core component of the freight invoice monetary triplet.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; NMFTA Freight Classification

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipment origin. Required for cross-border freight, customs compliance, and international freight cost reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipment origin facility (plant, warehouse, or distribution center) from which the freight movement originated. Used for lane-level freight cost analysis and carrier performance reporting.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN (Global Location Number) Standard; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was issued to the carrier for this freight invoice. Used to calculate Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), confirm on-time payment, and support carrier relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be made to the carrier per the contracted payment terms. Critical for cash flow management and avoiding late payment penalties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Terms; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Internal payment document or check/ACH reference number assigned when the invoice was paid. Used to reconcile freight invoices against bank statements and carrier remittance advice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Document; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms agreed with the carrier (e.g., Net30, Net45, 2/10Net30). Determines the payment due date and any early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Payment Terms; Oracle Cloud Financials

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to track the shipment within the carrier's system. Standard identifier in LTL and TL freight for track-and-trace and invoice matching.
attributes.references: NMFTA (National Motor Freight Traffic Association) Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Consumer Goods internal purchase order number associated with the freight services procured. Used for three-way match in accounts payable and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Purchase Order

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the freight invoice was received by Consumer Goods from the carrier, either via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), email, or carrier portal. Marks the start of the freight audit and pay (FAP) cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Vendor Invoice; EDI X12 Standard 210

attributes.name: service_date
attributes.description: Date the transportation service was rendered (pickup or delivery date). Used to match the invoice to the correct accounting period and validate service delivery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery; CFR Title 49

attributes.name: service_level
attributes.description: Carrier service level or product code for the transportation service rendered (e.g., standard ground, expedited, next-day, two-day). Used to validate that the invoiced service matches the contracted service level agreement (SLA).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Shipping Conditions; Carrier SLA

attributes.name: shipment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Actual or billed shipment weight in kilograms as stated on the freight invoice. Used to validate weight-based freight charges against contracted rates and detect weight discrepancies.
attributes.references: NMFTA Freight Classification; GS1 Global Data Standards

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the freight invoice, including applicable federal, state, and local taxes on transportation services. Required for accurate financial reporting and tax compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Tax; SOX Financial Reporting; CFR Title 26

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for the shipment covered by this invoice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TL|LTL|parcel|intermodal|air|ocean|rail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Data Standards; CFR Title 49 — Transportation

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the freight invoice record was last modified in the Consumer Goods data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the invoiced total amount and the contracted rate amount (invoiced_total_amount minus contracted_amount). Positive value indicates overbilling by carrier; negative indicates underbilling. Central metric in the freight audit and pay (FAP) process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — Invoice Verification; Oracle Cloud Financials

products.name: tracking_event
products.description: Real-time or near-real-time shipment tracking event captured from carrier EDI (214/990), GPS telematics, or IoT sensors. Captures event timestamp, shipment/leg reference, event type (picked-up, in-transit, out-for-delivery, delivered, exception, delay, damage, refused), location (city/state/GPS coordinates), carrier event code, temperature reading (cold-chain), exception root cause code, financial impact estimate, resolution action and timestamp, and data source. Powers track-and-trace visibility, cold-chain compliance monitoring, exception management, and carrier performance measurement.
products.reference: EDI 214 / Shipment Status Message / Track & Trace Event

attributes.name: tracking_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shipment tracking event record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the tracking_event data product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, parcel carrier, ocean liner, air freight provider) that generated or reported this tracking event.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane on which this tracking event occurred, enabling lane-level performance and exception analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP IBP Supply Planning

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment record to which this tracking event belongs. Links the event to the full shipment context including origin, destination, carrier, and BOL details.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: supply_replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supply_replenishment_order. Business justification: Tracking events on in-transit replenishment shipments update supply visibility — ETA updates, exception alerts, and in-transit inventory positions. Supply planners monitor replenishment order status v

attributes.name: carrier_event_code
attributes.description: The carrier's native status or event code as transmitted via EDI 214/990 or carrier API (e.g., 'X1', 'D1', 'AF', 'OFD'). Preserves the source system code for carrier-specific reporting and reconciliation against carrier invoices and SLA commitments.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ANSI X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: carrier_sla_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier Service Level Agreement (SLA) Met Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier met the contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) milestone at this event (e.g., on-time pickup, on-time delivery). Derived from comparison of event_timestamp against planned_event_timestamp and carrier contract terms. Feeds carrier performance scorecards and SLA penalty/incentive calculations.
attributes.references: Carrier Contract SLA Terms; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tracking event record was first ingested and created in the silver layer lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp (when the event occurred in the real world). Used for data latency monitoring and SLA measurement of carrier EDI/API feed timeliness.

attributes.name: customs_status
attributes.description: The customs clearance status of the shipment at the time of this tracking event, applicable to cross-border shipments. Indicates whether the shipment has cleared customs, is held for inspection, pending documentation, released after hold, or seized. Critical for international supply chain visibility and compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP); EU REACH Regulation; FDA Import Regulations

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The originating system or channel that generated this tracking event. Distinguishes between carrier EDI transmissions (214/990), GPS telematics feeds, IoT sensor readings, carrier API webhooks, WMS scan events, and manual entries. Critical for data lineage and source reliability scoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: edi_214|edi_990|gps_telematics|iot_sensor|carrier_api|manual_entry|wms_scan — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214; ANSI X12 EDI Standard; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: dwell_time_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes the shipment or vehicle dwelled at the event location (e.g., carrier terminal, cross-dock, customer dock) before the next movement event. Supports carrier performance analysis, dock scheduling optimization, and detention charge identification.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: edi_interchange_control_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Interchange Control Number
attributes.description: The unique interchange control number from the EDI envelope (ISA segment) of the source EDI transmission that generated this tracking event. Enables end-to-end EDI message traceability and duplicate detection.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: The ANSI X12 EDI transaction set number associated with the source message that generated this tracking event (e.g., 214 = Transportation Carrier Shipment Status, 990 = Response to a Load Tender). Supports EDI audit trail and carrier integration troubleshooting.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 EDI Standards

attributes.name: equipment_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the transportation equipment (trailer number, container number, railcar number, vessel IMO number) associated with this tracking event. Enables equipment-level tracking, utilization analysis, and cross-referencing with carrier equipment records.

attributes.name: event_city
attributes.description: The city where the tracking event occurred, as reported by the carrier or GPS system. Used for geographic visualization of shipment progress and lane-level exception analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message

attributes.name: event_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country where the tracking event occurred (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX'). Required for cross-border shipment tracking and customs compliance reporting.

attributes.name: event_state_province
attributes.description: The state or province where the tracking event occurred, using standard postal abbreviations (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'ON'). Supports regional performance reporting and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this tracking event record indicating whether it is the current authoritative event (active), has been superseded by a correction, cancelled, or identified as a duplicate. Supports data quality management in the silver layer.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset) at which the tracking event occurred in the real world, as reported by the carrier, GPS telematics system, or IoT sensor. This is the principal business event time, distinct from record ingestion timestamps.
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; ISO 8601

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the shipment tracking event representing the current milestone or status change in the shipment lifecycle. Drives track-and-trace visibility and exception management workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: picked_up|in_transit|out_for_delivery|delivered|exception|delay|damage|refused — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214 Transportation Carrier Shipment Status Message; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the exception condition, providing additional context beyond the root cause code. May include carrier notes, driver comments, or system-generated messages explaining the nature of the delay, damage, or refusal.

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that this tracking event represents or triggered a shipment exception condition (e.g., delay, damage, refused delivery, missed pickup, temperature breach). Drives exception management workflows and carrier performance scorecards.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: exception_root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized root cause code categorizing the reason for a shipment exception (e.g., 'WEATHER', 'CARRIER_DELAY', 'CUSTOMS_HOLD', 'MECHANICAL_FAILURE', 'INCORRECT_ADDRESS', 'REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE', 'DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT'). Used for exception trend analysis and carrier performance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEATHER|CARRIER_DELAY|CUSTOMS_HOLD|MECHANICAL_FAILURE|INCORRECT_ADDRESS|REFUSED_BY_CONSIGNEE|DAMAGED_IN_TRANSIT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 EDI 214; Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the carrier terminal, cross-dock, distribution center, port, or customer facility where the tracking event occurred (e.g., carrier hub code, GLN). Supports facility-level dwell time and throughput analysis.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN); Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated monetary value of the financial impact associated with this tracking event exception (e.g., cost of delay, damage claim value, re-delivery cost, expedite surcharge). Used for freight cost variance analysis and carrier chargeback management. Expressed in the currency defined by financial_impact_currency.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency operations across global consumer goods distribution networks.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: geofence_zone
attributes.description: The named geofence zone or virtual boundary that triggered this tracking event (e.g., 'CUSTOMER_DC_INBOUND', 'CARRIER_TERMINAL_CHICAGO', 'PORT_OF_LA_GATE'). Populated for GPS telematics events generated by geofence entry/exit triggers. Supports automated milestone detection without manual carrier check-ins.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: humidity_pct
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage reading captured at the time of the tracking event by an IoT sensor. Relevant for moisture-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., hygiene products, paper-based packaging). Null for shipments without humidity monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the location where the tracking event was recorded by GPS telematics or IoT sensor. Enables precise geospatial mapping of shipment progress and route deviation detection.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the location where the tracking event was recorded by GPS telematics or IoT sensor. Paired with latitude for precise geospatial analysis.

attributes.name: planned_event_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled or planned date and time for this event milestone (e.g., planned pickup time, planned delivery window). Compared against event_timestamp to calculate schedule adherence and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance at the event level.
attributes.references: SAP IBP Demand and Supply Planning; GS1 EDI 214

attributes.name: pod_method
attributes.description: The method by which Proof of Delivery (POD) was captured for a delivered event (electronic signature, paper signature, photo confirmation, or no-signature-required). Supports POD compliance tracking and carrier contract enforcement.

attributes.name: pod_signature_name
attributes.description: The name of the individual who signed for the delivery at the consignee location, as captured on the Proof of Delivery (POD) document. Populated only for 'delivered' event types. Supports dispute resolution and delivery confirmation.

attributes.name: pro_number
attributes.description: The carrier-assigned Progressive (PRO) number used to identify and track a freight shipment within the carrier's system. Serves as the primary external reference for LTL and TL carrier tracking and freight audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standard; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the corrective action taken to resolve the exception associated with this tracking event (e.g., 'REROUTED', 'REDELIVERY_SCHEDULED', 'CLAIM_FILED', 'PRODUCT_QUARANTINED', 'CARRIER_NOTIFIED', 'EXPEDITED'). Supports exception resolution tracking and SLA compliance measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REROUTED|REDELIVERY_SCHEDULED|CLAIM_FILED|PRODUCT_QUARANTINED|CARRIER_NOTIFIED|EXPEDITED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Module; ISO 9001

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the exception associated with this tracking event was resolved or closed. Used to calculate exception resolution cycle time and measure carrier SLA compliance for exception handling.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: shipment_leg_number
attributes.description: Sequential leg number within a multi-leg shipment (e.g., leg 1 = origin DC to cross-dock, leg 2 = cross-dock to destination). Enables granular tracking of multi-modal or relay shipments across the inbound and outbound network.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: speed_kmh
attributes.description: The speed of the transport vehicle in kilometers per hour at the time of the GPS telematics event. Used for route compliance monitoring, driver safety analytics, and detection of unauthorized stops or route deviations. Null for non-GPS-sourced events.
attributes.references: FMCSA Hours of Service Regulations; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: temperature_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the temperature reading at this event exceeded the shipment's defined cold-chain temperature range (temperature_min_c to temperature_max_c as defined on the parent shipment). True signals a cold-chain compliance violation requiring exception management and potential product quarantine.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; FSMA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient or product temperature reading in degrees Celsius captured at the time of the tracking event by an IoT sensor or cold-chain monitoring device. Critical for cold-chain compliance monitoring of temperature-sensitive consumer goods (e.g., personal care, food, pharmaceutical products). Null for non-cold-chain shipments.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 Good Manufacturing Practices for Cosmetics; FDA 21 CFR; FSMA

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: The carrier-issued parcel or shipment tracking number (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS tracking number) used for consumer-facing and operational track-and-trace. Distinct from PRO number which is used for freight/LTL.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; ANSI X12 EDI Standard

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation active at the time of this tracking event. Relevant for multi-modal shipments where the mode may change between legs (e.g., ocean to rail to truckload). Drives mode-specific SLA and performance benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: truckload|ltl|parcel|rail|ocean|air|intermodal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; Incoterms 2020; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this tracking event record was last modified in the silver layer lakehouse (e.g., due to a carrier correction, status update, or exception resolution). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change detection for downstream consumers.

products.name: freight_rate
products.description: Granular freight rate record defining the cost per unit of transport for a specific lane, carrier, mode, and shipment characteristic. Captures rate type (per-mile, per-cwt, per-pallet, flat), origin/destination zone or postal code range, weight break, effective and expiry dates, base rate, fuel surcharge rate, accessorial rate schedule reference, and currency. Sourced from carrier contracts and spot market quotes for freight cost estimation.

attributes.name: freight_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a freight rate record. Primary key for the freight_rate data product.

attributes.name: carrier_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier contract under which this freight rate is established. Links rate to the governing contractual agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier associated with this freight rate. Links to the carrier master for contract and service details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transportation lane (origin-destination pair) to which this freight rate applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: accessorial_schedule_code
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the accessorial charge schedule applicable to this freight rate. Accessorials include liftgate, inside delivery, residential delivery, detention, and other ancillary charges defined in the carrier tariff.

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The core freight rate amount per unit as defined by the rate_type (e.g., cost per mile, cost per CWT, cost per pallet, or flat amount). This is the primary rate value used in freight cost estimation before surcharges and accessorials are applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: cold_chain_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight rate applies to cold-chain (temperature-controlled) shipments. Critical for consumer goods categories such as perishable food, beverages, and pharmaceutical products requiring refrigerated transport.
attributes.references: ISO 22716; FDA 21 CFR; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and rate history tracking.

attributes.name: cross_border
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight rate applies to cross-border (international) shipments. Cross-border rates include additional cost components for customs, duties, and border crossing fees not present in domestic rates.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Standards; EU REACH; FDA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the freight rate is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency freight cost management and financial reporting.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination of the freight lane. Required for cross-border rate determination and import/export compliance.

attributes.name: destination_postal_code_from
attributes.description: Starting postal code of the destination zone range for this freight rate. Used for zone-based rate determination when the rate applies to a range of destination postal codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: destination_postal_code_to
attributes.description: Ending postal code of the destination zone range for this freight rate. Together with destination_postal_code_from, defines the geographic destination band to which this rate applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: destination_zone_code
attributes.description: Carrier-defined zone code for the destination geography. Used in conjunction with origin_zone_code for zone-pair rate determination in carrier tariff structures.

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Standard distance in kilometers for the origin-to-destination lane associated with this rate. Used in per-mile/per-km rate calculations and freight cost benchmarking.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this freight rate becomes valid and applicable for shipment cost estimation. Rates with effective_date in the future are pre-loaded for upcoming contract periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this rate. Reefer (refrigerated) equipment is critical for cold-chain compliance in consumer goods. Drives rate differentiation and carrier selection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Blue Yonder WMS

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this freight rate is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no defined expiration. Used to enforce rate validity windows in freight cost estimation and carrier contract management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_basis
attributes.description: Method by which the fuel surcharge is calculated and applied: as a percentage of the base rate, a flat amount per mile, or a flat amount per shipment. Determines how fuel_surcharge_rate is interpreted in cost computation.

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: Fuel surcharge rate expressed as a percentage or fixed amount applied on top of the base freight rate. Reflects carrier fuel cost pass-through and is typically indexed to a published fuel price index (e.g., DOE weekly diesel).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; DOE Fuel Index

attributes.name: hazmat_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight rate applies to hazardous materials (hazmat) shipments. Consumer goods with hazmat classification (e.g., aerosols, flammable products) require specialized rates and carrier certifications per DOT and EPA regulations.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the allocation of freight costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee under this rate. Governs which party bears the freight cost represented by this rate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: max_charge
attributes.description: Maximum charge amount that applies as a cap for this rate, regardless of shipment weight or distance. Null indicates no cap. Used in negotiated contract rates to protect shippers from excessive charges on large shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: min_charge
attributes.description: Minimum charge amount that applies regardless of shipment weight or distance. Ensures the carrier recovers a floor cost for any shipment under this rate. Used in freight cost estimation to enforce rate floor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Oracle Cloud Procurement

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin of the freight lane. Required for cross-border rate determination and customs/regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: origin_postal_code_from
attributes.description: Starting postal code of the origin zone range for this freight rate. Used for zone-based rate determination when the rate applies to a range of origin postal codes rather than a single location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: origin_postal_code_to
attributes.description: Ending postal code of the origin zone range for this freight rate. Together with origin_postal_code_from, defines the geographic origin band to which this rate applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; GS1 Global Standards

attributes.name: origin_zone_code
attributes.description: Carrier-defined zone code for the origin geography. Zone codes are used in carrier tariff structures to group postal codes into pricing zones for simplified rate lookup.

attributes.name: rate_basis_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure that defines the denominator for the base_rate. domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Owns physical inventory positions across the entire distribution network. Manages stock on hand, in-transit inventory, warehouse locations, FEFO/FIFO rotation rules, DIO metrics, OOS/OSA events, VMI replenishment triggers, lot/batch traceability for recall readiness, safety stock levels, and multi-echelon inventory visibility.

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record of physical inventory on-hand quantities for each SKU at each storage location. Captures unrestricted, quality-hold, blocked, consignment, VMI-managed, and in-transit stock quantities by stock type and special stock indicator. Serves as the authoritative real-time inventory balance (single source of truth for quantity on hand). Supports OOS/OSA monitoring, days-inventory-outstanding calculation, available-to-promise derivation, and multi-echelon inventory visibility across the distribution network.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regulatory reporting requires mapping each storage location to its jurisdiction for local compliance (labeling, safety, reporting).

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent facility (distribution center, warehouse, retail store, or third-party logistics provider) where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: WAREHOUSE MANAGEMENT: each storage location is physically part of a supply network node; required for location‑level inventory reporting.

attributes.name: warehouse_id

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification for the location based on inventory velocity and value. A for high-velocity/high-value, B for medium, C for low-velocity/low-value items. Used for slotting optimization.

attributes.name: aisle

attributes.name: bay

attributes.name: bin

attributes.name: blocked_date

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the location is blocked or unavailable, used for operational troubleshooting and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: capacity_pallet_positions

attributes.name: capacity_volume_m3

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the system for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated for cross-docking operations where goods move directly from receiving to shipping without long-term storage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location was decommissioned or removed from active use. Null for currently active locations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the storage location became operational and available for inventory placement.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS) and EPA Regulations

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within a bay, used for precise location addressing in multi-tier racking systems.

attributes.name: last_inventory_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed at this location, used for inventory accuracy tracking.
attributes.references: Inventory Management Best Practices and SOX Compliance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was most recently updated for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent inventory movement (putaway, pick, transfer) at this location, used for activity analysis and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the storage location for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and facility mapping.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the storage location used across warehouse management and inventory systems. Unique alphanumeric code assigned to each physical or logical storage position.

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the storage location for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location. Active for normal operations, blocked for temporary holds, maintenance for repairs, quarantine for quality issues, inactive for unused space, decommissioned for permanently retired locations.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location based on its operational purpose within the warehouse. Bulk storage for palletized goods, pick locations for order fulfillment, reserve for overflow, quarantine for quality hold, returns for reverse logistics, and staging for in-transit goods.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the storage location for geospatial analytics, route optimization, and facility mapping.

attributes.name: mixed_sku_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Mixed Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location permits storage of multiple SKUs simultaneously or requires single-SKU dedication for inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: picking_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for order picking optimization. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for fast-moving SKUs and efficient pick path planning.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Percentage threshold that triggers automatic replenishment from reserve to pick locations. Used in Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) and automated replenishment processes.

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied to this location. FEFO (First Expired First Out) for perishables, FIFO (First In First Out) for standard goods, LIFO (Last In First Out) for specific scenarios, or MANUAL for operator-controlled picking.
attributes.references: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and Food Safety Standards

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification of the storage location based on access controls and monitoring requirements. High-value for premium products, controlled substance for regulated materials, restricted for limited access areas.
attributes.references: Internal Security Policy and FDA Controlled Substance Regulations

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the storage location. Ambient for room temperature, refrigerated for 2-8°C, frozen for below 0°C, and controlled for specific temperature ranges required by product specifications.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: WMS zone identifier used for warehouse layout management, picking optimization, and labor allocation. Zones group locations by operational characteristics or product categories.

products.name: stock_movement
products.description: Transactional record of every inventory movement event including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, returns, write-offs, and inter-plant transfers. Captures movement type code, quantity, unit of measure, source and destination locations, posting date, reference document (purchase order, production order, delivery note), carrier/shipment reference for inter-node transfers, and posting user. Provides the full audit trail for inventory reconciliation and in-transit tracking.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Movement (MIGO) / Material Document

attributes.name: stock_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock movement transaction. Primary key for the stock movement record.

attributes.name: bom_line_id

attributes.name: campaign_flight_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign_flight. Business justification: Logistics teams track stock movements tied to specific campaign flights to measure promotional material delivery and OTIF performance.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Transportation carrier responsible for moving inventory between locations for inter-node transfers.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Cost accounting for each inventory movement requires linking to the responsible cost center for internal reporting and allocation.

attributes.name: destination_location_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Warehouse, plant, or storage location to which inventory is being moved. Null for goods issues to external destinations.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Stock movements (retailer shipments, display builds, returns) executed as part of promotion event fulfillment must be linked to the promotion event for trade spend reconciliation, deduction management

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id

Linking stock_movement to inventory_replenishment_order enables end-to-end replenishment traceability:

attributes.name: logistics_shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics shipment for inter-plant or inter-warehouse transfers to track in-transit inventory.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Needed to tie inventory movements to the originating sales order for order fulfillment audit and cost of goods sold reconciliation.

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Stock movements from GR posting must reference the specific PO line for line-level three-way match, partial delivery tracking, and invoice reconciliation. Existing purchase_order_id FK is header-level

attributes.name: primary_stock_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Warehouse, plant, or storage location from which inventory is being moved. Null for goods receipts from external sources.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Consumer goods ERP systems (SAP) require this link for

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profitability analysis of inventory flows assigns each movement to a profit center, needed for segment reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: REQUIRED: PO receipt tracking for OTIF reporting and financial reconciliation links stock movements to the originating purchase order.
