attributes.description: Reference to the original stock movement record that this transaction reverses or cancels.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU involved in this stock movement event.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Supplier or vendor from whom goods were received for goods receipt movements.

attributes.name: trade_account_id
attributes.description: Customer to whom goods were issued for sales order fulfillment or Direct to Consumer (DTC) shipments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock movement record was first created in the system for audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the movement value (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date on the source document (purchase order, production order, delivery note) that triggered this movement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Shelf life expiration date for perishable or time-sensitive products. Critical for First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation and Out of Stock (OOS) prevention.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this stock movement record was last updated or modified for change tracking.

attributes.name: manufacturing_date
attributes.description: Date when the product was manufactured or produced. Used for shelf life calculation and traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 22716 GMP for Cosmetics, FDA 21 CFR Part 211

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: SAP material document number generated for this goods movement. Unique identifier in the source ERP system.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year of the material document for SAP document key uniqueness.

attributes.name: movement_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the movement event for reporting and analytics purposes.

attributes.name: movement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the stock movement event.

attributes.name: movement_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the physical inventory movement occurred or was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: movement_type_code
attributes.description: SAP movement type code identifying the nature of the inventory transaction (e.g., 101=Goods Receipt from PO, 261=Goods Issue to Production, 311=Stock Transfer, 551=Scrapping, 601=Goods Receipt from Delivery).

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Manufacturing plant or distribution center code where the movement occurred.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the stock movement was posted to the inventory ledger for financial and inventory accounting purposes.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this stock movement requires quality inspection before the inventory can be released for use.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory moved in this transaction. Positive for receipts/increases, negative for issues/decreases.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Code explaining the business reason for the movement (e.g., quality issue, damage, expiration, customer return, production scrap).

attributes.name: reference_document_line
attributes.description: Line item number within the reference document that corresponds to this stock movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the source transaction (PO number, production order number, delivery note number) that triggered this movement.

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that initiated this stock movement for audit trail and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase_order|production_order|sales_order|delivery_note|transfer_order|return_order|adjustment_document — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this movement is a reversal or cancellation of a previous stock movement transaction.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items requiring individual unit tracking.
attributes.references: GS1 SGTIN (Serialized Global Trade Item Number)

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: SAP special stock type indicator (e.g., E=Sales Order Stock, K=Consignment Stock, O=Project Stock, W=Vendor Managed Inventory).

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of inventory status determining availability for use (unrestricted=available for sale/use, quality_inspection=pending QC, blocked=not available).

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific storage location or bin within the plant or warehouse where inventory is stored.

attributes.name: total_value
attributes.description: Total financial value of the inventory movement (quantity × unit cost) for financial reporting and inventory accounting.
attributes.references: GAAP Inventory Valuation, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of inventory at the time of movement for inventory valuation and Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP Inventory Valuation, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the movement quantity (e.g., EA=Each, CS=Case, KG=Kilogram, LT=Liter).

attributes.name: valuation_type
attributes.description: Sub-classification for split valuation of the same material (e.g., domestic vs imported, new vs refurbished).

products.name: inventory_replenishment_order
products.description: Transactional record of inventory replenishment requests and orders generated through VMI auto-replenishment, distribution requirements planning (DRP), or manual triggers. Captures replenishment type, requested quantity, approved quantity, source location, destination location, requested delivery date, priority, and fulfillment status. Closes the loop between demand sensing signals and physical stock movement execution.
products.reference: SAP IBP DRP / VMI Replenishment Order

attributes.name: inventory_replenishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory replenishment order record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Promotional campaigns trigger dedicated replenishment orders; linking enables the Campaign‑Driven Replenishment Report used in trade spend planning.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics carrier assigned to transport this replenishment shipment from source to destination.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Replenishment orders are charged to cost centers for budgeting and cost tracking of inventory replenishment.

attributes.name: destination_location_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or retail location that will receive the replenished inventory.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to promotion.promotion_event. Business justification: Replenishment orders are frequently triggered by upcoming promotion events (promotional inventory build). Linking enables promotion-driven supply chain planning, post-event analysis of inventory avail

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to logistics.lane. Business justification: Replenishment orders in consumer goods are executed on specific logistics lanes that determine transit time, carrier assignment, and freight cost — all critical inputs to replenishment planning and OT

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: When a replenishment order is received, it is associated with a specific lot/batch for FEFO rotation and shelf-life compliance. The existing lot_number STRING column is a denormalized reference; repla

attributes.name: primary_inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing facility from which inventory will be shipped to fulfill this replenishment order.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_order. Business justification: In make-to-stock consumer goods operations, inventory replenishment orders fulfilled by internal manufacturing are directly linked to the production order that will produce the stock. Supply planners

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center allocation of replenishment orders supports segment‑level expense reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_requisition. Business justification: REQUIRED: Internal replenishment orders are driven by purchase requisitions; linking supports demand‑driven planning.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU being replenished. Links to the product master for item details.

attributes.name: stock_position_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_position. Business justification: A replenishment order is triggered by a specific stock position falling below safety stock or reorder point thresholds (safety_stock_trigger_flag, oos_prevention_flag on inventory_replenishment_order)

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Replenishment orders are fulfilled by a specific supplier. Consumer goods supply planners track supplier-level fill rates and lead time adherence per replenishment order. No existing FK links replenis

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment was received at the destination location. Used to measure delivery performance and OTIF compliance.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Actual date the shipment departed from the source location. Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance.

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU approved for fulfillment after review and Available to Promise (ATP) validation. May differ from requested quantity due to supply constraints.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable. Examples include demand change, supply constraint, or duplicate order.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the product should not be sold or used. Used to enforce First Expired First Out (FEFO) rotation rules in inventory management.

attributes.name: freight_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total freight cost incurred for transporting this replenishment order from source to destination location.

attributes.name: freight_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the freight cost amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of days between order placement and delivery at the destination location, based on historical lane performance.

attributes.name: oos_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was created to prevent an anticipated Out of Stock (OOS) event based on demand forecasting.

attributes.name: order_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was approved for fulfillment by the supply chain planner or automated approval workflow.

attributes.name: order_cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was cancelled, if applicable. Null for active orders.

attributes.name: order_creation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the replenishment order was first created in the system, either automatically by planning algorithms or manually by a planner.

attributes.name: order_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for planners to capture special instructions, handling requirements, or contextual information about the replenishment order.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the replenishment order indicating its position in the fulfillment workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|in_transit|received|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to the replenishment order to guide fulfillment sequencing and resource allocation. Critical orders address Out of Stock (OOS) situations.

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity received and confirmed at the destination location. May differ from shipped quantity due to damage or discrepancies.

attributes.name: replenishment_order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the replenishment order, used for tracking and communication across systems and stakeholders.

attributes.name: replenishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the replenishment order generation method: Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) auto-replenishment, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) planned order, manual trigger by planner, safety stock replenishment, emergency order, or seasonal build.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the replenishment inventory is needed at the destination location to prevent Out of Stock (OOS) conditions.

attributes.name: requested_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the SKU requested for replenishment, as calculated by the demand planning system or entered by the planner.

attributes.name: rotation_rule
attributes.description: Inventory rotation policy applied to this replenishment: First Expired First Out (FEFO) for perishables, First In First Out (FIFO) for standard goods, Last In First Out (LIFO) for specific scenarios.

attributes.name: safety_stock_trigger_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this replenishment order was triggered by inventory falling below the safety stock threshold at the destination location.

attributes.name: scheduled_ship_date
attributes.description: Planned date for shipment departure from the source location, calculated based on lead time and requested delivery date.

attributes.name: shipment_tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for the shipment associated with this replenishment order. Used for in-transit visibility.

attributes.name: shipped_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity shipped from the source location. Updated when the shipment is dispatched.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the replenishment quantity is expressed: Each (EA), Case (CS), Pallet (PL), Pound (LB), Kilogram (KG), Liter (L), Gallon (GAL). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|LB|KG|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: inventory_cycle_count
products.description: Transactional record of physical inventory cycle count events conducted at storage locations. Captures count date, count method (full physical, ABC cycle, perpetual), counted quantity, system quantity, variance quantity, variance percentage, count status (planned, in-progress, confirmed, posted), and approver. Supports inventory accuracy KPIs, shrinkage investigation triggers, and WMS reconciliation. Distinct from stock_movement as it represents a formal audit event, not a stock transaction.
products.reference: SAP MM Physical Inventory (MI01/MI07) / Blue Yonder Cycle Count

attributes.name: inventory_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory cycle count event. Primary key for the cycle count record.

attributes.name: inventory_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse storage location where the cycle count was performed. Links to the physical bin, aisle, or zone within the facility.

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.lot_batch. Business justification: Cycle counts in consumer goods are conducted at the lot/batch level to verify lot-specific quantities, especially for perishable and regulated products. The existing lot_number STRING column is a deno

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count was performed. Supports multi-site inventory management.

attributes.name: original_count_inventory_cycle_count_id
attributes.description: If this is a recount, references the inventory_cycle_count_id of the original count that triggered the recount requirement. Null for initial counts.

attributes.name: planning_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.planning_period. Business justification: S&OP inventory accuracy reporting: consumer goods companies schedule cycle counts aligned with planning periods (monthly/quarterly) to feed inventory accuracy metrics into S&OP. This link enables peri

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) that was counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: stock_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_adjustment. Business justification: A cycle count variance triggers a stock adjustment to correct the inventory balance. The existing adjustment_document_number STRING column is a denormalized reference to the resulting adjustment; repl

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC inventory classification of the SKU at the time of count. A = high-value items counted frequently, B = medium-value, C = low-value counted less frequently. Drives cycle count frequency.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance has been posted as an inventory adjustment in the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system. True = adjustment posted, False = pending posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count was approved by the authorized supervisor. Part of the audit trail for inventory adjustments.

attributes.name: count_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the physical cycle count was performed.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The methodology used for the cycle count. Full physical = complete inventory audit, ABC cycle = frequency-based counting by value classification, perpetual = continuous counting, spot check = random verification, blind count = counter does not see system quantity.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management, WMS Best Practices

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event. Planned = scheduled but not started, in_progress = counting underway, confirmed = count verified, posted = variance adjusted in system, cancelled = count voided, recount_required = variance exceeds threshold.

attributes.name: count_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the cycle count was executed. Used for audit trail and WMS (Warehouse Management System) reconciliation.

attributes.name: count_zone
attributes.description: The warehouse zone or area designation where the count took place (e.g., receiving, picking, reserve, quarantine). Used for zone-based cycle count scheduling.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse associate during the cycle count event. Measured in the SKU's unit of measure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the lot/batch counted. Critical for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation rules and consumer safety in CPG (Consumer Packaged Goods).

attributes.name: inventory_value_at_count
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the counted inventory based on the counted quantity and the unit cost at the time of count. Used for financial reconciliation and shrinkage cost calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated. Tracks changes through the count lifecycle (planned → in_progress → confirmed → posted).

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counted inventory is in quarantine status pending quality inspection or regulatory clearance. True = quarantined, False = available.

attributes.name: recount_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count is a recount of a previous count that exceeded variance thresholds. True = recount, False = initial count.

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity recorded in the WMS (Warehouse Management System) or ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system at the time of the count. Used to calculate variance.
attributes.references: SAP WM/EWM, Blue Yonder WMS Standards

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counted inventory is stored in a temperature-controlled environment. True = cold chain storage, False = ambient. Relevant for perishable consumer goods.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the inventory was counted. EA = each, CS = case, PL = pallet, KG = kilogram, LB = pound, L = liter, GAL = gallon. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|KG|LB|L|GAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or additional context provided by the counter or approver regarding the variance. Used for investigation and documentation.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the system quantity. Calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100. Used to trigger investigation thresholds.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between counted quantity and system quantity (counted minus system). Positive values indicate overage, negative values indicate shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Categorization of the root cause for the inventory variance. Used for shrinkage analysis, process improvement, and loss prevention. products.name: recall_lot_scope
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory compliance artifact that enumerates exactly which lot/batch records are covered by each recall event, with per-lot recovery tracking. It captures the scope and recovery status of each recall at the lot level, replacing the denormalized affected_lot_batch_range STRING field on recall_event. Each record links one recall_event to one lot_batch and carries attributes — quantity recalled per lot, quantity recovered per lot, lot-level recall status, and recovery date — that exist only in the context of this specific recall-lot pairing. Required for FDA effectiveness checks and regulatory reporting obligations.. Existence Justification: In consumer goods regulatory operations, a single recall event explicitly covers multiple specific lot/batch numbers (e.g., Recall #2024-001 covers Lot A123, Lot B456, Lot C789), AND a single lot/batch can theoretically be implicated in multiple recall events over its lifecycle (e.g., a contamination recall and a labeling recall affecting overlapping lots). More critically, the business must track per-lot recovery status, quantities recalled per lot, and recovery dates — data that belongs neither to the recall event header nor to the lot master record alone. Regulatory bodies (FDA, CPSC) require manufacturers to report exactly which lot numbers are covered and the recovery status per lot, making this an operationally managed compliance artifact.

attributes.description: Primary key for the recall_lot_scope association

attributes.name: lot_batch_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recall Lot Scope - Lot Batch Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific lot or batch record included in this recall scope

attributes.name: recall_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Recall Lot Scope - Recall Event Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the recall event that covers this lot/batch record

attributes.name: affected_lot_batch_range
attributes.description: Specification of the lot numbers, batch codes, or serial number ranges included in the recall. Critical for traceability and targeted recovery. May be expressed as ranges, lists, or patterns. [Moved from recall_event: This STRING field is a denormalized placeholder that stores lot/batch ranges as unstructured text. It cannot support proper lot-level traceability, per-lot quantity tracking, or regulatory reporting. Its functional purpose is entirely replaced by the recall_lot_scope association table, which provides a proper FK-based enumeration of affected lots with per-lot recovery attributes. This field should be deprecated and removed from recall_event once recall_lot_scope is populated.]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 (FSMA Traceability), GMP Batch Record Requirements

attributes.name: lot_recall_status
attributes.description: The current recovery status of this specific lot/batch within the recall action. Tracks per-lot progress independently of the overall recall event status. Pending: recovery not yet initiated for this lot; In Progress: recovery activities underway; Recovered: full recovery achieved; Destroyed: product destroyed in lieu of return; Not Located: product cannot be traced.

attributes.name: quantity_recalled_per_lot
attributes.description: The quantity of product from this specific lot/batch that is subject to the recall action. May differ from the lot's total quantity_produced if only a portion was distributed or affected. Required for per-lot FDA effectiveness reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_recovered_per_lot
attributes.description: The actual quantity of product from this specific lot/batch that has been recovered from the market through returns, destruction, or retrieval. Used to calculate per-lot recovery effectiveness rate for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which recovery activities for this specific lot/batch were completed. Null if recovery is not yet complete. Used to calculate time-to-recovery per lot and to support FDA effectiveness check submissions.

Managed in Veeva Vault.

attributes.name: sds_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Safety Data Sheet record. Primary key.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS) are jurisdiction-specific documents — GHS classifications, regulatory information, and required statements vary by country and regulatory framework. The sds table current

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the raw material, finished good, or intermediate product that this SDS describes.

attributes.name: accidental_release_measures
attributes.description: Personal precautions, protective equipment, emergency procedures, and methods for containment and cleanup of spills or releases.

attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Visual description of the substance including color and form.

attributes.name: authoring_chemist
attributes.description: Name of the qualified chemist or toxicologist who authored or reviewed this SDS for technical accuracy.

attributes.name: autoignition_temperature
attributes.description: Temperature at which the substance will spontaneously ignite without an external ignition source.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the chemical substance or mixture, if applicable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposal_considerations
attributes.description: Guidance on proper disposal methods, waste treatment, and applicable regulations for the substance and contaminated packaging.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety document type: SDS (Safety Data Sheet per GHS), MSDS (Material Safety Data Sheet legacy format), or Extended SDS (with additional exposure scenarios).

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Locator (URL) or file path to the published SDS document in the document management system.

attributes.name: ecological_information
attributes.description: Environmental impact data including aquatic toxicity, persistence and degradability, bioaccumulative potential, and mobility in soil.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this SDS version becomes the official document for regulatory and operational use.

attributes.name: emergency_phone_number
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency contact telephone number for chemical emergency response (e.g., CHEMTREC, poison control).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS version is superseded or no longer valid, requiring update or renewal.

attributes.name: exposure_limits
attributes.description: Occupational exposure limits (OELs), permissible exposure limits (PELs), threshold limit values (TLVs), and biological exposure indices.
attributes.references: OSHA PEL, ACGIH TLV, GHS Section 8

attributes.name: firefighting_measures
attributes.description: Suitable extinguishing media, unsuitable extinguishing media, and special hazards arising from the substance or mixture during fire.

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Detailed first aid instructions for different exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as required by GHS Section 4.

attributes.name: flash_point
attributes.description: Lowest temperature at which vapors of the substance will ignite when given an ignition source, typically in degrees Celsius.

attributes.name: ghs_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification codes assigned to this substance or mixture (e.g., Flam. Liq. 2, Acute Tox. 3, Skin Corr. 1B).

attributes.name: handling_precautions
attributes.description: Safe handling practices and precautions for use to prevent exposure and ensure worker safety.

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS hazard statements (H-codes) describing the nature and degree of hazards (e.g., H225: Highly flammable liquid and vapor).

attributes.name: hazardous_decomposition_products
attributes.description: Hazardous substances that may be formed under fire conditions or other decomposition scenarios.

attributes.name: incompatible_materials
attributes.description: Materials or substances that should not be stored or used with this product due to potential hazardous reactions.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when this SDS was originally issued or first published.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which this SDS is written (e.g., EN for English, ES for Spanish).

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Complete physical address of the manufacturer or supplier for regulatory contact purposes.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the company that manufactures or supplies the product covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SDS record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: odor
attributes.description: Characteristic odor of the substance or mixture, if detectable.

attributes.name: packing_group
attributes.description: UN packing group indicating degree of danger for transport: I (high danger), II (medium danger), III (low danger).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: personal_protective_equipment
attributes.description: Required personal protective equipment for safe handling: respiratory protection, hand protection, eye protection, skin protection.

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: pH measurement of the substance or mixture, indicating acidity or alkalinity.

attributes.name: physical_state
attributes.description: Physical form of the substance or mixture at ambient conditions.

attributes.name: pictograms
attributes.description: List of GHS pictogram codes required on the label (e.g., GHS02 Flame, GHS07 Exclamation Mark, GHS08 Health Hazard).

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS precautionary statements (P-codes) describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects (e.g., P210: Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames).

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal product code or SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for the material covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The commercial or chemical name of the product or substance covered by this SDS.

attributes.name: proper_shipping_name
attributes.description: Official shipping name for transport documentation as specified by UN/DOT regulations.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_information
attributes.description: Applicable regulatory requirements including TSCA status, REACH registration, California Prop 65, SARA Title III, and other jurisdiction-specific regulations.

attributes.name: revision_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the SDS was last revised or updated.

attributes.name: sds_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique document number assigned to this SDS, used for regulatory submissions and cross-referencing.

attributes.name: sds_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SDS document within the regulatory document management system.

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS signal word indicating the severity level of the hazard: Danger (more severe) or Warning (less severe).

attributes.name: stability
attributes.description: Chemical stability information and conditions to avoid that may cause instability or hazardous reactions.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Conditions for safe storage including temperature, humidity, ventilation requirements, and incompatible materials.

attributes.name: toxicological_information
attributes.description: Comprehensive toxicology data including acute toxicity, skin corrosion/irritation, eye damage/irritation, sensitization, mutagenicity, carcinogenicity, reproductive toxicity, and target organ effects.

attributes.name: transport_hazard_class
attributes.description: UN/DOT hazard class for transportation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives).
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN identification number for hazardous materials transport classification.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on Transport of Dangerous Goods, DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this SDS revision, tracking document evolution over time.

products.name: ingredient_list
products.description: Ingredient declaration records capturing the full ingredient list for a finished product SKU as required for labeling compliance. Tracks INCI names, CAS numbers, concentration ranges, function (preservative, surfactant, fragrance, colorant), declaration order, jurisdiction-specific requirements (FDA 21 CFR, EU Cosmetics Regulation, REACH), allergen flags, and restricted substance flags. Links to product master and formulation records.
products.reference: INCI / FDA 21 CFR / EU Cosmetics Regulation

attributes.name: ingredient_list_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ingredient_list

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formulation record that defines the recipe and composition for this product. Links to formulation master data.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Ingredient declarations are jurisdiction-specific — the required INCI names, declaration formats, and allergen disclosure requirements vary by regulatory jurisdiction (EU Cosmetics Regulation, FDA OTC

attributes.name: restricted_substance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.restricted_substance. Business justification: Each ingredient in an ingredient declaration may be a restricted substance subject to prohibition, restriction, or authorization requirements. The ingredient_list table currently stores restricted_sub

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the finished product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this ingredient declaration applies. Links to product master data.

attributes.name: allergen_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is a known allergen requiring special labeling or disclosure per regulatory requirements (e.g., EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex III).
attributes.references: EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex III, FDA Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allergen type if allergen_flag is true. Used for consumer safety labeling and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the regulatory affairs professional who approved this ingredient declaration for use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration was approved by regulatory affairs.

attributes.name: cas_number
attributes.description: Unique CAS (Chemical Abstracts Service) registry number identifying the chemical substance. Used for regulatory submissions and safety documentation.

attributes.name: common_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the ingredient used for internal reference and non-regulated communications.

attributes.name: concentration_max_percent
attributes.description: Maximum concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for regulatory submissions and formulation specifications.

attributes.name: concentration_min_percent
attributes.description: Minimum concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for regulatory submissions and formulation specifications.

attributes.name: concentration_typical_percent
attributes.description: Typical or target concentration of the ingredient in the finished product, expressed as a percentage by weight. Used for quality control and manufacturing guidance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: declaration_name_override
attributes.description: Alternative name to be used on the product label if different from INCI name, as permitted by jurisdiction-specific regulations (e.g., trade name, common name).

attributes.name: declaration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient must be declared on the product label per regulatory requirements. Some processing aids or trace contaminants may be exempt.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ingredient declaration record in the regulatory documentation workflow.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this ingredient declaration becomes effective for regulatory compliance and labeling purposes.

attributes.name: einecs_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances (EINECS) Number
attributes.description: EINECS (European Inventory of Existing Commercial Chemical Substances) number for substances marketed in the EU before September 1981. Required for EU REACH compliance.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this ingredient declaration is no longer valid, typically due to formulation changes or regulatory updates. Null indicates no expiration.

attributes.name: fda_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Regulatory Status
attributes.description: FDA (Food and Drug Administration) regulatory status of the ingredient for use in consumer goods (e.g., GRAS - Generally Recognized As Safe, approved food additive, approved color additive).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR, FDA GRAS Notice Inventory

attributes.name: ifra_amendment_number
attributes.description: IFRA (International Fragrance Association) amendment number that governs the use restrictions for this ingredient if IFRA restricted.
attributes.references: IFRA Standards and Code of Practice

attributes.name: ifra_restricted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is subject to IFRA (International Fragrance Association) restrictions or standards for use in fragrance compounds.
attributes.references: IFRA Standards and Code of Practice

attributes.name: inci_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients (INCI) Name
attributes.description: Standardized INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients) name for the ingredient as required for cosmetic product labeling. Mandatory for cosmetics and personal care products.
attributes.references: INCI International Cosmetic Ingredient Dictionary and Handbook

attributes.name: ingredient_function
attributes.description: Primary functional role of the ingredient in the formulation (e.g., preservative, surfactant, fragrance, colorant, active ingredient). Used for regulatory classification and formulation analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preservative|surfactant|emollient|humectant|emulsifier|thickener|fragrance|colorant|active_ingredient|solvent|ph_adjuster|antioxidant|chelating_agent|opacifier|film_former — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ingredient_sequence
attributes.description: Order in which this ingredient appears on the product label declaration. Typically sorted by descending concentration per regulatory requirements (FDA 21 CFR, EU Cosmetics Regulation).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR 701.3, EU Cosmetics Regulation 1223/2009 Annex I

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this ingredient declaration record was last modified in the data platform.

attributes.name: nanomaterial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is in nanomaterial form, requiring special labeling per EU Cosmetics Regulation (nano) designation.

attributes.name: natural_origin_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is derived from natural sources (plant, mineral, animal) as opposed to synthetic or petrochemical sources. Used for natural product claims and marketing.
attributes.references: ISO 16128 Natural and Organic Cosmetics Standard

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is certified organic by a recognized certification body (e.g., USDA Organic, COSMOS, ECOCERT). Used for organic product claims.
attributes.references: USDA Organic Standards, COSMOS Standard, ECOCERT

attributes.name: palm_oil_derivative_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is derived from palm oil. Used for sustainable sourcing tracking and RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) compliance.

attributes.name: reach_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals (REACH) Registration Number
attributes.description: REACH (Registration Evaluation Authorization and Restriction of Chemicals) registration number for substances manufactured or imported in the EU in quantities of 1 tonne or more per year.

attributes.name: rspo_certified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil (RSPO) Certified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether palm-derived ingredients are RSPO (Roundtable on Sustainable Palm Oil) certified for sustainable sourcing.

attributes.name: sds_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number linking this ingredient to its Safety Data Sheet (SDS) or Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS) document for hazard communication and workplace safety.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this record in the source system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system from which this ingredient declaration record originated (e.g., Veeva Vault, SAP PLM, internal formulation system).

attributes.name: vegan_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ingredient is free from animal-derived substances and suitable for vegan product claims.
attributes.references: Vegan Society Standards, Internal Vegan Certification

products.name: label_version
products.description: Product label version master tracking all approved and historical label artwork versions for each SKU across markets. Captures label version number, market/country, language, label type (primary, secondary, shipper), regulatory approval status, approval date, approving authority, label claims, warning statements, net content declaration, country-of-origin, and Veeva Vault document reference. Supports multi-jurisdictional labeling compliance.
products.reference: FTC Labeling / FDA CFR / EU Labeling Directive

attributes.name: label_version_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the label version record. Primary key.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Label versions are market- and jurisdiction-specific — labeling language, required warnings, ingredient declaration format, and net content units vary by jurisdiction. The label_version table currentl

attributes.name: previous_version_label_version_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding label version that this version supersedes, enabling version lineage tracking.

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_registration. Business justification: A product label version is approved under a specific regulatory registration — the label artwork, claims, and warnings must conform to the registration approval. This FK links each label version to th

attributes.name: regulatory_claim_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Label Claim Assignment - Regulatory Claim Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the approved regulatory claim being assigned to this label version.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU this label version applies to.

attributes.name: allergen_declarations
attributes.description: Allergen declarations required on the label (e.g., 'Contains: milk, soy, tree nuts'). Applicable for food and cosmetic products.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the label version received regulatory approval from the governing authority.

attributes.name: approval_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the regulatory approval expires and the label version can no longer be used, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference or registration number assigned by the regulatory authority for this label approval.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of this specific claim-on-label-version assignment. Distinct from the regulatory_claim's own approval_status — a globally approved claim may still be pending approval for a specific label version in a specific market.

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or authority that approved this label version (e.g., FDA, EPA, EU Commission, Health Canada).

attributes.name: artwork_checksum
attributes.description: SHA-256 checksum hash of the artwork file to ensure file integrity and detect unauthorized modifications.

attributes.name: artwork_file_name
attributes.description: File name of the approved label artwork file (e.g., PDF, AI, or other format) stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: barcode_type
attributes.description: Type of barcode symbology printed on the label (e.g., UPC, EAN-13, GTIN-14, QR Code, DataMatrix).

attributes.name: barcode_value
attributes.description: The encoded value of the barcode printed on this label version (e.g., UPC number, GTIN, serialized data).

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: Brand name displayed on the label.

attributes.name: certification_marks
attributes.description: Third-party certification marks and compliance logos displayed on the label (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Leaping Bunny', 'Non-GMO Project', 'Kosher', 'Halal').
attributes.references: USDA NOP, Leaping Bunny, Non-GMO Project, Kosher Certification Bodies

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for creating this new label version (e.g., 'Regulatory requirement change', 'Ingredient reformulation', 'Packaging redesign', 'Correction of error').

attributes.name: contact_information
attributes.description: Consumer contact information displayed on the label (phone number, website, email) for inquiries and customer service.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced, as declared on the label.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, FTC Country of Origin Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label version record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: distributor_name
attributes.description: Name of the distributor or importer as declared on the label, if different from manufacturer.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific claim becomes effective on this label version. May differ from the claim's own effective_date when market-specific or label-version-specific activation timing applies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this label version is no longer valid for new production. Nullable for currently active versions.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this label version becomes effective and can be used in production and distribution.

attributes.name: expiry_date_format
attributes.description: Format specification for how the expiry or best-before date will be printed on the label (e.g., 'MM/YYYY', 'DD-MMM-YYYY', 'EXP: YYYY-MM-DD').

attributes.name: ingredient_list
attributes.description: Full ingredient list as declared on the label in descending order of predominance, following regulatory naming conventions (INCI for cosmetics, common names for food).
attributes.references: FDA CFR 21 Part 101.4, INCI (International Nomenclature of Cosmetic Ingredients), EU Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: is_current_version
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is the currently active label version for the SKU in the specified market. True if current, False if historical.

attributes.name: label_claims
attributes.description: Marketing claims and statements appearing on the label (e.g., 'organic', 'hypoallergenic', 'dermatologist tested', 'cruelty-free'). Pipe-separated list if multiple.
attributes.references: FTC Green Guides, FDA CFR 21 Part 101, EU Regulation 1223/2009

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Classification of the label type: primary (consumer-facing package), secondary (outer carton), shipper (distribution box), pallet (logistics unit), promotional (limited edition), or sample (trial size).

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code, optionally with ISO 3166-1 country code (e.g., en, en-US, fr-CA) indicating the label language.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who last modified this label version record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this label version record was last modified.

attributes.name: lot_code_format
attributes.description: Format specification for the lot or batch code that will be printed on labels during production (e.g., 'YYMMDD-LLLL' where LLLL is line code).

attributes.name: manufacturer_address
attributes.description: Full address of the manufacturer as declared on the label for regulatory compliance and consumer contact.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer as declared on the label for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: market_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/market code indicating the specific market for which this claim is authorized on this label version. Supports multi-jurisdictional labeling compliance.

attributes.name: net_content_declaration
attributes.description: Full net content declaration statement as it appears on the label, including quantity and unit (e.g., '500 ml', '16 fl oz (473 ml)').

attributes.name: net_content_quantity
attributes.description: Numeric value of the net content quantity declared on the label.

attributes.name: net_content_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net content quantity (e.g., ml, g, oz, fl_oz, count). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ml|l|g|kg|oz|lb|fl_oz|gal|count|each — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: product_name_on_label
attributes.description: The exact product name as it appears on the label artwork, which may differ from internal product names due to marketing or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FDA CFR 21 Part 101, FTC Labeling Guidelines

attributes.name: recycling_symbols
attributes.description: Recycling symbols and sustainability marks displayed on the label (e.g., 'Recyclable', 'FSC Certified', 'Green Dot', resin identification codes).
attributes.references: ISO 14021, FSC, RSPO, EU Packaging Directive

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the label version in the target market jurisdiction. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|approved|rejected|withdrawn|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: veeva_vault_document_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the label artwork document stored in Veeva Vault regulatory document management system.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version number of the label artwork (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Follows semantic versioning convention.

attributes.name: warning_statements
attributes.description: Mandatory warning and precautionary statements required by regulatory authorities (e.g., 'Keep out of reach of children', 'For external use only').
attributes.references: FDA CFR 21, CPSC, EPA FIFRA, GHS

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the person who created this label version record.

products.name: compliance_obligation
products.description: Master record of regulatory compliance obligations applicable to the business by jurisdiction, product category, and governing body. Tracks obligation type (registration, labeling, reporting, testing, notification, renewal), governing regulation (CFR part, EU directive, REACH article, state law), applicable product categories, compliance deadline, renewal frequency, advance notice period, responsible regulatory affairs owner, estimated compliance cost, and current compliance status. Drives the regulatory compliance calendar and proactive renewal management.
products.reference: FDA / EPA / EU REACH / CPSC Regulatory Frameworks

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compliance obligation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Compliance budgeting assigns each obligation to a cost center for internal charge‑back and reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Expense for a compliance obligation is posted to a specific GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Compliance obligations are defined per regulatory jurisdiction; linking provides a normalized reference and removes duplicated jurisdiction fields.

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the regulatory registration to which the obligation applies.

attributes.name: advance_notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days in advance that the business must be notified or begin preparation to meet this compliance obligation.

attributes.name: applicability_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance obligation became applicable to this specific regulatory registration. Belongs to the pairing, not to either parent entity, as the same obligation may become applicable to different registrations at different times.

attributes.name: applicable_product_category
attributes.description: The product category or categories to which this compliance obligation applies (e.g., cosmetics, household cleaners, personal care, food contact materials).

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the compliance obligation must be fulfilled to avoid regulatory penalties or non-compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Framework, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or context regarding this compliance obligation, including special instructions, historical context, or exceptions.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current status of compliance with this obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated compliance cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this compliance obligation becomes effective and enforceable.
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Framework, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: estimated_compliance_cost
attributes.description: The estimated financial cost to fulfill this compliance obligation, including registration fees, testing costs, documentation, and labor.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when this compliance obligation expires or is no longer applicable, if applicable.

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or governing body that enforces this obligation (e.g., FDA, EPA, CPSC, EU Commission).
attributes.references: FDA, EPA, CPSC, EU REACH, IFRA, ISO

attributes.name: governing_regulation
attributes.description: The specific regulation, directive, or legal framework that mandates this obligation (e.g., CFR 21 Part 701, EU Directive 2009/48/EC, REACH Article 33).
attributes.references: CFR (Code of Federal Regulations), EU REACH Regulation, FDA Regulations

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance obligation is currently active and applicable to the business.

attributes.name: last_compliance_verification_date
attributes.description: The date when compliance with this obligation was last verified or audited.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this compliance obligation record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next internal or external audit of compliance with this obligation.

attributes.name: next_due_date_override
attributes.description: A registration-specific override of the standard compliance deadline defined on the parent compliance_obligation. Used when a regulatory authority grants an extension or imposes an earlier deadline for a specific registered product.

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The date when the next renewal or re-certification of this obligation is due.

attributes.name: notification_sent_date
attributes.description: The date when the compliance deadline notification was sent to the responsible owner.

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance notification has been sent to the responsible owner regarding the upcoming compliance deadline.

attributes.name: obligation_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the compliance obligation, used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: obligation_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the compliance obligation.

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance obligation by regulatory action required.
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Framework, EU REACH Regulation

attributes.name: penalty_for_non_compliance
attributes.description: Description of the penalties, fines, or consequences for failing to meet this compliance obligation (e.g., product recall, market withdrawal, monetary fines, legal action).
attributes.references: FDA Enforcement Policy, EU REACH Regulation, CPSC Guidelines

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: The business priority assigned to fulfilling this compliance obligation, used for resource allocation and scheduling.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this compliance obligation must be renewed or re-certified.

attributes.name: required_documentation
attributes.description: List or description of the documentation required to fulfill this compliance obligation (e.g., Safety Data Sheet (SDS), ingredient declaration, test reports, certificates of analysis).
attributes.references: FDA Regulatory Framework, EU REACH Regulation, ISO 22716

attributes.name: responsible_department
attributes.description: The department or business unit responsible for managing this compliance obligation (e.g., Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Legal).

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: The assessed risk level associated with non-compliance with this obligation, based on potential business impact, regulatory scrutiny, and penalty severity.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this compliance obligation data originates (e.g., Veeva Vault, SAP ERP, internal regulatory database).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this compliance obligation in the source system of record.

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: The method by which compliance documentation or filings must be submitted to the governing body.
attributes.references: FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway, EU REACH-IT Portal

attributes.name: submission_portal_url
attributes.description: The web address of the electronic portal or system where compliance submissions must be filed, if applicable.
attributes.references: FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway, EU REACH-IT Portal

attributes.name: testing_requirement
attributes.description: Description of any laboratory testing or analytical work required to demonstrate compliance (e.g., stability testing, microbial testing, heavy metals analysis, allergen testing).
attributes.references: OECD Guidelines for Testing of Chemicals, ISO 9001, FDA Testing Standards

attributes.name: waiver_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver has been granted, is pending, or has expired for this specific obligation-registration pairing. A waiver is granted at the intersection level — the same obligation may be waived for one registration but enforced for another.

products.name: compliance_assessment
products.description: Transactional records documenting compliance assessments against specific regulatory requirements (CFR, IFRA, EU CLP, REACH, state regulations) for each product, formulation, or facility. Captures regulatory framework, specific requirement reference, compliance assessment date, assessor, compliance finding (compliant, non-compliant, conditional), corrective action required, corrective action due date, closure date, and evidence document reference. Supports multi-framework compliance verification including FDA/EPA audit readiness and IFRA fragrance safety substantiation. SSOT for all regulatory compliance assessments regardless of governing body.

attributes.name: compliance_assessment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for compliance_assessment

attributes.name: approved_supplier_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.approved_supplier_list. Business justification: Approved supplier list entries in consumer goods are established and periodically re-evaluated based on compliance assessments. The ASL has compliance_status and re_evaluation_due_date fields whose va

attributes.name: compliance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.compliance_obligation. Business justification: A compliance assessment is a transactional record documenting the evaluation of compliance against a specific regulatory obligation. The compliance_obligation is the master record defining what must b

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Compliance assessment costs (third-party auditors, lab testing, certification fees) are charged to regulatory affairs cost centers. Consumer goods companies track assessment spend by cost center for d

attributes.name: formulation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific product formulation undergoing compliance assessment.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.goods_receipt. Business justification: Incoming goods receipts for regulated materials (cosmetic ingredients, household chemicals) trigger compliance assessments — certificate of analysis review, GMP batch release, restricted substance che

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Compliance assessments are performed within a specific regulatory jurisdiction context. The compliance_assessment table currently stores jurisdiction as a denormalized STRING column. Adding jurisdicti

attributes.name: manufacturing_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or distribution facility being assessed for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_registration. Business justification: Compliance assessments are frequently performed in the context of a specific product registration — verifying that a registered product continues to meet the conditions of its registration approval. A

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product being assessed for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_contract. Business justification: Supplier contracts in consumer goods mandate periodic compliance audits (GMP, REACH, sustainability). Linking compliance_assessment to supplier_contract identifies which contractual obligation trigger

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Supplier compliance assessments (GMP audits, REACH checks, cosmetic regulation audits) are a core procurement-regulatory process in consumer goods. Linking compliance_assessment to supplier enables su

attributes.name: supplier_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier_site. Business justification: Site-level compliance assessments (GMP facility audits, ISO audits) are conducted at supplier sites in consumer goods. Linking compliance_assessment to supplier_site enables site qualification trackin

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the compliance assessment was performed.

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: Method or approach used to conduct the compliance assessment (e.g., document review, laboratory test, site inspection, supplier audit, self-assessment, third-party certification).
attributes.references: ISO 17025 Laboratory Testing; ISO 19011 Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the compliance assessment record, typically formatted as CA-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the compliance assessment type (e.g., initial, periodic, pre-market, post-market, audit-triggered, change control).

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual or team who conducted the compliance assessment.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this compliance assessment to the audit trail or change history log for traceability and regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 11; EU Annex 11 Computerised Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the third-party certification or approval certificate obtained as evidence of compliance, if applicable.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; ISO 22716 GMP; Third-Party Certification Bodies

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance assessment was formally closed after verification of corrective actions or confirmation of compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 820

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional comments, notes, or observations related to the compliance assessment that provide context or clarification.

attributes.name: compliance_finding
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the compliance assessment finding, including observations, test results, and rationale for the compliance determination.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820; ISO 9001 Quality Management Standard

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance finding status indicating whether the product, formulation, or facility meets the regulatory requirement (compliant, non-compliant, conditional, pending review, not applicable).

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the corrective action plan required to remediate the non-compliance or conditional finding.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 CAPA; ISO 9001 Corrective Action Standard

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the corrective action must be completed to achieve compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Format Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 820 CAPA

attributes.name: corrective_action_owner
attributes.description: Name of the individual or department responsible for implementing the corrective action.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether corrective action is required to address the compliance finding (True if corrective action is required, False otherwise).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 CAPA; ISO 9001 Corrective Action Standard

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action implementation (not started, in progress, completed, verified, overdue).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 820 CAPA; ISO 9001 Corrective Action Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the compliance assessment record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format Standard; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: evidence_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the supporting documentation, test reports, certificates, or dossiers that substantiate the compliance assessment finding.
attributes.references: Internal Document Management Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when the compliance assessment record was last modified or updated.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format Standard; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic compliance assessment or re-assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Regulatory Compliance Standard; ISO 9001 Periodic Review

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body responsible for the regulatory framework (e.g., FDA, EPA, ECHA, CPSC).
attributes.references: FDA; EPA; ECHA (European Chemicals Agency); CPSC; National Regulatory Authorities

attributes.name: regulatory_framework
attributes.description: The governing regulatory framework under which the compliance assessment is conducted (e.g., CFR, IFRA, EU CLP, REACH, EPA, FDA, CPSC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CFR|IFRA|EU_CLP|REACH|EPA|FDA|CPSC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA CFR Title 21; EPA CFR Title 40; EU CLP Regulation (EC) No 1272/2008; REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006; IFRA Standards; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: requirement_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific regulatory requirement being assessed for compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CFR; EPA CFR; EU REACH; IFRA Standards; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: requirement_reference
attributes.description: Specific citation or reference to the regulatory requirement being assessed (e.g., 21 CFR 701.3, IFRA Standard 49, REACH Annex XVII Entry 23).
attributes.references: FDA CFR; EPA CFR; EU REACH; IFRA Standards; CPSC Regulations

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance assessment was formally reviewed and approved.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who reviewed and approved the compliance assessment findings.

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Risk severity level associated with the compliance finding (critical, high, medium, low, negligible).
attributes.references: ISO 31000 Risk Management Standard; FDA Risk-Based Approach

attributes.name: test_report_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the laboratory test report or analytical certificate supporting the compliance assessment, if applicable.

products.name: product_recall
products.description: Product recall and market withdrawal master records initiated voluntarily or mandated by regulatory authorities. Captures recall class (Class I/II/III per FDA/CPSC), recall reason, affected SKUs, affected lot/batch numbers, recall scope (geographic, channel), initiation date, authority notification date, press release reference, quantity recalled, completion date, effectiveness check results, and consumer remedy type. SSOT for recall event management across all jurisdictions and authorities.

attributes.name: product_recall_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product recall event. Primary key for the product recall record.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Recall expenses (logistics, disposal) are allocated to a cost center for budgeting and reporting.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.jurisdiction. Business justification: Product recalls are managed per jurisdiction; linking provides a normalized jurisdiction reference.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Recall financial impact (estimated_financial_impact_amount) must be allocated to the responsible profit center for P&L reporting. Consumer goods companies attribute recall costs to the brand/product p

attributes.name: registration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_registration. Business justification: A product recall is initiated for a product that was approved under a specific regulatory registration. Linking product_recall to regulatory_registration enables traceability from recall events back t

attributes.name: submission_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: A product recall typically requires a regulatory submission — the recall notification filed with the governing authority (e.g., FDA recall notification, CPSC report). Linking product_recall to the cor

attributes.name: affected_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of distribution channels impacted by recall (e.g., Retail, E-commerce, Wholesale, DSD, DTC). Defines which go-to-market channels received affected product.

attributes.name: affected_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where recalled products were distributed (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: affected_gtin_list
attributes.business_glossary_term: Affected Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) List
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of GTIN/UPC/EAN codes for recalled products. Enables point-of-sale and supply chain identification of affected items.

attributes.name: affected_lot_batch_numbers
